areas.summary: The Atrium's relay board rests on a genuinely strong, well-documented design foundation (disciplined RT type ramp, rem-first sizing, canon EMBER/GOLD semantics, full reduced-motion coverage on the relay), but it is not production-ready. A P0 i18n gap means nl/de/es/fr users see a fully English relay board, and several designed features (Keeper's Ledger, the datumLine stats readout) ship silently disabled because their props are hardcoded to null / never wired. The three sibling nav surfaces (PalaceSubNav, TopBar, MobileBottomBar) and both discovery menus were never rebased onto the canon that NavigationBar/AtriumRelay adopted, so they read as an older Tuscan skin (gold-on-generic-chrome, warmStone gradients, cool shadows, 9px labels, emoji icons) with a dead Time Capsule control. Net: the core is coherent but the surface has one localization blocker and a broad band of canon-drift and dead-feature P1s that must clear before ship.

p0.title: Relay tile content is hardcoded English — no i18n across nl/de/es/fr
p0.detail: AtriumRelay is fed by HomeView, where nearly every user-facing tile string is a raw English literal instead of t(): anchor titles/descs ('Enter Your Palace'/'Walk through your rooms in 3D', 'Enter Your Library'/'Your whole collection'), all lane tiles ('Add Photos', 'Import from Cloud', 'Restore a Photo', 'Write a Memory', 'Interviews', 'Capture by WhatsApp', 'Time Capsule', 'Memory Map', 'Timeline', 'Highlights', 'Family Tree', 'Create a Gallery', 'Tidy Your Rooms', 'Explore', 'Life Story', 'Start a Family Group', 'Build Together', 'Invite Relatives', 'Share Publicly'), the YOU pills ('Milestones','Your Profile','Settings','Help & Guides'), and several suggestion cards ('Your family shared with you','On this day','Bring in your first photos','Record your story'). Only a subset (relay.eveningFind, relay.sixtySeconds, relay.familyEmbers, board labels) uses t(). A Dutch/German/Spanish/French user sees a fully English relay board.
p0.recommendation: Route every title/desc/label/reason and the interview 'recorded'/'steps' datum suffixes through t() with relay.* keys added to all five messages files (en/nl/de/es/fr). This is the single biggest multimodality gap on the surface.

p1.title: Legacy LibraryIllustration paints in off-canon walnut + charcoal, not palace ink
p1.detail: LibraryIllustration and the shared particle art use T.color.walnut (#8B7355) as the dominant line/book/shelf ink and T.color.charcoal (#1F1B1A) for wicks. Neither is in the palace token set (canon INK is #403B36). The Library keystone renders in a muddier bronze-brown register than the Palace keystone (pure gold on #403B36), so the two anchor cards — meant to be a matched pair — do not read as the same design language. The file header admits it was 'restored from AtriumHero @ b95ae58', i.e. pre-canon art carried in wholesale.
p1.recommendation: Rebase the Library line-art onto the anchor palette: swap walnut ink for gold/ink used on the dark keystone (#D4AF37 rimming, #403B36 or the anchor descColor for structure) and drop #1F1B1A for a warm ink, so the Library anchor matches the Palace anchor's gilt-on-ink register.

p1.title: Keeper's Ledger is dead in production — ledger prop hardcoded to null
p1.detail: HomeView computes a full relayLedger (warm/quiet weekly line) at lines 704-710, but the production render path (USE_VILLA_HUB=false, AtriumRelay at line 865) passes ledger={null}. Inside AtriumRelay the entire ledger block — greeting subline button, aria-expanded state, and the ONLY trigger for the 12-week weekHistory strip — is wrapped in {ledger ? (...) : null}. Because ledger is null, the whole ledgerOpen state machine and weekHistory dots never render. weekHistory={computeWeekHistory(creationDates)} is still passed (line 872) but unreachable. A whole designed feature is silently missing, plus wasted per-render computeWeekHistory work.
p1.recommendation: Pass ledger={relayLedger} to the AtriumRelay instance (matching AtriumVilla at line 842). If the ledger was intentionally cut, drop the now-unreachable weekHistory prop and the ledger/ledgerOpen code.

p1.title: datumLine (stats line) never wired to AtriumRelay — silently absent
p1.detail:
HomeView computes relayDatum ('{wings} · {rooms} · {memories}' or firstMemoryPrompt) at line 572 and passes it as datumLine only to AtriumVilla (line 841). The production AtriumRelay call (lines 865-887) never passes datumLine. AtriumRelay renders that line only when the prop is present ({datumLine ?

: null}, line 437), so the at-a-glance palace stats line under the greeting is missing on the live board.
p1.recommendation: Add datumLine={relayDatum} to the AtriumRelay props, or remove relayDatum if the stats line is intentionally dropped from the relay layout.

p1.title: Count datums built by number+word concatenation — ungrammatical / unpluralized in de/fr/es
p1.detail: Datum lines are assembled as `${totalWings} ${t('wings')} · ${totalRooms} ${t('rooms')}`, `${totalMemories} ${t('memories')}`, `${mtc.photo} ${t('relay.photosCount')}`, `${interviewSessions.length} recorded`. Interpolated {count} plural forms already exist in the message files (e.g. de 'memories': '{count} Erinnerungen') but are bypassed by manual concat, and 'recorded' is not translated at all. Concatenation forces English word order and drops singular/plural distinction.
p1.recommendation: Use the interpolated t('memories', { count }) / plural-aware keys already present, add a relay.recordedCount key; never hand-concatenate a number with a translated noun.

p1.title: Anchor keystone pair is locked to two columns even in mobile portrait
p1.detail: The anchor row always renders gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr' regardless of isMobile (only the gap narrows). Each anchor tile has minHeight 12rem with an 8rem dark illustration header, title (RT.titleL 1.375rem, 2-line clamp), 2-line desc, a wing/thumb fan and datum. Two side-by-side on a ~360px portrait screen leaves ~9rem per card, crushing the Fraunces title and WingFan (six 2.1rem overlapping medallions) into an unreadable strip.
p1.recommendation: Stack the anchors to a single column on portrait/mobile: gridTemplateColumns: isMobile ? '1fr' : '1fr 1fr' (ideally gate on useIsPortrait so landscape phones keep two).

p1.title: PalaceSubNav spends GOLD on every generic pill border, chevron, section label and bar border — violates palace-only rule
p1.detail: Canon (libraryTokens THE ONE RULE) reserves GOLD #D4AF37 for 'the palace itself only: wing seals, focus rings, on-this-day frames'. PalaceSubNav uses gold as the default accent for ordinary chrome: pillStyle falls back to gold, breadcrumb chevrons are gold, the wing-switcher section label is gold, the bar border is a gold tint, and mobile section labels ('P'/'W') are gold. This is exactly the 'generic button/filter/divider/accent' the rule forbids, making the sub-nav read as an older Tuscan surface vs the EMBER-based NavigationBar directly above it.
p1.recommendation: Reserve gold only for ceremonial cases (Palace-level pill/seal). Default breadcrumb chevrons, section labels and non-wing pill borders to MUTED #716A5E / HAIRLINE #E3D6BC, use EMBER #B85C38 (or wing accent) for the active/current pill, mirroring NavigationBar.

p1.title: Nav surfaces use warmStone→sandstone gradient glass and off-canon shadows instead of NavigationBar's linen-glass + warm-ink grammar
p1.detail: NavigationBar was rebuilt to canon (linen glass, warm-ink shadow rgba(64,59,54,x), HAIRLINE border). PalaceSubNav / TopBar / MobileBottomBar still use the old Tuscan idiom: heavy diagonal warmStone/sandstone gradients and cool/neutral shadows rgba(44,44,42,x)/rgba(0,0,0,x) that are not the warm-ink ramp. Because these bars sit adjacent to and visually continue from NavigationBar, the fill and shadow-temperature mismatch is immediately visible.
p1.recommendation: Adopt NavigationBar's surface grammar: on the desktop sub-nav capsule (linen C7 glass + convert rgba(44,44,42) to rgba(64,59,54)) and on mobile bars/dropdowns swap gradient fills for flat linen glass and replace all rgba(44,44,42,x)/rgba(0,0,0,x) shadows with the warm-ink SHADOW ladder rgba(64,59,54,x).

p1.title: MobileBottomBar and PalaceSubNav run infinite/entrance animations with no prefers-reduced-motion guard
p1.detail: NavigationBar injects a global @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) rule disabling all its animations. MobileBottomBar (mobileMoreSlideUp, mobileBarSlideUp) and PalaceSubNav mobile (mpPendingPulse INFINITE box-shadow pulse, mp-fade-in, subnavDropdownIn) have zero reduced-motion coverage — grep returns 0 matches in both files. The pending-pill pulse loops forever (mpPendingPulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite), exactly the motion reduced-motion users need suppressed.
p1.recommendation: Wrap the injected <style> keyframes in both components with a @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){ [data-mp-palace-bars] *, ...more-menu... { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; } } block mirroring NavigationBar's KEYFRAMES.

p1.title: MobileBottomBar action/label text is 9px (0.5625rem) — below legible minimum and ignores a11y scale
p1.detail: The primary bottom-bar action labels and the More label render at fontSize 0.5625rem (=9px), well under a readable floor and, unlike TopBar/user-menu which respect --a11y-scale, these are fixed rem with no scaling. On the app's most-used mobile surface this is an accessibility and legibility problem, and the emoji-glyph icons (fontSize 1.1875rem) are the only real affordance.
p1.recommendation: Raise the label size to at least 0.625-0.6875rem (matching NavigationBar mobile tab labels at 0.6875rem) and/or multiply by var(--a11y-scale, 1) so it grows in comfortable/large accessibility modes.

p1.title: Headings/labels use near-black charcoal #1F1B1A instead of canon INK #403B36
p1.detail: Every title, feature label and FAB-adjacent text is colored with T.color.charcoal (#1F1B1A), a cold near-black. Canon INK is the warm #403B36 used by the sibling AtriumRelay surface. This makes the menus read colder/harsher than the rest of the Atrium and breaks the 'one warm ink' rule.
p1.recommendation: Replace T.color.charcoal with canon INK #403B36 (import INK from @/lib/libraryTokens, as AtriumRelay does) for all title, feature-label and body-heading text in both menus.

p1.title: Primary FAB gradient uses off-canon terracotta #C66B3D, not EMBER #B85C38
p1.detail: The primary FAB is a gradient from accent (defaulting to T.color.terracotta = #C66B3D) into T.color.walnut = #8B7355. #C66B3D is a brighter, more orange terracotta than the canon interactive EMBER #B85C38 that AtriumRelay uses for its CTA accents. The one CTA on this surface therefore doesn't speak the canon interactive color.
p1.recommendation: Default the FAB accent to canon EMBER #B85C38 (e.g. accent || '#B85C38'), keeping walnut as the deepening stop, so the CTA matches the interactive-ember canon.

p1.title: Card/panel borders use cream & sandstone, never the canon HAIRLINE #E3D6BC
p1.detail: All borders in both files use T.color.cream (#FCFAF5 — same as the surface, so effectively invisible) or T.color.sandstone (#D6CCBA on hover). The canon hairline for card borders is #E3D6BC, which AtriumRelay uses (border: 0.0625rem solid ${HAIRLINE}). The feature tiles thus have near-invisible rest borders and a grey hover border rather than the warm parchment hairline used everywhere else.
p1.recommendation: Use canon HAIRLINE #E3D6BC for the panel, feature-tile and ActionMenu borders (rest state), reserving a warmer accent for hover, to match the Atrium/Library hairline grammar.

p1.title: Time Capsule discovery tile is a dead no-op — button dismisses without doing anything
p1.detail: In MemoryPalace.tsx the DiscoveryMenu onTimeCapsule prop is an empty stub: onTimeCapsule={() => {/* navigate to room for time capsule */}}. In DiscoveryMenu the tile onClick calls actionMap[f.action](); props.onDismiss(); (line 124), so tapping the 'Time Capsules' feature card runs the empty function and immediately closes the menu. The feature is advertised with a title + description ('Seal a room to open on a future date') but is completely non-functional — a dead control in a first-run discovery surface.
p1.recommendation: Wire onTimeCapsule to the real time-capsule flow (open the room/time-capsule panel like the other handlers), or if not ready, remove the timeCapsules entry from FEATURES so the menu doesn't present a control that does nothing.

p2plus.title: relay-suggest hover shadow breaks the 'one warm ink' shadow grammar
p2plus.recommendation: Use the shared HOVER_SHADOW (rgba(64,59,54,0.16)) — or a warm-ink value at slightly higher elevation — so the suggestion card obeys the same three-step ink shadow ramp as the tiles.

p2plus.title: AtriumRelay re-declares RT / SHADOW / HAIRLINE locally instead of importing libraryTokens
p2plus.recommendation: Import RT, SHADOW, HOVER_SHADOW, TOP_HIGHLIGHT, HAIRLINE, GOLD, EMBER, SAGE, GOLD_SOFT from src/lib/libraryTokens and delete the local copies, keeping the ACCENT/TRAY board-specific maps as the only local additions.

p2plus.title: Ledger warmth-strip dots + ledger accent use ochre #8A6410, an off-token gold
p2plus.recommendation: Consolidate the gold ink family: use GOLD (#D4AF37) for ceremonial and GOLD_SOFT/#C99A2E for softer graphic gold, and promote #8A6410 / #E8C255 to named tokens if a darker ledger-ochre and lighter flame-gold are genuinely wanted.

p2plus.title: SOON tile glyph well and label use a hard-coded grey #A9A090 outside the token set
p2plus.recommendation: Use MUTED #716A5E (or a warm-stone tint) for the Soon glyph and label so the disabled state stays in the warm-ink family.

p2plus.title: WingFan seal count badge and dark-shadow use raw black, off the warm-ink shadow rule
p2plus.recommendation: Swap rgba(0,0,0,0.35) for a warm-ink shadow such as rgba(46,42,38,0.4) so the seal fan obeys the single-ink shadow language.

p2plus.title: Anchor arrow and back-card arrow use different golds than the tile they sit on
p2plus.recommendation: Make the arrow colour consistent per lane: drive both hero and secondary arrows from a.tileTop, or standardise all invite arrows on GOLD_SOFT.

p2plus.title: RelayVignettes hard-code CREAM #FCFAF5 and HAIR #E3D6BC as literals instead of tokens
p2plus.recommendation: Import CREAM and HAIRLINE from libraryTokens (or T.color) and reference them so a future palette change propagates automatically.

p2plus.title: Hero selection can pick a hidden/soon tile as the lane lead via the suggestion key
p2plus.recommendation: Base heroFor's share-lane choice on the same predicate as the tile's visibility (sharedWithMe.length>0 only, not sharedLoading), or have markHero re-verify the chosen hero key is in the non-hidden, loaded set.

p2plus.title: Retired chips path is fully dead code (relayChips always empty)
p2plus.recommendation: Either remove the chips prop and its render/grid branch from AtriumRelay, or restore a real use.

p2plus.title: Several relay tile titles/reasons are hardcoded English, bypassing i18n
p2plus.recommendation: Route all tile titles/descs and suggestion strings through t()/tWings as the ledger/labels already are, adding keys to messages/{en,nl,de,es,fr}.json.

p2plus.title: memoriesStrip mixed-count footer uses hardcoded English + non-tabular units
p2plus.recommendation: Replace with an i18n string using count-aware keys (relay.stripSummary with {photos},{videos},{stories},{wings}).

p2plus.title: Suggestion 'letter'/'shared' can duplicate a lane tile action without dedup guard
p2plus.recommendation: When a suggestion key is promoted to a lane hero, suppress the redundant top suggestion card or exclude that key from hero promotion so each action appears once.

p2plus.title: EmbersRow avatars are undersized for a comfortable touch target
p2plus.recommendation: Add vertical padding so the whole cameo+name is a >=2.75rem tall tap zone, and add an edge fade / aria-describedby hint that the strip scrolls.

p2plus.title: Anchor illustrations are passed hover={false} — no touch/press visual feedback
p2plus.recommendation: Wire the illustration's hover to the tile's hover/active state (and an :active brighten for touch) so press feedback and the lit state are reachable across input modes.

p2plus.title: Back-card slide-up motion and invite arrows are entirely (hover: hover)-gated
p2plus.recommendation: Provide a lightweight always-on affordance for touch (e.g. a persistent low-opacity open arrow on secondary tiles).

p2plus.title: Dark scrim/overlay colors are off-canon umber-black, not warm ink
p2plus.recommendation: Standardize scrims on a warm-ink wash, e.g. rgba(64,59,54,0.35).

p2plus.title: Sub-nav and bottom bar mix px borders instead of the canon rem hairlines
p2plus.recommendation: Replace 1px/1.5px/2px border literals with 0.0625rem/0.09375rem/0.125rem to match NavigationBar and let borders scale with a11y-scale.

p2plus.title: MobileBottomBar and TopBar mobile menu rely entirely on emoji glyphs for iconography, breaking consistency with the crafted SVG icon system
p2plus.recommendation: Replace emoji with the app's stroke SVG icon components tinted MUTED/accent, matching the NavigationBar/PalaceSubNav icon language.

p2plus.title: Mobile 'Enter' portico uses a saturated gold→terracotta→walnut radial gradient — heavy ceremonial gold on an ordinary nav commit control
p2plus.recommendation: Reground the active Enter state on EMBER (interactive) with at most a subtle gold seam, dropping the full gold radial + glow.

p2plus.title: PalaceSubNav wing dropdowns use pure-white glass instead of NavigationBar's linen glass
p2plus.recommendation: Match NavigationBar menus: linen glass background and warm-ink shadow (rgba(64,59,54,x)), drop the gold 1px inset ring.

p2plus.title: TopBar section-header letter-spacing is in rem, producing inconsistent small-caps tracking vs the em-based canon overline
p2plus.recommendation: Express small-caps tracking in em (e.g. 0.06em) to match the RT overline voice.

p2plus.title: WingsDropdown trigger shows untranslated raw wing name
p2plus.recommendation: Wrap with translateWingName: {activeWingData ? translateWingName(activeWingData, tWings) : tc('palaceMap')}.

p2plus.title: Shared-wing display name is fabricated from the slug instead of the real name
p2plus.recommendation: Pass the shared wing's real display name through SharedWingItem (add a name field populated when shares are fetched) and render translateWingName/that name; fall back to slug only if missing.

p2plus.title: getProgress() is invoked unconditionally on every MobileBottomBar render
p2plus.recommendation: Move the getProgress() call inside the exploreItems/awards build block (or memoize gated on moreMenuOpen) so it only runs when the More menu is rendered.

p2plus.title: Room pill uses non-null assertion on a wingId that can be null
p2plus.recommendation: Only map focusRooms when focusWingId is truthy, and drop the ! in favor of an explicit if (!focusWingId) return; early-out.

p2plus.title: Unused useMemo import in TopBar (dead import)
p2plus.recommendation: Remove useMemo from the import.

p2plus.title: Bottom-bar and palace-subnav actions use emoji glyphs as the sole icon layer — cross-platform multimodal risk
p2plus.recommendation: Migrate action glyphs to the inline-SVG icon set used by NavigationBar/WingRoomIcons so rendering is deterministic across devices and themeable to canon colors.

p2plus.title: Shared-wing names shown untranslated/raw-cased instead of via translateWingName
p2plus.recommendation: Resolve shared wings to a WingItem (or map slug to nameKey) and render with translateWingName/tWings; if user-custom-named, pass its real name.

p2plus.title: PalaceSubNav room breadcrumb pill renders roomName prop raw (not translated) while other room labels use translateRoomName
p2plus.recommendation: Have callers pass a nameKey (or the RoomItem) into PalaceSubNav so the breadcrumb runs through translateRoomName like the dropdown entries.

p2plus.title: Desktop scroll-shrink and pulse animations lack an in-JS reduced-motion consideration for transform-based movement
p2plus.recommendation: When adding reduced-motion guards to PalaceSubNav/MobileBottomBar, include transition: none !important as well as animation: none, matching NavigationBar, so inline-style transitions are also stilled.

p2plus.title: No multimodal capture entry point (voice/photo/camera) surfaced in the primary nav despite app being capture-centric
p2plus.recommendation: Consider a split/long-press on the accent Add button offering photo / camera / voice-note capture directly, so common multimodal inputs are one tap from the nav.

p2plus.title: Secondary text uses off-canon muted #857B70 instead of MUTED #716A5E
p2plus.recommendation: Use canon MUTED #716A5E for the subtitle and description spans (and any muted text in ActionMenu).

p2plus.title: Backdrop overlay uses raw rgba(42,34,24,0.55), not warm-ink rgba(64,59,54,x)
p2plus.recommendation: Switch the scrim to the warm-ink base, e.g. rgba(64,59,54,0.55).

p2plus.title: Panel surface is greyer linen #F2EDE4 rather than canon CREAM #FCFAF5
p2plus.recommendation: Use CREAM #FCFAF5 (or TRAY #F6EBE3 recessed sandstone) as the panel/tray surface with a HAIRLINE #E3D6BC border.

p2plus.title: 'Explore on my own' dismiss button colored walnut, not INK/MUTED
p2plus.recommendation: Color the dismiss label with MUTED #716A5E (or INK #403B36) and use a HAIRLINE border, keeping walnut for non-text ink only.

p2plus.title: Feature-tile hover elevation diverges from canon HOVER_LIFT + SHADOW ramp
p2plus.recommendation: Adopt the canon hover: translateY(-0.1875rem) lift plus SHADOW[1]/HOVER_SHADOW from libraryTokens.

p2plus.title: ActionMenu is dead code — no longer imported or rendered anywhere
p2plus.recommendation: Delete ActionMenu.tsx (and its actionMenu i18n block if unused elsewhere) or add a tracking comment/TODO if it's intended to return.

p2plus.title: onShare / onCustomize discovery tiles silently do nothing when no active room/wing
p2plus.recommendation: Provide a fallback when activeRoomId is null (open a room picker or route to the palace/library share entry) so the Share tile always leads somewhere.

p2plus.title: ActionMenu Escape only closes when a menu button holds focus; container has no Escape handler
p2plus.recommendation: Add a single Escape handler at the wrapping div (or a document keydown effect gated on open) so Escape reliably closes the fan. Low priority since currently unwired.

p2plus.title: ActionMenu uses array index as React key for secondary items
p2plus.recommendation: Key on a stable identifier such as item.label instead of the array index.

p2plus.title: ActionMenu disclosure lacks menu roles and aria-controls linkage
p2plus.recommendation: Add id to the popup with role='menu', give each item role='menuitem', set aria-controls={popupId} on the toggle; optionally move focus into the first menuitem when opened.

p2plus.title: DiscoveryMenu feature grid has no dedicated landscape-phone / narrow layout
p2plus.recommendation: Use useIsPortrait()/useIsSmall() to pick a 3-column (or auto-fit minmax) grid in landscape-phone, and reduce card padding when the viewport is short.

p2plus.title: DiscoveryMenu feature buttons expose affordance only via hover, not on touch
p2plus.recommendation: Add a touch/active feedback path (onPointerDown or WebkitTapHighlight / active-state style) and an explicit focus-visible outline in canon GOLD.

p2plus.title: Design-token drift from canon values (cream/muted/interactive)
p2plus.recommendation: Reconcile theme.ts muted/interactive tokens with libraryTokens (MUTED #716A5E, EMBER #B85C38); verify muted secondary text still meets 4.5:1 on cream.

strengths: Disciplined type system: a single RT ramp with Fraunces for all titles/greeting and Source Sans for meta/overline/body, applied consistently across anchors, hero, secondary, soon, pills and the ledger — no ad-hoc font sizes.
Rigorous rem usage throughout sizing (radii, min-heights, gaps, medallion dimensions) with px reserved only for hairlines/SVG strokes; chip and pill touch targets respect the 2.75rem/3rem minimum.

Coherent, well-documented canon story: the dark-gilt keystone is deliberately the ONLY ink-dark + true-gold register, lanes carry pre-mixed opaque earth trays with matching left rules and overlines, and EMBER/GOLD semantics are honoured (gold = the palace, ember = interactive).
Fully responsive via inline styles + isMobile prop and (hover:*) media queries only — no layout @media, matching the house rule; grid columns and hero span collapse cleanly on mobile.

Thorough empty/quiet/error-adjacent styling on the relay: warmth=0 desaturates rather than greys-dead, empty wing seals render as quiet gilt frames, the ledger has a non-scolding warm/quiet copy split, and 'add your name' has a designed inline affordance.

Complete reduced-motion coverage on the relay board itself: one prefers-reduced-motion:reduce block disables every animation/transition and neutralises hover transforms, with the shared 4s breath tempo applied consistently.
Vignettes and icons share one engraved USP visual language (parchment grid, zone-ink strokes, one gilt detail) tying relay tiles to the landing-page card system for cross-surface consistency.
Defensive icon/vignette lookups: RelayIcons[k] ?? RelayIcons.palace, chips fallback RelayIcons.continue, you-row fallback RelayIcons.settings — an unknown key never throws.

Every interactive relay element is a real <button type='button'> with a concrete onClick wired to navigation/state (router.push, setShow*, handleNavigate*) — no dead controls among the tiles/pills/anchors.
Empty/zero states handled: tile.hidden filtering, lane suppression when visible.length===0, datum/thumbs/chips conditionally rendered, and memoriesStrip/embers gated on non-empty arrays.
Broken-image resilience: the memories strip uses a real with onError→markImgBroken and filters brokenImgIds on the next render, so expired thumbnails self-heal out of the strip.
The ledgerOpen state machine is correct where reachable — onClick bound only when weekHistory has entries, aria-expanded set, cursor/pointer reflect interactivity.

areas.summary: The Library's Il Muro photo wall is a genuine highlight — chromeless justified tiles, correct index provenance into the viewer, canon-clean typography/rem discipline, robust measurement/fallback logic, and real focus-visible/reduced-motion a11y. But readiness is held back by one P0 and a dense band of P1s. The single P0 is a real launch blocker: iPad portrait (768-1024px) is not covered by the phone-only isMobile prop, so a touch-only tablet renders the mouse-built 17rem desktop sidebar with ~1.5rem rows, 0.875rem buttons, hover-only affordances, and a sub-16px search input that triggers iOS zoom. Beyond that, multiple P1s cluster around touch-target floors below 2.75rem, a keyboard/AT-unreachable jump-to-date rail, gold-vs-EMBER canon violations on the primary Import CTA, off-canon ink/bronze tokens in RoomMediaPanel, ignored-but-wired mobile props, a missing i18n key in all five locales, and a StoragePlayerPanel with zero responsive hooks. Ship the P0 sidebar gating first, then the touch-target and canon-token P1 sweep.

p0.title: iPad portrait renders the tiny-touch desktop sidebar (isMobile prop is not iPad-aware)
p0.detail: The component branches solely on the injected isMobile boolean (if isMobile return mobile pill strip, else desktop). isMobile derives from useIsMobile whose query is (max-width: 767px), (max-height: 500px). iPad portrait is 768-1024px wide, so isMobile is FALSE and the full 17rem desktop sidebar renders on a touch-only tablet. That desktop tree is built for a mouse: room rows are ~1.5rem tall, the info ? button is 0.875rem, the color dot hit box is 1.5rem, and color swatches are 1.125rem — every one far below the 2.75rem touch minimum. Hover-only affordances (chevron opacity, color-dot opacity 0.6->1 on hover) also never trigger on touch. This same code path also forces the sub-16px search input onto iPad, causing iOS zoom-on-focus.
p0.recommendation: Gate the layout on useIsCompact() (max-width:1024px) or useIsTablet() rather than the phone-only isMobile prop, so iPad portrait gets touch-sized targets. At minimum, bump room-row / tooltip / color-dot / swatch hit boxes to >=2.75rem when useTouchControls() is true.

p1.title: Tile touch targets can fall well below 2.75rem in packed rows on phones
p1.detail: Tiles are the primary interactive control (open viewer / toggle-select), but their height is whatever the justified packer produces. For non-last rows the height is h = (containerWidth - gaps) / sumAR, which can be far below the targetRowHeight of 116px on a <420px phone once several wide-aspect photos share a row; individual tile width (item.ar * h) can also shrink to a sliver for tall/narrow images. Nothing clamps tile w/h to a >=2.75rem (44px) minimum, so on a dense wall a phone user may face tap targets of ~30px or less.
p1.recommendation: On coarse-pointer/mobile, enforce a floor: raise targetRowHeight or clamp per-tile min-height to 2.75rem, and/or reduce tiles-per-row on narrow widths so no packed tile renders under 44px in either dimension.

p1.title: Jump-to-date rail is keyboard-unreachable (tabIndex={-1})
p1.detail: The right-edge scrubber is a core navigation affordance for long libraries, but every tick button is explicitly removed from the tab order and the whole rail is aria-hidden. Keyboard and screen-reader users have no way to jump to a month/year — they must tab through potentially thousands of tiles. The pointer-drag scrubbing (touchAction:none) is pointer-only.
p1.recommendation: Expose the rail as a real navigation control: give the container role="navigation" with an aria-label, make tick buttons focusable (drop tabIndex={-1}), and remove aria-hidden so AT users can jump to sections; keep the pointer-drag as an enhancement.

p1.title: SearchBar input text uses charcoal #1F1B1A instead of canon INK #403B36
p1.detail: The search input color is T.color.charcoal = #1F1B1A, a near-black that is darker/cooler than the warm INK #403B36 used everywhere in the sidebar for primary text. On a warm cream/white glass field this reads as a harder, off-canon black.
p1.recommendation: Set the input color to INK #403B36 (import from libraryTokens) to match the sidebar's primary-text ink.

p1.title: Mobile sidebar silently drops room selection, search, drag-drop, shared, add, and Enter-Palace — many wired props are ignored
p1.detail: The isMobile branch returns early after rendering only wing pills. Props onSelectRoom, sharedWings/onSharedClick, onAddWing/onAddRoom, wingWarmth, dragActive/onDropMemory, and onEnter3D are all passed from LibraryView (lines 1342-1359) but never consumed on mobile. So on mobile there is no way to pick a specific room from the sidebar, no sidebar search, no seal-warmth, and drag-drop into rooms is dead. If the parent relies on this component as the mobile nav, those controls are simply non-functional there.
p1.recommendation: Either document that mobile intentionally delegates room/search/drag to other UI (and stop passing the unused props to avoid implying they work), or add a room drill-down + search to the mobile strip. At minimum ensure onEnter3D and room selection are reachable on mobile.

p1.title: Sidebar search input fontSize 0.75rem triggers iOS zoom-on-focus (on iPad)
p1.detail: The desktop sidebar search input uses fontSize 0.75rem. Because the desktop sidebar renders on iPad (see the isMobile P0 finding), tapping this input on iPad Safari/WKWebView triggers the automatic zoom that fires whenever an input's font is below 16px/1rem. The canon explicitly requires input fontSize 1rem to prevent iOS zoom.
p1.recommendation: Set the sidebar search input fontSize to 1rem (at least on touch), matching SearchBar.tsx which already does fontSize:isMobile?"1rem":"0.75rem".

p1.title: searchBar.clearFilter key missing in ALL five locales — aria-label reads the raw key
p1.detail: SearchBar's clear button uses aria-label={t("clearFilter")}, but clearFilter does not exist in en/nl/de/es/fr searchBar sections. useTranslation falls back to English and then to the literal key string, so the accessible name announced by screen readers is the untranslated token "clearFilter" in every language.
p1.recommendation: Add a "clearFilter" key (e.g. "Clear search and filters") to searchBar in all five message files, translated per locale.

p1.title: Primary Import CTA misuses GOLD — canon reserves gold for the palace itself
p1.detail: The Import button (the main action of the Library tab) is painted with a gold gradient (T.color.gold -> T.color.goldDark) plus a gold-tinted shadow. libraryTokens.ts THE ONE RULE states gold is for 'the palace itself ONLY: wing seals, focus rings, on-this-day frames' and 'Never spend gold on a generic button, filter, divider or accent.' A generic import/upload button should be EMBER (#B85C38) — which is exactly what the sibling LibraryEmptyState CTA already uses. This is the single most prominent styling element in the panel and it contradicts both the token doctrine and its own sibling surface.
p1.recommendation: Repaint the Import button in EMBER (#B85C38 / gradient to a warm-rust like #9A4F2A->#6B3318 matching land.ctaGrad) and drop the gold shadow to a warm-ink SHADOW.1 token. Reserve gold strictly for focus rings/seals.

p1.title: Off-canon dark-bronze scrims and pills (rgba(42,34,24,...)) instead of warm-ink register
p1.detail: Multiple overlays, pills, badges and the clear-slot button use rgba(42,34,24,x) — a cold near-black bronze that is NOT in the canon. Canon warm-ink is #403B36 / #2E2A26 (rgba(64,59,54,x)), which StoragePlayerPanel correctly uses. RoomMediaPanel instead sprinkles rgba(42,34,24,.4) for the backdrop scrim, rgba(42,34,24,0.55)/0.75/0.85 for the DisplayedPill background, toast, count badge and slot clear button. This reads as a slightly muddier, greener-black than the rest of the palace and is visible everywhere the panel opens.
p1.recommendation: Replace every rgba(42,34,24,x) with the canon warm-ink rgba(64,59,54,x) (or the #2E2A26 register StoragePlayerPanel uses) so scrims/pills/badges match the Atrium and Library siblings.

p1.title: Uses legacy T.color tokens (charcoal #1F1B1A, muted #857B70, terracotta) instead of libraryTokens canon
p1.detail: The whole panel is built on the legacy theme palette: T.color.charcoal is #1F1B1A (cold near-black), T.color.muted is #857B70, default accent falls back to T.color.terracotta #C66B3D. Canon per libraryTokens.ts is INK #403B36, MUTED #716A5E, EMBER_GLYPH #9A4F2A. The sibling LibraryEmptyState hardcodes the canon values directly, so within the same Library surface the RoomMediaPanel text ink and secondary text are a visibly different, colder gray-black than the empty state it renders. This is a systemic drift, not a one-off.
p1.recommendation: Import from libraryTokens (INK/MUTED/EMBER_GLYPH/HAIRLINE) and swap charcoal->INK #403B36, muted->#716A5E, terracotta fallback->wingAccent()/EMBER_GLYPH so the panel matches its own sibling surfaces.

p1.title: Move-selected button hidden behind onSelect, but move actually depends on room/moveMemory
p1.detail: In select mode the 'Move selected' bulk button is only rendered when onSelect is truthy, yet handleMoveSelected/handleMoveToRoom don't use onSelect at all — they use movingMem, room and moveMemory. So a parent that passes onDelete/onUpdate but not the optional onSelect callback silently loses the bulk-move feature even though moving would work fine. Conversely single-card onMove is always wired, creating inconsistent availability of the same capability.
p1.recommendation: Gate the bulk-move button on the real dependency (room && moveMemory) rather than onSelect, matching the always-available single-card move path.

p1.title: StoragePlayerPanel has zero responsive hooks — fixed desktop sizing on phones/iPad
p1.detail: The whole storage player overlay imports no useIsMobile/useIsCompact/useIsPortrait. It hardcodes maxWidth 43.75rem and video maxHeight 22.5rem with fixed 1.5rem horizontal padding regardless of viewport. On a small phone in landscape (height < 500px) the 22.5rem-tall video plus header can overflow the fold, and there is no portrait/landscape or iPad density adaptation. Per canon, responsiveness must come from the hooks (inline styles, no @media), and this file adapts to nothing except safe-area insets.
p1.recommendation: Import useIsMobile()/useIsSmall() and scale video maxHeight (e.g. min(22.5rem, 55vh)), header font, and horizontal padding for phone/landscape; verify the active-player + list fit within the fold on a landscape phone.

p2plus.title: Canon color tokens re-hardcoded as hex literals throughout the wall
p2plus.recommendation: Import INK, MUTED, HAIRLINE, GOLD_SOFT, EMBER_GLYPH from libraryTokens and replace the literals; use the already-imported CREAM in the sticky-band gradient instead of a fresh #FCFAF5.

p2plus.title: Focus ring grammar diverges from the shared focusRing token
p2plus.recommendation: Reference GOLD from the token instead of #D4AF37, and add a second inset contrast ring so the gold focus reads on both light and dark tiles.

p2plus.title: Empty/fallback glyph tiles render washed-out on the light Il Muro gradient
p2plus.recommendation: For PhotoWall fallbacks pass a canon ink/ember-glyph iconColor (e.g. EMBER_GLYPH or INK at ~0.7) rather than translucent white.

p2plus.title: Layout seam gap uses raw px instead of rem
p2plus.recommendation: Express the seam in rem (e.g. 0.1875rem) or thread it through the packer as a rem-derived px value.

p2plus.title: Scrubber-rail tick spends gold-family color on a generic nav control
p2plus.recommendation: Use EMBER for the active/hover tick and reserve gold only for the section-band gilt rule.

p2plus.title: Selected-tile check badge uses fixed rem size regardless of tile scale
p2plus.recommendation: Scale the badge and its inset from the packed tile height so the selection mark keeps consistent visual weight.

p2plus.title: Sibling TuscanCard primitive still carries off-canon dark bronze-glass styling
p2plus.recommendation: Migrate any Il Muro-adjacent TuscanCard usage to warm-ink SHADOW ramp + CREAM/HAIRLINE tokens and 0.0625rem hairlines.

p2plus.title: Room-lens 'undated last' sort is dead code — undated tiles are NOT forced to the end
p2plus.recommendation: Detect the undated bucket by comparing the label against undatedLabel so the existing undated-last sort actually fires.

p2plus.title: Last/short row can overflow container width for wide (panoramic) tiles
p2plus.recommendation: For the last row, if summed widths + gaps exceed containerWidth, solve the row height to fit or cap each tile width.

p2plus.title: TileMedia source-fallback index persists across memory changes due to key reuse
p2plus.recommendation: Reset idx when the sources array identity/length changes (useEffect on [sources]).

p2plus.title: Tiles use role=listitem without an enclosing role=list, breaking list semantics
p2plus.recommendation: Either drop role=listitem or add role=list to the row/section containers.

p2plus.title: onDragEnd fires without the !selectMode guard used by draggable/onDragStart
p2plus.recommendation: Match the guard: onDragEnd={draggableTiles && !selectMode ? () => onTileDragEnd?.() : undefined}.

p2plus.title: Tiles lack list semantics and selection state for screen readers
p2plus.recommendation: Wrap rows in role=list and set aria-pressed={selected} (or role=checkbox + aria-checked) in selectMode.

p2plus.title: Selection checkmark badge has no text alternative
p2plus.recommendation: Pair the visual badge with aria-pressed on the button or a visually-hidden 'Selected' label.

p2plus.title: countLabel renders a bare number with no unit/pluralization for AT
p2plus.recommendation: Return a translated, pluralized string (reuse memoryCount key) across en/nl/de/es/fr.

p2plus.title: Native HTML5 drag-to-room has no keyboard/touch equivalent
p2plus.recommendation: Provide a non-drag path (context/kebab action or selectMode + move-selected) reachable on touch and keyboard.

p2plus.title: Section band media use no lang-aware alt; decorative alt='' on real photos
p2plus.recommendation: Append the media type to the button's accessible name so audio/video/document memories are distinguishable non-visually.

p2plus.title: SearchBar uses px for blur/maxWidth/calc instead of rem
p2plus.recommendation: Convert blur(10px)/blur(8px), maxWidth/calc, and active border to rem; reserve px for hairlines only.

p2plus.title: Two different 'muted' grays across the two sibling surfaces
p2plus.recommendation: Standardize on canon MUTED #716A5E from libraryTokens.

p2plus.title: Storage progress bar uses terracotta gradient while wing progress bars use EMBER
p2plus.recommendation: Use EMBER #B85C38 for the storage progress fill too, or a single shared token.

p2plus.title: SearchBar has no styled empty/no-results state
p2plus.recommendation: When filteredCount===0, render a canon-styled empty hint (Fraunces line + muted subtext + EMBER clear-filters link).

p2plus.title: SearchBar result-count typography is undersized vs the RT ramp
p2plus.recommendation: Raise the count and pill-label minimum to at least RT.overline (0.6875rem).

p2plus.title: Mobile pill strip and hardcoded RGBA glass are not sourced from tokens
p2plus.recommendation: Derive the mobile strip glass and borders from CREAM/TRAY/HAIRLINE tokens.

p2plus.title: SearchBar.tsx is entirely dead code — imported and rendered nowhere
p2plus.recommendation: Delete SearchBar.tsx (and its unused searchBar i18n namespace) or actually wire it into LibraryView.

p2plus.title: SearchBar type filter compares raw m.type instead of normalizeDisplayType, unlike the live wall
p2plus.recommendation: If revived, route filterType through the same normalizeDisplayType mapping; otherwise remove with the component.

p2plus.title: Wing recolor only tints the dot + chevron; the wing's real accent is never overridden
p2plus.recommendation: Apply wingColors as the effective accent everywhere or route the choice through roomStore.changeWingAccent so it is authoritative app-wide.

p2plus.title: Sidebar search hides wings but header/stats counts still say total wings
p2plus.recommendation: Use unfiltered wings.length for header/stats counts, or gate stats to reflect filtering consistently for both wings and rooms.

p2plus.title: 'Enter Palace' vs 'Enter this Wing' label keys off wings[0].id, fragile after reordering/deletion
p2plus.recommendation: Test against the sentinel the parent uses (selectedWing !== '__all__') rather than positional wings[0]?.id.

p2plus.title: colorPicker and tooltip open-state never auto-closes on outside click / wing switch
p2plus.recommendation: Reset colorPickerWing to null in onSelectWing (or add a click-away listener), and make the tooltip click-toggle OR hover, not both.

p2plus.title: Desktop room / control touch targets below 2.75rem
p2plus.recommendation: When on touch (useTouchControls), enlarge interactive rows/buttons to >=2.75rem hit area, consistent with the mobile pill strip.

p2plus.title: No multimodal capture entry point in the search/facet surface
p2plus.recommendation: Consider a voice-search mic button (guarded to touch + SpeechRecognition-capable browsers) reusing the app's speech pipeline; optional.

p2plus.title: Decorative emoji icons not hidden from assistive tech
p2plus.recommendation: Add aria-hidden='true' to the decorative emoji spans (magnifier and type-pill icons).

p2plus.title: Shadows use cold rgba(44,44,42,...) and rgba(0,0,0,0.3) instead of canon warm-ink shadow ramp
p2plus.recommendation: Replace with SHADOW.1/.2 and HOVER_SHADOW constants (rgba(64,59,54,x)) from libraryTokens.

p2plus.title: Moved-toast uses cold charcoal #1F1B1A background
p2plus.recommendation: Use warm-ink #403B36 (or #2E2A26) for the toast background and a warm-ink shadow.

p2plus.title: Furniture-slot count badges and pills use hardcoded #FFF and sub-ramp fontSizes
p2plus.recommendation: Raise micro-labels to the RT.overline 0.6875rem floor and swap pure #FFF -> CREAM #FCFAF5.

p2plus.title: StoragePlayerPanel empty state is text-only, unlike the illustrated Library empty state
p2plus.recommendation: Give the storage empty state the same overline/title/subtitle rhythm (and a dark-surface engraved SVG variant) as LibraryEmptyState.

p2plus.title: Gallery furniture-slot glyphs are raw emoji, breaking the custom-SVG icon language
p2plus.recommendation: Replace furniture-slot emoji with the existing TypeIcon/stroke-SVG set tinted in the wing accent.

p2plus.title: handleSelect / handleMoveToRoom dependency arrays omit used values
p2plus.recommendation: Add slotCounts (and drop unused t if not needed) to the dependency array so limit reflects current slot capacities.

p2plus.title: Select-all checkbox and count operate on filtered list; deleting a superset feels inconsistent
p2plus.recommendation: On searchQuery/filterType change, prune selectedIds to currently-visible ids (or clear selection).

p2plus.title: StoragePlayerPanel activeMem can become stale/deleted with no reconciliation
p2plus.recommendation: Reconcile activeMem against the fresh list; if not found in stored, reset to stored[0] || null and use a guarded seed.

p2plus.title: Non-exhibition auto-evict removes an arbitrary 'oldest' occupant with no ordering guarantee
p2plus.recommendation: Sort occupants by createdAt (or a real displayOrder) before evicting so 'oldest' matches the UI promise.

p2plus.title: Cloud import failures are swallowed with no user feedback
p2plus.recommendation: Surface a toast/error on non-ok or thrown import rather than closing silently.

p2plus.title: RoomMediaPlayer receives displayedMems (filtered/sorted) so index navigation excludes hidden items
p2plus.recommendation: Either pass the unfiltered mems (mapping index into it) or document that player navigation is scoped to the active filter.

p2plus.title: Sort and display-unit dropdowns lack menu/listbox roles and aria state
p2plus.recommendation: Add aria-haspopup='menu' + aria-expanded to triggers, role='menu' to popovers, role='menuitemradio' + aria-checked to options, and arrow-key handling.

p2plus.title: StoragePlayerPanel autoPlays video/audio with no reduced-motion / autoplay guard
p2plus.recommendation: Only autoPlay when the user explicitly selects an item (not on initial mount of stored[0]), gate motion behind prefers-reduced-motion, and consider muted-first for video.

p2plus.title: RoomMediaPanel adapts only via useIsMobile — no iPad-portrait / compact handling
p2plus.recommendation: Use useIsTablet()/useIsCompact() to keep touch-sized targets (>=2.75rem close button, larger pills) on iPad.

p2plus.title: Furniture slot thumbnails use CSS background-image with no alt/label text
p2plus.recommendation: Prefer an or add an aria-label to the slot button that includes the assigned memory title.

strengths: The core Il Muro concept is executed with strong discipline: truly chromeless edge-to-edge tiles (no card, border, shadow, or per-tile text), letting the photograph be the memory exactly as the spec intends.

Warm-ink shadow and gold-seam grammar is honored where it matters: the sticky month band uses the correct gilt underline gradient (#C99A2E -> transparent) matching libraryTokens giltRule, and the scrub label bubble uses the canon warm-ink shadow rgba(64,59,54,0.14).
Typography is on-canon: Fraunces for section/band titles and Source Sans for meta/counts, with a restrained size ramp (1.0625rem title, 0.8125rem meta, 0.6875rem overline) matching the RT ramp.
Excellent rem discipline in the component body (paddings, radii, badge sizes, rail spacing all in rem) with px correctly reserved only for the tile-packing math that must be pixel-exact.

Responsiveness is done the canon way — measured container width + targetRowHeight() instead of @media breakpoints, and the scrub rail is tucked into a reserved mobile gutter so it never overlays tiles.

a11y polish on the wall: real focus-visible ring, reduced-motion guard on tile transitions, hover-only brightness via @media (hover:hover), aria-labels on tiles/sections, and EMBER used correctly for the interactive selected state.

Index provenance is correct end-to-end: each tile carries its original _i into mems, onOpen(item._i) sets mediaPlayerIndex, and RoomMediaPlayer receives the SAME memories={filteredRoomMems} + initialIndex, so the viewer opens exactly the tapped memory regardless of grouping or sort.

Robust width measurement: useLayoutEffect for a synchronous pre-paint measure, a ResizeObserver with a >1px threshold to avoid thrash, and a window-based effWidth fallback so a lagging/zero measurement never yields a blank wall.
Aspect-ratio repack loop is guarded against thrash: compares against the same typed fallback used at pack time, only re-packs when |delta|>0.02, and batches a single rAF repack via pendingRepack.
Image source fallback (thumbnail -> original -> glyph) is safe and terminates: onError increments idx and cleanly renders the type glyph with no infinite retry once idx exceeds sources.

Empty/loading states are handled at the parent (PhotoWall only renders when filteredRoomMems.length>0, with a shimmer skeleton while roomLoading), and packJustifiedRows early-returns [] for width<=0 or empty items.
Scrubber rail is well-behaved: hidden below 2 ticks, condensed to year ticks above 24 sections, uses pointer capture with try/catch for older browsers, and cleans up its timeout on unmount.

areas.summary: The Explore surface is largely production-ready: the main directory/rails page (ExplorePageClient.tsx) shows strong canon fidelity, robust race-guarded search, correct blocked-user (Apple 1.2) filtering, and graceful data-layer degradation. However, the social profile/palace cards carry six confirmed P1 defects concentrated in ProfileCard.tsx — most importantly a Follow CTA that misspends ceremonial GOLD instead of canon EMBER, renders live for signed-out visitors yet silently no-ops server-side, has no error handling on its mutation, and falls under the 2.75rem touch-target minimum. None of these are launch-blocking data-loss or crash bugs (no P0), but the Follow control is the single most prominent action on the highest-traffic (logged-out) Explore audience and is currently a confusing dead/off-canon control. Ship the main page as-is; the cards need a focused fix pass before this area is fully done.

p1.title: Follow-button CTA painted GOLD instead of canon EMBER interactive color
p1.detail: The primary interactive CTA on ProfileCard (the Follow button, lines 150-174) uses a gold-to-goldDark gradient. Canon codifies EMBER #B85C38 as the interactive/active color and explicitly states 'Never spend gold on a generic button.' Gold is reserved for palace seals and focus rings. This is the single most prominent action on the Explore profile surface and it is off-canon. The 'Following' outline state also bases its border on sandstone rather than a canon hairline/ember.
p1.recommendation: Repaint the active Follow CTA with EMBER (gradient from #B85C38 to a darker ember), reserving GOLD strictly for focus rings/seals. Keep the outline 'Following' state but base its border on HAIRLINE #E3D6BC / EMBER rather than sandstone.

p1.title: Category chip spends GOLD on a generic filter/tag
p1.detail: PalaceCard's category badge (lines 121-133) uses a translucent gold background (`${T.color.gold}15`) and goldDark text. Canon is explicit: 'Never spend gold on a generic button, filter, divider or accent.' A category tag is exactly a generic accent and should not carry the ceremonial palace-gold.
p1.recommendation: Restyle the category chip with a neutral recessed tray (TRAY #F6EBE3 background, MUTED/INK text) or a subtle EMBER-glyph tint, freeing gold for palace-only usage.

p1.title: Follow button renders and silently no-ops for signed-out visitors
p1.detail: ProfileCard shows the Follow button whenever profile.is_own is false (line 149). On a public /u/[username] page a signed-out visitor gets is_own=false and is_following=false, so a fully interactive Follow button renders. Clicking calls toggleFollow, which returns { following: false } when there is no authenticated user (profile-actions.ts line 148: `if (!user || user.id === targetUserId) return { following: false }`). The UI then sets isFollowing=false and leaves followerCount unchanged — no sign-in prompt, no error, no visible effect. The control looks functional but does nothing, a confusing dead control for the largest audience of an Explore/profile surface (logged-out browsers).
p1.recommendation: Gate the button on authentication: pass an isAuthenticated prop (ProfilePageClient already has it) and for signed-out viewers either hide the button or route to sign-in on click (router.push('/login?next=/u/'+username)). Do not render a live Follow control that server-side no-ops for anonymous users.

p1.title: handleFollow has no error handling — rejected mutation leaves UI silently stale
p1.detail: The follow handler (lines 28-36) awaits toggleFollow inside startTransition with no try/catch. toggleFollow performs network Supabase calls (select/insert/delete) and can reject on transient errors; a rejection makes the async transition callback throw, so setIsFollowing/setFollowerCount/onFollowChange/track are never reached and the user gets no feedback. Because the code is pessimistic (updates only after the await resolves), a failed toggle silently does nothing — the user taps Follow, nothing happens, and there is no retry or error surface.
p1.recommendation: Wrap the await in try/catch; on failure surface a toast/inline error and do not leave the button in a wait state. Consider optimistic update + rollback in catch so a network blip is recoverable rather than silently swallowed.

p1.title: Follow button falls below the 2.75rem touch-target minimum
p1.detail: The Follow/Following toggle uses padding '0.5rem 1.25rem' with fontSize 0.8125rem and no minHeight/minWidth (lines 157-158). Rendered height is roughly 0.8125rem*~1.2 line + 1rem vertical padding ≈ 2rem — under the 2.75rem canon minimum for touch targets. On mobile/portrait this is a hard-to-tap primary action, and it sits in a wrapping flex row next to the avatar and SafetyMenu.
p1.recommendation: Add minHeight: '2.75rem' (and ideally minWidth: '2.75rem') to the follow button style, matching the SafetyMenu buttons which already set minHeight: '2.75rem'.

p2plus.title: Card background + border use off-canon hex not in libraryTokens
p2plus.recommendation: Promote these to libraryTokens (a shared CARD_BG/CARD_BORDER exported from the file the Atrium cards use) or replace CARD_BORDER with HAIRLINE (#E3D6BC). If the warm gradient is intentional, name it in libraryTokens so sibling surfaces reuse the identical value.

p2plus.title: Three different border grays on one surface (warmStone vs HAIRLINE vs CARD_BORDER)
p2plus.recommendation: Standardise resting borders on HAIRLINE across pills, quiet buttons and cards so the whole surface shares one hairline value; reserve warmStone (if kept) for a deliberately heavier control.

p2plus.title: Search input has no visible GOLD focus ring — inconsistent with rest of surface
p2plus.recommendation: Add the input to the .explore-*:focus-visible GOLD outline rule (or wrap the field so the container shows the gold ring on focus-within) so the search field matches the surface's focus canon.

p2plus.title: Empty single rail shows generic 'nothing here' even when other rails are full
p2plus.recommendation: Add a rail-specific empty message (t('exploreFeaturedEmpty') / t('exploreNewEmpty')) for the featured/new branches, mirroring the following branch, so an empty curated rail reads as 'nothing featured yet' rather than the whole-directory-empty copy.

p2plus.title: Hardcoded English aria-label on logo link
p2plus.recommendation: Replace with a translated key (aria-label={t('exploreHomeLink')}) or reuse an existing brand/home key present in all five locale files (en/nl/de/es/fr).

p2plus.title: Category label renders untranslated raw DB slug
p2plus.recommendation: Add category_* keys for every known category to the social namespace in all five locale files, or map slugs to human labels via a translated lookup. Until then, format the slug (title-case, replace underscores) rather than showing the raw DB value.

p2plus.title: Cool black shadows and translucent-white card surface instead of warm-ink/cream canon
p2plus.recommendation: Either move these Explore cards onto a canon surface (CREAM bg, HAIRLINE 1px border, SHADOW ramp rgba(64,59,54,x)) or update the shared TuscanCard glass/elevated variants to warm-ink shadows and a cream base.

p2plus.title: No visible GOLD focus ring on interactive card elements
p2plus.recommendation: Add a :focus-visible style using the canon focusRing (outline 0.1875rem solid GOLD, outlineOffset 0.1875rem) to the Follow button and the PalaceCard clickable div. This is the one legitimate use of gold on these surfaces.

p2plus.title: Bio secondary text uses walnut #8B7355 rather than canon muted
p2plus.recommendation: Render bio text in canon MUTED #716A5E (or INK for full-strength prose) so bio, username, and stats share one secondary voice.

p2plus.title: PalaceCard.tsx is dead code — never imported or wired
p2plus.recommendation: Either delete this unused component or wire it into the Explore rails in place of the ad-hoc local PalaceCard, passing an onClick that router.push()es to the palace (using palace.first_wing_slug). As-is it is a maintenance trap that duplicates a diverged local implementation.

p2plus.title: Optimistic follower count can desync / go negative on spurious server response
p2plus.recommendation: Only mutate followerCount when the operation actually changed state. Have toggleFollow return a discriminated result ({ changed: boolean, following: boolean }) or the authoritative new count, and skip the +/-1 when changed is false.

p2plus.title: Neither card uses responsive hooks; layout is prop-driven only
p2plus.recommendation: Derive compact/spacing from useIsCompact()/useIsPortrait() so the card self-adapts on small screens instead of depending on the parent to pass compact, and verify the wrapped follow/menu layout in portrait.

p2plus.title: Follow toggle button lacks aria-pressed for its toggle state
p2plus.recommendation: Add aria-pressed={isFollowing} to the follow button so assistive tech announces the toggle state.

p2plus.title: PalaceCard avatar has no image semantics for screen readers
p2plus.recommendation: Give the avatar div role='img' and aria-label with the display name (as ProfileCard does), or mark it aria-hidden since the name is already announced.

p2plus.title: GOLD hairline spent on the generic register/keystone CTA
p2plus.recommendation: Drop the gold hairline (use HAIRLINE or no border) or, if a ceremonial edge is wanted, treat it as an intentional landing-keystone exception documented as such. Token-ise the #2E2A26 dark stop.

p2plus.title: Icon dimensions hardcoded in px instead of rem
p2plus.recommendation: Express icon size in rem (width='1.125rem') or set font-size on the SVG and size via em so glyphs track the rem/type scale like the rest of the board.

p2plus.title: Bespoke focus/search shadow values sit outside the SHADOW ramp
p2plus.recommendation: Reuse SHADOW[0]/SHADOW[1] (or add a named 'input' step to the ramp) so all elevation on the surface flows from one source.

p2plus.title: showAll not reset when clearing search or toggling search view
p2plus.recommendation: Add setShowAll(false) inside clearSearch (and optionally when entering the search-results view) to keep the mobile cap consistent.

p2plus.title: Debounced search timeout / in-flight transition not cancelled on unmount
p2plus.recommendation: Add a useEffect cleanup that clears debounceRef.current and increments searchSeq.current on unmount to cancel pending debounce/response.

p2plus.title: first_wing_slug fetched and enriched but never used by the card destination
p2plus.recommendation: Either wire first_wing_slug into a 'walk this palace' affordance on the card, or drop it from the DirectoryPalace payload used by Explore to avoid shipping unused per-row data.

p2plus.title: Pill rail uses group semantics without a shared active-state contract
p2plus.recommendation: If the pills are truly mutually exclusive, consider role='radiogroup' with role='radio'/aria-checked; otherwise keep aria-pressed but this is acceptable as-is.

p2plus.title: Search results count badge may double-announce with aria-live region
p2plus.recommendation: Optionally add aria-hidden to the decorative count badge since the aria-live region already announces the count, avoiding double-announcement.

p2plus.title: Avatar identity gradient/border built entirely from GOLD
p2plus.recommendation: Consider an EMBER/terracotta-based identity gradient with a HAIRLINE or ember ring, keeping at most a single restrained gold accent per card so gold stays meaningful.

p2plus.title: No dedicated empty/loading/error styling for absent avatar/data
p2plus.recommendation: Add a canon-styled skeleton (HAIRLINE/TRAY shimmer with reduced-motion guard) for loading, and ensure the initial/'?' fallback renders on image load error, on a calmer ember-tint circle rather than a gold gradient.

p2plus.title: Private-profile ProfileCard exposes a Follow button on a zeroed profile
p2plus.recommendation: For the private-profile limited-info branch, either suppress the Follow affordance (add an is_public/limited flag the card can read) or avoid rendering optimistic stats that are known-zeroed placeholders.

p2plus.title: Follow button transition ignores prefers-reduced-motion
p2plus.recommendation: Gate the transition on a reduced-motion check and disable it when reduced motion is requested; also avoid 'all' in favor of specific properties.

p2plus.title: Counts rendered without locale-aware number formatting
p2plus.recommendation: Format counts with Intl.NumberFormat(locale) (or a shared formatNumber helper) so grouping matches the active locale.

p2plus.title: No visible focus ring on the keyboard-focusable PalaceCard
p2plus.recommendation: Add onFocus/onBlur-driven inline outline (or a focus-visible style via TuscanCard) using GOLD #D4AF37 so keyboard focus is visibly indicated.

strengths: Strong overall canon fidelity on the main page: CREAM bg, INK/MUTED text, EMBER for interactive (card top-border, visit affordance, active pills), EMBER_GLYPH for at-rest lane dots/overlines, and GOLD used correctly and only once — the featured star seal — with a comment citing it as 'the one legitimate ceremonial gold'.

Typography follows canon precisely: Fraunces (display) for h1/card names/empty-state, Source Sans (body) for all body/meta, with a coherent rem type scale (2.25/1.75rem h1, 1.0625rem titles, 0.6875rem uppercase overlines matching RT.overline).
LaneHeader faithfully reproduces the Atrium canon (ember-glyph dot + 0.12em uppercase overline + fading HAIRLINE rule), giving strong visual consistency with sibling surfaces.

Disciplined rem usage across layout/spacing/radii; px correctly limited to hairlines and the idiomatic 1px sr-only clip. Main-page touch targets consistently >=2.75rem and inputs at fontSize 1rem to avoid iOS zoom.
Motion is a single well-guarded voice: one board-rise entrance, CSS-only hover lift matching tokens, hover gated behind (hover:hover) and a thorough prefers-reduced-motion reset.
Empty/loading/error states are all styled on-canon (TRAY-filled compass medallion, Fraunces headline + muted hint, ember spinner, error alert) rather than raw browser defaults.

Search is robustly race-guarded: a monotonic searchSeq ref ensures only the latest response lands, sub-2-char input short-circuits and cancels in-flight results, and errors set a distinct searchError state with role='alert'.

Blocked-user (Apple 1.2) filtering is correctly applied in every path: hoisted once per request in page.tsx for rails/following, and re-applied server-side via excludeBlocked inside searchPalaces, with a no-op for signed-out viewers.

Graceful degradation throughout the data layer: RPC-missing fallbacks (explore_trending_owners / explore_visit_counts) fall back to bounded scans, and getExploreRails/getFollowingPalaces degrade to empty rails on preview deploys lacking a service-role key instead of hitting the error boundary.

Coherent rails/search/expand state machine: pill toggle resets showAll, active pill re-tap clears the filter, and the merged/deduped grid (featured>trending>newest, recency-weighted) with per-request blocked filtering keeps card keys unique.

Image and status states handled: avatar has onError fallback to an initial-letter tile, isPending drives a spinner, aria-busy/aria-live report search status, and every user-facing string on the main page routes through useTranslation with verified en.json keys.
Search input sets fontSize: 1rem explicitly (WebKit's no-auto-zoom threshold on iOS Safari) with an inline comment, preventing iOS focus zoom.

areas.summary: The "Me" area is visually strong and canon-faithful (imported palette, correct EMBER/GOLD discipline, Fraunces/Source Sans voice, rem-based rhythm, iOS free-tier seal, robust server code), but it is not production-ready: 10 confirmed P1 defects span all three surfaces. Two are functional/reliability risks — AchievementsPanel is lazy() without a Suspense boundary (first open can crash to a blank), and StatisticsPanel shows a fabricated "night owl, peak at 0:00" personality insight to brand-new zero-memory users. The rest are accessibility and touch-target gaps (uncannounced toasts, invisible charts, sub-44px controls, a dialog overlay with no focus management) plus one off-canon pure-white Doors card and orphaned dead-code toast. No P0 defects were confirmed, but the P1 cluster — especially the Suspense crash and the misleading empty-state — must be fixed before ship.

p1.title: AchievementsPanel is lazy() but rendered without a Suspense boundary — first open can crash/blank
p1.detail: AchievementsPanel is declared via React.lazy() (line 37). Every sibling lazy panel (MemoryTimeline, StatisticsPanel, FamilyTreePanel, PublishModal) is wrapped in <Suspense fallback={lazyFallback}>, but AchievementsPanel is rendered bare at lines 1121 and 1536 ({showAchievements&&<AchievementsPanel .../>}). MemoryPalace is loaded via next/dynamic(ssr:false), whose loading fallback covers only the dynamic chunk, not nested React.lazy children, and there is no ancestor <Suspense>. On first open (before the chunk is cached) React.lazy suspends with no boundary, throwing a synchronous-suspend error / bubbling to an error boundary and showing a blank/crashed panel. Repeat opens work only because the chunk is already cached.
p1.recommendation: Wrap both render sites in the peers' boundary: {showAchievements&&<Suspense fallback={lazyFallback}><AchievementsPanel onClose={()=>setShowAchievements(false)} highlightId={achHighlightId}/></Suspense>} at lines 1121 and 1536.

p1.title: No empty-state: a zero-memory user sees a fabricated 'night owl, peak at 0:00' personality insight
p1.detail: There is no top-level empty-state guard. peakHour = hourCounts.indexOf(Math.max(...hourCounts)) returns 0 for an all-zero array, so timeOfDay resolves to 'nightOwl' and the always-rendered Personality hero card (section 3) plus peakCreativityDesc ('You tend to create around 0:00') are shown to a brand-new user who has created nothing. The weekday heatmap also renders all-zero. This is a misleading, embarrassing first impression.
p1.recommendation: Add an early empty-state branch when stats.totalMems === 0 (a friendly 'no memories yet' message), and/or gate the Personality hero card and heatmap behind stats.totalMems > 0 the same way sections 5/6/8 are already gated.

p1.title: Doors card uses pure white (#FFFFFF), off the warm CREAM/TRAY canon
p1.detail: The Band-4 settings-doors container is filled with pure white, which reads cold against the surrounding CREAM (#FCFAF5) page and breaks the warm-sandstone material grammar. Canon lifted/recessed surfaces are CREAM, TRAY (#F6EBE3), or linen — never a clinical white. It is the single most visible off-canon note on an otherwise faithful surface, and it makes the HAIRLINE (#E3D6BC) borders read grey rather than gilt.
p1.recommendation: Swap to a warm surface: either CREAM with the SHADOW[1]+TOP_HIGHLIGHT lift already applied, or a linen/white-cream like the Atrium tray. If a lifted white is intended, use a warm off-white (e.g. #FFFDFA) so it stays in the warm-ink family; import from libraryTokens rather than hardcoding.

p1.title: Per-card Share button is a 28px touch target — below the 2.75rem minimum
p1.detail: The share button on every earned achievement card is 1.75rem (28px) square, well under the 2.75rem (44px) touch-target floor, and it sits on the far edge of a dense card grid, so on phones/iPad it is hard to tap accurately without hitting the card body.
p1.recommendation: Grow the button to >=2.75rem square (or keep a 1.75rem visual with a 2.75rem hit area via padding/negative margin, or a ::before overlay). On touch (useTouchControls()) bump the size unconditionally.

p1.title: Toast ('Copied to clipboard') is not announced to screen readers
p1.detail: The share flow surfaces feedback only via a visual toast <div>. There is no aria-live / role=status region anywhere in the panel (confirmed by grep). A VoiceOver/TalkBack user who taps Share and falls back to clipboard copy gets no confirmation that anything happened.
p1.recommendation: Add role="status" aria-live="polite" to the toast container (or a dedicated persistent live region) so clipboard/share feedback is announced.

p1.title: Weekly-digest 'sent' toast is unreachable dead code after the read-only refactor
p1.detail: showToast state and its toast block render the i18n string weeklyDigestSent ('Weekly digest sent to your email'), but setShowToast is never called anywhere in the file, and the digest button only opens an in-app overlay (setShowDigest(true)) — nothing is emailed. The feature was refactored from an email-send action to a read-only overlay, orphaning the toast, the showToast/setShowToast state, and the 'sent to your email' copy. The user can never see this toast, and the retained copy implies a send that no longer happens.
p1.recommendation: Remove the dead showToast state and its toast JSX block, or re-wire an actual send action + setShowToast(true) if email digests are still intended. If purely read-only, also drop/retitle the weeklyDigestSent i18n string so no orphaned 'sent to your email' copy remains.

p1.title: Statistics header close button is below the 2.75rem touch-target minimum
p1.detail: The primary dismiss control (the ✕ button in the sticky header) is only 2rem x 2rem (32px). Canon requires touch targets >= 2.75rem (44px). On phones and iPad this is a small, easy-to-miss tap target for the main way to close the panel.
p1.recommendation: Bump width/height to at least 2.75rem (or keep visual size but expand the hit area with padding / a larger transparent box), and adjust borderRadius accordingly. Consider useIsMobile() to enforce >=2.75rem on touch.

p1.title: Weekly-digest overlay has no dialog semantics or focus management
p1.detail: When showDigest is true a full-screen overlay renders (position:fixed, inset:0, zIndex:810) with its own back button and content, but it is a plain <div> with no role="dialog", no aria-modal, no aria-label, and no focus trap. Focus stays trapped in the underlying stats dialog's useFocusTrap, so keyboard/screen-reader users can tab into the now-hidden background panel behind the digest. Escape is handled only via an onKeyDown on the div (line 441), which won't fire unless the div itself is focused.
p1.recommendation: Give the digest overlay role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={t("weeklyDigestTitle")}, run its own useFocusTrap (or move focus to the back button on open), and attach the Escape handler at a reliably-focused element.

p1.title: Data-bearing charts (donut, weekday heatmap, month bars) are invisible to screen readers
p1.detail: The core statistical visualizations convey information purely visually. The donut <svg> has no role="img"/aria-label summarizing the type breakdown; the weekday heatmap cells are non-semantic <div>s where the count text is conditionally hidden (count>0) so an empty day announces nothing; the monthly bars render count as bar width with the label read out only visually. A screen-reader user gets little from this panel.
p1.recommendation: Add role="img" + an aria-label with a text summary to each chart svg/container (e.g. 'Photo 40%, Text 35%...'), and give each weekday/month row an aria-label with day name + count so the data is announced even when the visual number is hidden.

p2plus.title: Panel background gradient ends in warmStone, greyer than canon CREAM and out of step with siblings
p2plus.recommendation: Re-anchor the gradient on the warm ladder used by siblings — e.g. linear-gradient(160deg, #F2EDE4 0%, #FCFAF5 78%) (linen → cream) so the panel lands on canon CREAM, matching StatisticsPanel.

p2plus.title: Share-toast detection duplicates share.ts branch logic and misfires on user-cancel
p2plus.recommendation: Have shareAchievement() return a discriminated result ({ok, method:'native'|'web'|'clipboard'}) and drive the toast off method==='clipboard' instead of re-deriving the branch in the caller.

p2plus.title: Unlocked date rendered as raw ISO YYYY-MM-DD, not localized
p2plus.recommendation: Format with new Date(earnedDate).toLocaleDateString(locale, {year:'numeric',month:'long',day:'numeric'}) (guarding invalid dates), using the active i18n locale.

p2plus.title: No iPad / compact handling — only useIsMobile() (max 767px) is consulted
p2plus.recommendation: Consult useIsCompact()/useIsTablet() to enlarge padding and touch targets on iPad, and consider a single-column grid on compact so 16.25rem min columns don't crowd.

p2plus.title: Animations lack reduced-motion guards
p2plus.recommendation: Gate animations/behavior:'smooth' behind a prefers-reduced-motion check (matchMedia or useReducedMotion); fall back to no animation and behavior:'auto'.

p2plus.title: Close button is a 36px touch target — under the 2.75rem floor
p2plus.recommendation: Increase to >=2.75rem square, at least when useTouchControls() is true.

p2plus.title: Backdrop scrim uses an off-canon umber rgba, not warm-ink
p2plus.recommendation: Change the scrim to the warm-ink base, e.g. rgba(64,59,54,0.45) (or a documented Atrium scrim token), so the panel dims the app in the same warm ink as its own shadows.

p2plus.title: Primary CTA (Weekly Digest) never spends EMBER for its interactive accent
p2plus.recommendation: Give the CTA an EMBER (#B85C38) signal (EMBER text or an EMBER left/hover treatment) so the interactive control is visibly distinct from at-rest accent labels, per THE ONE RULE.

p2plus.title: SAGE value diverges from the theme token (#56683C vs T.color.sage #4A6741)
p2plus.recommendation: Import SAGE (and INK/MUTED/HAIRLINE/CREAM/EMBER) from src/lib/libraryTokens.ts instead of retyping hex, so the panel and siblings can never drift.

p2plus.title: Stats close button below 2.75rem and uses an off-token fill
p2plus.recommendation: Bump the hit area to >=2.75rem (glyph can stay small via padding) and use a canon surface (CREAM card or TRAY) with a HAIRLINE border to match sibling controls.

p2plus.title: No dedicated empty/zero-memory state — charts render hollow instead of an invitation
p2plus.recommendation: Add a canon-styled empty state (Fraunces heading + muted body + optional CTA) when stats.totalMems === 0 instead of rendering a hollow donut and orphaned overview zeros.

p2plus.title: stats useMemo can go stale on wing/room customization (Zustand selector fns are stable refs)
p2plus.recommendation: Subscribe to underlying state slices (customWings/extraWings/customRooms) rather than the methods so the memo's deps change when wing/room config changes.

p2plus.title: Weekly-digest CTA button height borderline under 2.75rem
p2plus.recommendation: Set minHeight:'2.75rem' (and adequate horizontal hit area) on both the digest CTA and back button, or increase vertical padding.

p2plus.title: No iPad/compact or portrait handling — only a single mobile breakpoint
p2plus.recommendation: Use useIsCompact() (<=1024px) for grid density (2-col overview on iPad portrait) and useIsTablet() to bump padding/touch-target sizing.

p2plus.title: Canon colors hardcoded as hex/rgba instead of imported tokens
p2plus.recommendation: Reference tokens: gradient from ${EMBER},${EMBER_GLYPH}; focus outline from GOLD/focusRing; derive hover tints from EMBER_GLYPH. Import GOLD from libraryTokens for the focus ring.

p2plus.title: Door/chevron icons sized in raw px rather than rem
p2plus.recommendation: Express icon box in rem (e.g. 1.125rem) so glyphs scale with the type ramp; keep the internal viewBox at 24 for crisp geometry.

p2plus.title: 'Visitors' stat counts total visit rows, not unique visitors
p2plus.recommendation: Count DISTINCT visitor_id (RPC/view like explore_visit_counts, or GROUP BY visitor_id) so 'Visitors' reflects unique people; or relabel to 'Visits' if the total-events number is intended.

p2plus.title: Stat labels can overflow / force horizontal scroll on narrow phones (long localized words)
p2plus.recommendation: Add textAlign:'center' and either whiteSpace:'nowrap' with a smaller fontSize via useIsSmall(), or overflowWrap:'anywhere' with a shared min-width per stat. Verify at 320px in de/es.

p2plus.title: Locked-icon tint reintroduces alpha (sandstone22) despite the file's own 'pre-mixed opaque surfaces' rule
p2plus.recommendation: Replace ${T.color.sandstone}22 with a pre-mixed opaque tint (#EBE3D4 / T.color.lineFaint or a resolved hex) so the locked well matches the opaque discipline.

p2plus.title: Earned-date meta shares the exact size of the description, flattening card hierarchy
p2plus.recommendation: Drop the date to a smaller overline/micro size (0.6875–0.75rem), optionally letter-spaced, so it reads as quiet metadata.

p2plus.title: Header trophy medallion and card icon wells use slightly different gold-lane tints/opacities
p2plus.recommendation: Give the header trophy medallion more presence (stronger tint or SHADOW.1 plus a hairline ring) for a clear focal hierarchy, or document the intentional flatness.

p2plus.title: scrollIntoView highlight can fire before lazy content/layout is ready
p2plus.recommendation: Defer the scroll with requestAnimationFrame (or a small timeout tied to the open animation) and honor prefers-reduced-motion with behavior:'auto'.

p2plus.title: handleShare has no error/failure feedback when clipboard write fails
p2plus.recommendation: Add an else if (!ok) onShareToast(t('shareFailed')) branch (new i18n key) so a failed share surfaces a message.

p2plus.title: Category grid uses a role=list/listitem tree but cards are non-interactive containers
p2plus.recommendation: Wrap category overlines in role="heading" aria-level or an h-tag, and link each role=list to its heading via aria-labelledby.

p2plus.title: Fullscreen mobile panel uses safe-area-inset but not landscape-specific insets for the toast
p2plus.recommendation: Use bottom: max(2rem, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) for the toast to keep it clear of the home indicator in landscape.

p2plus.title: EMBER used as a static (non-interactive) timeline bar gradient
p2plus.recommendation: Use an accent-glyph-only gradient (e.g. #9A4F2A into a lighter terracotta) for passive data bars, keeping EMBER for genuinely interactive elements.
