p2plus.title: 'text' memory-type swatch is pure INK, reading as a gap rather than a data color
p2plus.recommendation: Give 'text' a distinct warm data hue (walnut/parchment) reserved for charts so no data segment collides with body-ink.

p2plus.title: Panel base is LINEN while canon names CREAM as the background token
p2plus.recommendation: No change if linen-recessed is the documented Atrium base; otherwise standardize the shell on CREAM with tray/linen only for recessed sub-surfaces.

p2plus.title: digestLoading is permanently false — its disabled/loading UI branches are unreachable dead code
p2plus.recommendation: Remove digestLoading and simplify the button to its always-enabled form, or restore a real loading state if async work returns.

p2plus.title: expandedSection / setExpandedSection state is declared but never read
p2plus.recommendation: Delete the unused expandedSection state to avoid confusion and dead code.

p2plus.title: Two content sections both labelled '7.' in comments (numbering regression)
p2plus.recommendation: Renumber the trailing Weekly Digest comment (e.g. to 9) so section comments are unique and ordered.

p2plus.title: Weekday abbreviation via .slice(0,2) on translated day names is fragile
p2plus.recommendation: Add explicit dayShort_* keys per locale (or use Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale,{weekday:'short'})) instead of .slice(0,2).

p2plus.title: Layout animations depend on a @media reduced-motion rule rather than a JS guard
p2plus.recommendation: Optionally gate entrance animations with a shared usePrefersReducedMotion() hook so suppression doesn't rely solely on the injected @media block.

p2plus.title: Type sizes hardcoded rather than drawn from the RT ramp
p2plus.recommendation: Import RT from libraryTokens and reference RT.titleL / RT.overline / RT.meta / RT.body so the ramp stays the single source of truth.

p2plus.title: Empty/no-avatar fallback initial can render '?'
p2plus.recommendation: For the truly-empty case, prefer a canon glyph (small keeper/person mark or palace seal) over a literal '?', matching the 'Your palace' name fallback beside it.

p2plus.title: Sign-out row visually indistinct from settings doors despite a different action class
p2plus.recommendation: Add a heavier separator or a small gap/TRAY break before the sign-out row, or give it its own grouping, so the terminal action is set apart from navigational doors.

p2plus.title: Visitors silently degrades to 0 on deploys without the service-role key
p2plus.recommendation: Fine on production (admin client bypasses RLS). Optionally log when the visitors query errors, and confirm the service-role key is present on prod so the stat is real rather than a masked 0.

p2plus.title: Public-profile CTA can point at /u/[username] that 404s for public-but-unpublished profiles
p2plus.recommendation: Confirm /u/[username] renders for any is_public profile with a username; if it also requires published content, tighten hasPublicPage to match (or have the public page render a graceful empty state).

p2plus.title: Stat values not locale-formatted (thousands separators)
p2plus.recommendation: Format with new Intl.NumberFormat(locale).format(s.value) so grouping matches nl/de/es/fr conventions.

p2plus.title: Identity portrait + name fully hidden from assistive tech
p2plus.recommendation: Acceptable as decorative given the adjacent h1, but consider a localized alt (t('meAvatarAlt') with display name) and removing aria-hidden on the wrapper.

strengths: Faithful canon palette overall: INK/MUTED/EMBER/EMBER_GLYPH/HAIRLINE/CREAM are imported and used correctly, with no leftover dark bronze-glass or renaissance-era surfaces.
EMBER and GOLD are spent correctly per THE ONE RULE: EMBER on the primary 'Edit profile' CTA and interactive hover/active tints, GOLD reserved solely for the focus-visible ring.
Typography is consistently Fraunces (display) for name/stats hero and Source Sans (body) for labels, matching the sibling Atrium/Library voice.
Spacing and rhythm are cleanly rem-based with a coherent 5-band Instagram/Airbnb anatomy and a canon overline lane header.

Responsiveness follows canon: inline styles driven by useIsMobile/useIsCompact with safe-area padding, no layout @media queries; the only <style> block is correctly scoped to hover/reduced-motion pseudo-states.
Touch targets on the identity page meet the 2.75rem minimum (stats, actions 2.75rem, doors 3rem), and reduced-motion guards wrap the entrance animation.
Warm-ink shadow grammar via SHADOW[1] + TOP_HIGHLIGHT on the doors card, with a graceful 2-line bio clamp + 150-char truncation.

Server component is defensively coded: unauthenticated users redirect to /login, profile uses .single() with p?. optional chaining, all counts use ?? 0, and Supabase query builders resolve rather than reject so Promise.all can't break on one failed query.
iOS free-tier seal is correct and flash-free: server-side isNativeIOS drives the initial render so the Subscription door is absent from first paint on iOS, with client isIOS() as a second guard.
All wired routes are real: every settings door href, both CTAs, and both nav handlers resolve to existing pages.
Sign-out is robust: re-entrancy guard, single-shot navigation, 8s hang-guard, server revoke + local signOut + stale per-user localStorage cleanup.
i18n is complete and namespace-correct: every user-facing string routes through useTranslation with a tf() English fallback, and all keys exist in the section they are read from.

areas.summary: The Tutorial area is not production-ready: it carries two P0 functional defects (the entire TutorialOverlay is commented out and never renders, and the MobileBottomBar "tour" item is a wired-looking dead control) plus a systemic canon-design failure where every tutorial surface — overlay, all four 3D tours, and the Settings/Help tutorials — still renders as legacy dark bronze-glass with off-token gold instead of the CREAM/INK/EMBER canon. Compounding this, three P0/P1 iOS-subscription gating findings show the two live settings shells and the tutorial bullet list disagree about whether iOS users can reach subscription management post-IAP-merge. The underlying state machine, rem discipline, typography tokens, and touch targets are genuinely solid, so the remediation is largely a canon reskin plus deleting or re-wiring the orphaned overlay/spirit code — but until the P0s are resolved the surface is both partly invisible and visually foreign to the rest of the app.

p0.title: Entire TutorialOverlay is commented out / never rendered in production
p0.detail: In MemoryPalace.tsx the only render site of the overlay is disabled: line 1435 `{/* <TutorialOverlay /> */}` with the comment 'Old tutorial overlay — disabled, replaced by NudgeTooltip system'. The auto-start effect is also commented (lines 952-953). Nothing else in the codebase renders <TutorialOverlay/>. So the whole component — its typewriter, progress bar, step dots, skip/next controls, and highlight rings — is dead: tutorialStore can flip active=true but no UI ever appears. Leftover from the overhaul that swapped the tour system to NudgeTooltip + the mp:open-palace-tutorial event.
p0.recommendation: If NudgeTooltip is the intended replacement, delete TutorialOverlay.tsx, tutorialStore.ts, the now-dead useTutorialStore reads (lines 319-321), and the MobileBottomBar launcher to prevent a live-but-invisible tutorial. If the overlay is still wanted, re-enable the render and wire the auto-start/event listener to it.

p0.title: MobileBottomBar 'tour' menu item is a dead control (starts an overlay that never renders)
p0.detail: MobileBottomBar.tsx line 129 pushes a settings item labelled tAction('tour') whose action calls useTutorialStore.getState().start(). start() sets active=true and stepIndex=0, but because <TutorialOverlay/> is commented out, tapping this item produces no visible effect — a fully wired-looking control that does nothing. By contrast NavigationBar's 'startTutorial' buttons correctly dispatch the mp:open-palace-tutorial event to the new tour system.
p0.recommendation: Change the mobile 'tour' action to dispatch window.dispatchEvent(new Event('mp:open-palace-tutorial')) (matching NavigationBar) so mobile users get the actual tour instead of a no-op.

p0.title: Dark bronze-glass tutorial cards are entirely off-canon (should be CREAM/INK)
p0.detail: All four 3D tutorials render their tooltip/card on a dark bronze glass surface: cardBg = rgba(42,34,24,0.92) (RoomTutorial 0.94) with body text at rgba(250,250,247,0.88) and a gold-tinted border. Canon calls for CREAM #FCFAF5 backgrounds with INK #403B36 text and HAIRLINE #E3D6BC borders. This is exactly the leftover dark bronze-glass the reskin was meant to eliminate; it looks visually foreign next to the reskinned Library/Atrium surfaces the user tours right after.
p0.recommendation: Reskin the card to a light canon surface: background CREAM #FCFAF5 (or TRAY #F6EBE3), body text INK #403B36 / secondary MUTED #716A5E, border 1px solid HAIRLINE #E3D6BC. Apply identically to all four files so they match the Library/Atrium reskin.

p0.title: GOLD is misused as the primary text/accent voice throughout the tutorial
p0.detail: Both step titles, the pulse ring, and the card border are all gold/goldLight. The canon rule (libraryTokens.ts lines 8-12) is explicit: GOLD is palace-only (wing seals, focus rings), 'Never spend gold on a generic button, filter, divider or accent.' Here gold is the headline color and the highlight ring — a generic accent — which cheapens the ceremonial token and diverges from EMBER-as-interactive.
p0.recommendation: Set titles to INK #403B36 (or EMBER_GLYPH #9A4F2A for accent), make the highlight ring/pulse EMBER #B85C38 (interactive), and reserve GOLD only if you truly want a ceremonial focus ring — not for body headings.

p0.title: SettingsTutorial is entirely off-canon dark bronze-glass, clashing with the CREAM app
p0.detail: The whole tutorial overlay renders as a dark, gold-tinted bronze-glass card — the exact legacy dark aesthetic the rest of the app (and the sibling /help page) was migrated away from. Canon is a CREAM #FCFAF5 canvas with INK #403B36 text and HAIRLINE #E3D6BC borders. A user opening Help from Settings sees a jarring dark tooltip floating over the light settings UI.
p0.recommendation: Re-skin the tutorial cards to canon: cardBg = CREAM/TRAY (#FCFAF5 or #F6EBE3), border 1px HAIRLINE #E3D6BC, warm-ink shadow from the SHADOW ramp, INK text. Mirror the /help C.* remap so the two Help surfaces read as one system.

p1.title: Off-canon dark bronze-glass panel in TutorialOverlay (leftover dark theme, not CREAM/INK)
p1.detail: The speech bubble uses a dark bronze translucent panel rather than the canon light surface (CREAM #FCFAF5 / INK #403B36). It renders over the dark 3D scene so a tint is contextually defensible, but the specific value is a raw off-token bronze with no relation to any theme constant, reading as a different design era from canon overlays (OnboardingWizard, panels) and from its own light TourButton trigger.
p1.recommendation: Move to the canon scrim grammar: a CREAM/linen glass panel with INK text (as sibling reskinned overlays use), or at minimum derive the tint from a theme token (e.g. T.color.charcoal / T.land.dark) so it is not a floating magic hex. Match the visual era of the light TourButton that launches it.

p1.title: Local off-canon gold hex constants instead of canon GOLD tokens
p1.detail: Three bespoke gold hexes are declared at module scope and used for title text, spirit indicator, progress gradient, dots, and next-button ink. None correspond to canon GOLD #D4AF37 / GOLD_SOFT #C99A2E. GOLD_GLOW/#FFEEBB and GOLD_WARM/#FFD080 are near-white pastels that drift warm-yellow, diverging from the palace gold used everywhere else.
p1.recommendation: Replace the DOM/text uses with canon tokens: title/label text and progress bar in T.color.gold (#D4AF37) with T.color.goldDark for gradient depth; drop the #FFEEBB/#FFD080 pastels for chrome. Keep bespoke bright hexes only inside TutorialSpirit's additive-blended 3D materials where an emissive glow is intentional.

p1.title: TutorialSpirit (createSpirit) is entirely orphaned dead code
p1.detail: TutorialSpirit.tsx exports createSpirit()/SpiritHandle to inject a glowing orb into a Three.js scene, but a repo-wide search shows no import or call of createSpirit/SpiritHandle/TutorialSpirit anywhere. The tutorialStore carries a spiritPos field per step, TUTORIAL_STEPS never sets it, and TutorialOverlay never reads it — the spirit was designed to be driven by the overlay that is itself disabled. It also has no dispose() for its geometries/materials, so if mounted it would leak GPU resources.
p1.recommendation: Delete TutorialSpirit.tsx along with the overlay, or if kept, add a dispose() (dispose geometries/materials, remove from scene) and wire it via SpiritHandle.setTarget from the step spiritPos.

p1.title: GOLD spent on ordinary titles, step dots and bullets (violates palace-only rule)
p1.detail: Titles are colored goldLight (#C9A84C), active step dots are a gold gradient, past dots are ${T.color.gold}80, and RoomTutorial's bullet diamonds use T.color.gold. libraryTokens states GOLD is ceremonial/palace-only (wing seals, focus rings) and must never be spent on a generic button, divider or accent. Tutorial chrome is generic UI, so gold here dilutes the ceremonial signal.
p1.recommendation: Recolor titles to INK #403B36 in Fraunces, step dots/progress to EMBER (#B85C38 active, HAIRLINE inactive), and bullets to EMBER_GLYPH #9A4F2A. Reserve gold only for the pulsing highlight ring if a ceremonial focus cue is desired.

p1.title: Highlight ring & pulse hardcode gold rgba, not canon focus token
p1.detail: The spotlight ring is border: 2px solid ${goldLight}70 with @keyframes pulse using rgba(212,175,55,0.4). Canon provides focusRing = 0.1875rem solid GOLD as the single focus grammar, and other rgba values (0,0,0,0.45 scrim, 0.3 shadow) are cold black rather than the warm-ink rgba(64,59,54,x) shadow grammar the app uses.
p1.recommendation: Drive the ring from canon GOLD #D4AF37 (a legitimate ceremonial focus use) and switch the card scrim/shadow to warm-ink: scrim rgba(64,59,54,0.45), shadow SHADOW[2] = 0 0.5rem 1.5rem rgba(64,59,54,0.14).

p1.title: Cold-black shadows and scrims instead of warm-ink grammar
p1.detail: cardShadow = 0 0.5rem 2rem rgba(0,0,0,0.3) and the overlay scrim fill=rgba(0,0,0,0.45) (RoomTutorial 0.5) use pure black. The design canon shadow grammar is warm-ink rgba(64,59,54,x) with a fixed 3-step ramp (SHADOW/HOVER_SHADOW in libraryTokens). Pure-black shadows read colder and heavier than every sibling surface.
p1.recommendation: Replace card shadows with SHADOW[2] (rgba(64,59,54,0.14)) and tint scrims to warm ink, e.g. rgba(36,28,21,0.5), to match the umber/ink shadow language.

p1.title: Raw black shadows and black scrim instead of warm-ink canon values (Settings tutorial)
p1.detail: Shadows and overlay scrims use pure black rgba(0,0,0,...), but the canon shadow grammar is a single warm ink rgba(64,59,54,x) (SHADOW ramp) with warm-ink dimming. Pure-black shadows on a warm cream app look cold and generic and break visual consistency with Library/Atrium surfaces.
p1.recommendation: Swap shadows to the SHADOW ramp (e.g. 0 0.5rem 1.5rem rgba(64,59,54,0.14)) and the modal scrim to a warm-ink veil (e.g. rgba(64,59,54,0.45)) for consistency with sibling overlays.

p1.title: Tutorial Subscription bullet uses stale iOS-only gate, contradicting the IAP_ENABLED tab filter
p1.detail: SettingsTutorial drops the Subscription feature bullet whenever isIOS(), but the routed settings shell (settings/layout.tsx:149) now shows the Subscription tab on iOS when IAP is live via isIOS() && !IAP_ENABLED. Since IAP_ENABLED = true in production (src/lib/native/iap-flags.ts:8), an iOS user who sees a real Subscription tab is told about every tab EXCEPT Subscription in the 'Everything in your Me area' overview. The tutorial's own comment ('iOS is free-tier only (Apple 3.1.1) — drop the Subscription feature bullet') is out of date post-IAP-merge.
p1.recommendation: Import IAP_ENABLED and match the layout filter: !(isIOS() && !IAP_ENABLED && f.titleKey === 'feat_subscription_title') so the tutorial bullet list stays consistent with which tabs are actually visible.

p1.title: SettingsInline hides the Subscription tab on iOS even when IAP is live — inconsistent with settings/layout
p1.detail: The in-palace overlay shell filters nav items with item.hideInNative && isIOS() (no IAP_ENABLED check), so on iOS the Subscription tab is HIDDEN in SettingsInline. The routed page shell (settings/layout.tsx:149) uses isIOS() && !IAP_ENABLED, so it SHOWS the Subscription tab on iOS. The two live settings shells disagree about whether iOS users can reach subscription management, and the tutorial (mounted by both) can describe a tab that one shell hides. Looks like a regression from the IAP merge where only settings/layout.tsx was updated.
p1.recommendation: Align SettingsInline with settings/layout: !(item.hideInNative && isIOS() && !IAP_ENABLED). Then also fix the tutorial gate (previous finding) so all three surfaces agree.

p2plus.title: Cold black/white shadows and tracks instead of warm-ink rgba(64,59,54,x)
p2plus.recommendation: Swap rgba(0,0,0,x) shadows to warm-ink rgba(64,59,54,x) per the SHADOW ladder, and replace rgba(255,255,255,0.08)/0.12 track and inactive-dot fills with a warm low-alpha ink or hairline-derived tint.

p2plus.title: Animations have no reduced-motion guard
p2plus.recommendation: Gate the typewriter and keyframe animations behind a prefers-reduced-motion check (render full text instantly, drop pulse/blink) via a useReducedMotion hook or media query wrapper, matching guards used elsewhere.

p2plus.title: TourButton visually inconsistent with the overlay it launches
p2plus.recommendation: Unify the two: make the overlay light-canon to match the button, or restyle both from the same token set. Use warm-ink shadow and EMBER accent on the button's orb rather than the #FFEEBB/#FFD080 pastel gradient.

p2plus.title: Highlight label uses tiny pastel text with cold drop-shadow
p2plus.recommendation: Use T.color.gold (or EMBER) for the label, a warm-ink text shadow, and consider the canon overline treatment (uppercase/letter-spacing) for the small-caps voice at this size.

p2plus.title: TutorialSpirit orb colors are bespoke pastels (defensible but untokened)
p2plus.recommendation: Extract the spirit's emissive palette into shared named constants (SPIRIT_CORE/GLOW/HALO) reused by both files, and tie the warm hue to a documented gold-glow so orb and overlay chrome stay in sync if canon gold shifts.

p2plus.title: aria-label i18n key 'stepDot' is missing in all locales, so screen readers announce the literal 'stepDot'
p2plus.recommendation: Add a 'stepDot' key like 'Step {current} of {total}' to all five message files, and drop role='presentation' (or move the label onto the parent dot container with role='img') so the label is exposed.

p2plus.title: TourButton is an exported dead component (never mounted)
p2plus.recommendation: Remove TourButton, or if a re-usable tour launcher is desired, repoint its onClick to the mp:open-palace-tutorial event and mount it where needed.

p2plus.title: Typewriter effect re-runs on 'message' identity, risking restart on locale/re-render
p2plus.recommendation: Depend on [active, stepIndex] only and read message via a ref, or snapshot message at effect start, so a background messages update doesn't restart the animation.

p2plus.title: Step dots use role='presentation' together with an aria-label — the label is discarded
p2plus.recommendation: Remove aria-label from the presentational dots and instead give the progress bar container role='progressbar' with aria-valuenow/valuemin/valuemax/aria-valuetext, or add a visually-hidden aria-live='polite' line announcing 'Step X of N' once per step.

p2plus.title: Bubble layout only branches on useIsMobile — no useIsCompact/useIsTablet path for iPad portrait
p2plus.recommendation: Introduce useIsCompact()/useIsTablet() to raise the bottom offset (and possibly tighten width) on iPad portrait so the bubble clears the on-canvas controls the same way it does on phones.

p2plus.title: Navigation copy hardcodes both keyboard and touch instructions instead of adapting to the active modality
p2plus.recommendation: Split into modality-specific message keys and select via useTouchControls() so touch users see joystick/swipe wording and keyboard users see WASD wording.

p2plus.title: Progress bar conveys progress by color only, with no text alternative
p2plus.recommendation: Wrap the progress bar in role='progressbar' with aria-valuenow={stepIndex+1}, aria-valuemin={1}, aria-valuemax={TUTORIAL_STEPS.length} and an aria-valuetext localized string; this also makes the missing stepDot label redundant.

p2plus.title: Highlight cutout radius uses raw px and inline literals, breaking rem discipline
p2plus.recommendation: Express corner radii and paddings in rem (via remToPx) so the highlight and tooltip scale consistently with the token system.

p2plus.title: Title uses ad-hoc font sizes/weight instead of the RT type ramp
p2plus.recommendation: Reference the RT ramp (title = RT.titleS, body = RT.meta, footer = RT.overline) for a consistent typographic voice with Library/Atrium.

p2plus.title: Skip button falls below the 2.75rem touch target
p2plus.recommendation: Increase vertical padding (or add minHeight: T.touch = 2.75rem) on Skip and Next/Done so both meet the 44pt minimum touch target.

p2plus.title: Corridor mobile step-0 joystick fallback points at an exterior-only element
p2plus.recommendation: Drop the dead [data-mp-palace-bars] fallback in corridor context (it belongs to the exterior tour), or replace it with an anchor that actually renders in the corridor.

p2plus.title: Joystick visibility not forced for entrance/corridor tours (only room tour)
p2plus.recommendation: Include entranceTourOpen and corridorTourOpen in the force-visible clause: visible={roomTourOpen || entranceTourOpen || corridorTourOpen || (!selMem && ...)} so the highlighted joystick is present during those tours.

p2plus.title: Four exported auto-open hooks are dead code that duplicate (and diverge from) the live path
p2plus.recommendation: Delete the four unused hooks, or wire the URL-replay logic (the ?xTour=1 reset) into the MemoryPalace.tsx effects so the query-param replay actually works. Do not leave two divergent auto-open implementations.

p2plus.title: Dialogs declare aria-modal but have no Escape handler or focus management
p2plus.recommendation: Add a keydown listener for Escape that calls onClose, move focus to the primary button (Done/Next) on open, and restore focus on close. Apply to all four tutorials.

p2plus.title: Corridor/entrance/room highlight cutout intercepts clicks meant for the highlighted control
p2plus.recommendation: Consider punching pointer-events through the cutout (or advancing the step) when the user taps inside the highlighted rect, so the tour feels interactive rather than dismissive.

p2plus.title: No Escape-key handler to dismiss the modal
p2plus.recommendation: Add a useEffect keydown listener while open that calls onClose() on 'Escape'. Add to all four files.

p2plus.title: Step-progress dots are non-semantic divs with no screen-reader state
p2plus.recommendation: Wrap the pips in a container with role='group' aria-label={t('stepXofY', {current, total})} or add an sr-only live text like 'Step 2 of 3'. Applies to Palace/Entrance/Corridor tutorials.

p2plus.title: tipTop/tipLeft positioning uses hard-coded pixel offsets, ignoring rem/font scale and landscape height
p2plus.recommendation: Derive vertical offsets from remToPx() like tipWidth (e.g. remToPx(11) instead of 180) or measure rendered card height, so placement respects text scaling and short landscape viewports.

p2plus.title: Room tutorial fixed 22rem card can overflow narrow/scaled viewports
p2plus.recommendation: Use width: min(22rem, calc(100vw - 2.5rem)) and add maxHeight: calc(100dvh - 3rem) with overflowY:'auto' so long/scaled content and small viewports never clip.

p2plus.title: Highlight cutout mask uses px radius while rest of surface is rem — minor unit inconsistency
p2plus.recommendation: Express the corner radius in rem (convert via remToPx for the SVG rx, keep borderRadius as a rem string) for consistency; low priority.

p2plus.title: Tutorial mixes px and rem for the highlight cutout geometry
p2plus.recommendation: Express pad/radius in rem (e.g. 0.375rem / 0.75rem) or derive from tokens so the cutout scales with the type ramp.

p2plus.title: Tutorial 'Skip' control is very low-contrast and small for a canon touch target
p2plus.recommendation: After the canon re-skin, use MUTED #716A5E on cream for Skip and ensure both controls reach the 2.75rem min touch height with adequate padding.

p2plus.title: /help error text and success color lean on non-canon token names
p2plus.recommendation: Confirm SAGE #56683C is the intended success hue and align C.sage to it, or restyle the success panel with HAIRLINE border + EMBER checkmark to stay inside the canon palette.

p2plus.title: /help nav back-button and select borders use ad-hoc alpha suffixes rather than a token step
p2plus.recommendation: Consolidate to one or two canonical hairline treatments (full HAIRLINE #E3D6BC for active, a single softened step for rest) so borders read uniformly across Help and sibling settings pages.

p2plus.title: No client-side attachment size check — oversized files upload fully before the server rejects them
p2plus.recommendation: In the file onChange, check file.size > 5*1024*1024 and set an inline error (with a dedicated i18n key) instead of accepting the file, so the user learns the limit before uploading.

p2plus.title: Success email is sent to the user even if the support email to the team silently failed
p2plus.recommendation: Check the support-send response (and the missing-key case); if delivery to the team fails, return an error (or persist the ticket to a DB table) instead of returning ok and emailing the user a false confirmation.

p2plus.title: useSettingsTutorial is invoked in two mounted shells; ?tour=1 reset logic runs twice
p2plus.recommendation: Centralize the ?tour=1 bootstrap (run once in a single settings root) and let secondary shells only read useSettingsTourStore(open) without re-running the reset, to avoid duplicate portals.

p2plus.title: STORAGE_KEY (mp_settings_tour_seen_v2) is written but never read to gate auto-open — dead persistence
p2plus.recommendation: Either remove the unused STORAGE_KEY read/write and correct the 'auto first visit' comments, or restore an actual first-visit auto-open that reads the flag — pick one so code and comments agree.

p2plus.title: Tutorial dialog has no focus trap, focus-on-open, or Escape-to-close
p2plus.recommendation: On open, focus the primary button; add a keydown handler for Escape to call onClose; and trap focus between Skip and Next/Done to satisfy the aria-modal contract it advertises.

p2plus.title: Help page does no responsive-hook branching — relies solely on clamp/maxWidth
p2plus.recommendation: Add a useIsMobile()/useIsCompact() check to shrink or hide the wordmark text on very narrow viewports and to reduce success-panel padding, matching inline-hook responsiveness used elsewhere.

p2plus.title: FAQ accordion toggle exposes no expanded/controls semantics
p2plus.recommendation: Add aria-expanded={openFaq === i} and aria-controls pointing to an id on the answer div (give the answer role region/labelledby) so the disclosure state is announced.

p2plus.title: Tutorial tooltip width reads window.innerWidth outside a reactive path
p2plus.recommendation: Derive tooltip width/position from the same resize-tracked state that updates targetBox so re-layout is guaranteed on rotation even if the target rect is unchanged.

strengths: Consistent, disciplined rem-based sizing throughout (only true 1px hairline borders use px), matching canon unit rules.
Correct typography tokens: T.font.display (Fraunces) for titles, T.font.body (Source Sans) for message/controls/labels.
Responsiveness done canon-correctly with inline styles + useIsMobile() and no @media queries; mobile/desktop variants for width, padding, and font sizes.
Touch targets respect the 2.75rem minimum on both the Skip and Next buttons (both explicitly set minHeight: 2.75rem).
Thoughtful micro-interactions (typewriter with skip-to-full, progress bar, animated step dots, hover scale) give the surface real polish once recolored to canon.
aria-labels present on Skip/Next; the overlay cleanly returns null when inactive (no empty-state artifact).
Store state machine is internally correct: next() guards the last step (stepIndex >= length-1) and finishes via skip(), which persists completed=true to localStorage with a try/catch guard.
SSR-safety is handled: module-init localStorage read is guarded with typeof window !== 'undefined', and writes are wrapped in try/catch.
The 'Show all' interaction is functionally correct — clicking Next while typing completes the text instead of advancing, a sensible two-stage control.
Typewriter setInterval is cleaned up on unmount/step-change via the effect return, avoiding a runaway timer.
Translation keys used by the overlay resolve correctly across all five locales — only 'stepDot' is missing.

areas.summary: The onboarding wizard is visually strong and architecturally disciplined — the four cream-canon setup phases, the ceremonial celebration, atomic completion routing, and a hardened iOS 3.1.1 paywall seal are all production-grade. However, it is NOT ship-ready because of one P0: the "place your first memory" upload is never persisted to any store/DB, yet the flow marks the checklist item complete and celebrates it, so the surface's core do-first promise silently loses user data. A cluster of P1s compounds this — an off-canon dark bronze-glass paywall that visually whiplashes after the cream celebration, an unguarded 12.5s autoplay video that ignores prefers-reduced-motion, and radiogroups that assert an ARIA contract they don't fulfill (no arrow-key navigation). Fix the P0 persistence path first, then the four P1s, before release.

p0.title: Onboarding 'first memory' upload is never persisted — silent data loss
p0.detail: In the upload phase, ImportHub's onImportFiles handler builds an in-memory object, stores it only in local React state (setUploadedMemory) to render inside the celebration 3D scene, sets memoryUploadedRef, and advances to celebration. It never calls any store/DB write (no addMemory/saveMemory/createMemory anywhere in the file). After finish, handleFinishOnboarding even marks the checklist item 'upload_first_memory' as complete — so the user is told their first memory was saved, but it vanishes on unmount. This is the core 'do-first / place your first memory' promise of the surviving flow, and it is broken.
p0.recommendation: Persist the uploaded file before advancing: call the real memory-creation path (the same store/action the in-app ImportHub uses) inside onImportFiles for room 'ro1'/wing 'roots', await it, and only then handleMemoryAdded(). Surface an error toast and stay on the upload phase if the write fails, so the checklist mark reflects a real saved memory.

p1.title: Paywall phase is a leftover dark bronze-glass card, wholly off-canon from the cream setup flow
p1.detail: Every other phase (lang_a11y, name, style_era, celebration) is warm-cream Library canon: CREAM/#FFF cards, HAIRLINE borders, INK/MUTED text, EMBER CTAs, Overline in EMBER_GLYPH. The paywall reverts to the retired dark theme: full-screen background '#1a1917', a translucent brown glass card 'rgba(40, 34, 26, 0.85)' with heavy blur(20px), and text in raw hex '#F2EDE7', '#A09889', '#D4CBC0', '#8A8073', '#6B6155'. It also uses the OLD palette tokens T.color.terracotta (#C66B3D) and T.color.walnut (#8B7355) rather than canon EMBER (#B85C38) / EMBER_GLYPH (#9A4F2A). Reaching this screen after the calm cream celebration is a jarring visual whiplash and reads as an un-migrated surface.
p1.recommendation: Reskin the paywall to cream canon: CREAM/#FFF card, HAIRLINE border, SHADOW[2]+TOP_HIGHLIGHT, INK/MUTED text, the canon Overline component, EMBER-glyph feature checks, and the shared primaryCtaStyle/T.land.ctaGrad for the trial CTA. Drop the #1a1917 backdrop and T.color.terracotta/walnut tokens entirely.

p1.title: Paywall uses non-canon terracotta/walnut palette tokens instead of EMBER/EMBER_GLYPH
p1.detail: The paywall CTA, feature-icon backgrounds, ornamental rule, and legal links are all colored with T.color.terracotta (#C66B3D) — a lighter, more orange bronze that is NOT the canon EMBER (#B85C38) or EMBER_GLYPH (#9A4F2A). This is the exact 'misused/off-canon' interactive color the design canon warns against. It appears 6+ times in this block.
p1.recommendation: Replace all T.color.terracotta references in the paywall with EMBER (interactive) / EMBER_GLYPH (at-rest accent ink), and the CTA gradient with T.land.ctaGrad, matching every other onboarding phase.

p1.title: Video intro phase ignores prefers-reduced-motion
p1.detail: The 'video_intro' phase autoplays a full-screen looping motion video (/video/hero-ob.mp4) with animated welcome-outro and gradient scrims, with no reduced-motion guard. OnboardingSceneHost and OnboardingCelebration both correctly gate animation on prefersReducedMotion(), but this first-seen phase does not — a motion-sensitive user gets 12.5s of unavoidable moving video before any content. This is the most prominent motion in the flow.
p1.recommendation: Detect prefers-reduced-motion (reuse the same helper as SceneHost). When set, skip the video entirely and start at 'lang_a11y' (or show a static poster frame with the welcome title, no autoplay), mirroring the reduced-motion swaps already used elsewhere.

p1.title: Language/text-size radiogroups lack keyboard arrow navigation (broken ARIA radiogroup pattern)
p1.detail: Both radiogroups render role="radiogroup" with role="radio" children, but each radio is a plain button with only onClick. There is no roving tabIndex and no arrow-key handler, so keyboard/switch users cannot move selection with Up/Down/Left/Right as the radiogroup role promises; every option is also a separate Tab stop. The ARIA contract is asserted but not fulfilled.
p1.recommendation: Implement the radiogroup keyboard pattern: give the checked radio tabIndex=0 and others tabIndex=-1, and add an onKeyDown on the group that moves selection+focus with Arrow keys (and Home/End). Applies to both the locale grid and the text-size row.

p2plus.title: Paywall mixes px letter-spacing and uses Fraunces for an uppercase overline, breaking type-canon
p2plus.recommendation: Reuse the shared <Overline> component (Source Sans, 0.6875rem/700, 0.12em, EMBER_GLYPH) here too, so all five phases share one overline grammar.

p2plus.title: beginOutro's 2.6s setPhase timeout is never cleared on unmount
p2plus.recommendation: Store the timeout id in a ref and clear it in the skip handler and in a useEffect cleanup, or drive the outro→advance via a guarded effect keyed on showWelcome so React owns teardown.

p2plus.title: celebrationAtrium key label 'Select your plan' contradicts the comment 'CTA always enters (never a paywall)'
p2plus.recommendation: Reconcile intent: if the paywall step is desired for web, fix the stale comment; if the ceremonial threshold should always enter the palace, use celebrationContinue and drop the paywall branch. Do not ship a label ('Select your plan') that mismatches its own documented contract.

p2plus.title: Step-progress dots invisible to assistive tech
p2plus.recommendation: Add role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow={current} aria-valuemin={1} aria-valuemax={total} and an aria-label, or include a visually-hidden i18n string like t('stepOf',{current,total}) so progress is announced.

p2plus.title: Video Skip button below 2.75rem touch target
p2plus.recommendation: Raise the Skip button minHeight to at least 2.75rem (and consider matching horizontal hit area) to meet the touch-target minimum.

p2plus.title: Paywall 'Continue free' and Terms/Privacy links have no minimum touch target
p2plus.recommendation: Give the free-continue button minHeight >=2.75rem and padding, and increase the tap area / spacing of the Terms/Privacy links (e.g. inline-block with padding) so they satisfy the touch-target minimum.

p2plus.title: Video-intro welcome title uses an ad-hoc gold '#E8C766' instead of canon GOLD/steward gradient
p2plus.recommendation: Align the outro gold to canon: use GOLD (#D4AF37) or the same #E8C255 anchor from NAME_GRAD so the two ceremonial gold beats read as one system.

p2plus.title: Hairline/border widths use px (3px, 1px) instead of rem in several spots
p2plus.recommendation: Use rem for non-hairline strokes (e.g. spinner '0.1875rem'); keep 1px only for genuine 1-device-pixel hairline rules for consistency with SceneHost which uses HAIRLINE at 0.125rem.

p2plus.title: StepDots count (3) excludes the video_intro and upload phases, so the progress reads inconsistently
p2plus.recommendation: Either keep dots only on the 3 form cards (acceptable) but confirm intentionally, or extend the dot grammar subtly to signal the do-first upload step so the progress cue doesn't vanish mid-flow.

p2plus.title: Video-intro skip button uses cool neutral glass, not warm-ink canon
p2plus.recommendation: Warm the intro skip chrome to an ink-tinted rgba(64,59,54,x) fill/border to keep even the video overlay on the warm palette.

p2plus.title: Two active-state checkmarks are literal '✓' glyphs rather than a canon icon/weight
p2plus.recommendation: Consider a small stroked check SVG (matching the laurel/divider-tick drawing style) for a more intentional, canon-consistent selected affordance; low priority.

p2plus.title: Autoplay-fail fallback abandons the graceful outro and the localized welcome beat
p2plus.recommendation: On autoplay rejection, either render a tap-to-continue affordance so the outro can play on gesture, or route through beginOutro (welcome beat) rather than hard-cutting to lang_a11y, so mobile users get the same transition as desktop.

p2plus.title: Uploaded memory data URL degrades scene fidelity but is silently mishandled when both file read and preview fail
p2plus.recommendation: If dataUrl resolves empty after all fallbacks, surface an error toast and do not advance (or retry), rather than persisting/celebrating a memory with no renderable content.

p2plus.title: Name input uses autoFocus, forcing keyboard/scroll on mobile
p2plus.recommendation: Consider gating autoFocus to non-mobile (e.g. only when !isMobile) so the keyboard/scroll jump and premature focus move don't disrupt the mobile/AT flow while desktop keeps the convenience.

p2plus.title: Landscape scroll fix applies only to setup cards, not the full-screen phases
p2plus.recommendation: Add overflowY:auto and top/flex-start alignment to the paywall/celebration overlay containers when isLandscapePhone (mirroring the setup-card treatment) so tall cards remain fully reachable on short landscape viewports.

strengths: The four setup phases (lang_a11y, name, style_era) and the celebration are textbook cream-canon: CREAM/#FFF cards, 0.0625rem HAIRLINE borders, SHADOW[1/2]+TOP_HIGHLIGHT, INK/MUTED text, and a single EMBER T.land.ctaGrad CTA — visually consistent with the Library/Atrium siblings.

OnboardingCelebration is beautifully disciplined: exactly one licensed GOLD flourish (divider tick) plus the gold-sage steward NAME_GRAD on the headline, honoring the 'gold = palace-only, never a party' rule.

Shared primitives (canonStyle, cardStyle, pageStyle, Overline, primaryCtaStyle, skipLinkStyle) enforce one visual grammar across phases and use the GOLD focus ring via .onb-focusable, giving consistent visible-focus a11y polish.

Empty/loading/error states are genuinely designed: SceneHost's warm-cream radial fallback + SceneFallback with Fraunces room name, and the wizard's sceneLoadingFallback spinner with an always-clickable skip — no black or broken canvas.
Strong rem discipline and responsiveness via inline useIsMobile/useIsPortrait hooks (landscape-phone top-align/scroll handling) with no @media, matching canon.
Reduced-motion is respected across the scene surfaces (SceneHost crossfade, Celebration enter animations, transition guards) — the video-intro gap is the lone exception.

Robust state-machine hygiene: retired/legacy saved phases are remapped (RETIRED_PHASE_MAP) and unknown phases fall through to null so stale localStorage can never resurrect a removed phase or strand the user.

iOS 3.1.1 paywall seal is defended in depth and correct: loadPhase() remap, a dedicated coercion effect, and the render guard phase==='paywall' && (!isIOS() || IAP_ENABLED) all gate consistently on (isIOS() && !IAP_ENABLED).

Scene reveal is gated on a real onReady signal with a 4s ceiling timeout, WebGL capability probe, and a SceneErrorBoundary + warm-cream SceneFallback — a failed/slow 3D chunk in WKWebView never leaves a black or frozen screen, and the lazy Suspense fallback always offers a clickable Skip.

Completion is unified and atomic: skip and normal finish both route through completeAndFinish, and handleFinishOnboarding awaits finishOnboarding() and bails (keeping the wizard mounted) if the DB write throws, preventing half-persisted re-onboarding.

Double-completion is correctly prevented: handleMemoryAdded sets memoryUploadedRef synchronously before ImportHub's post-import onClose() fires, and the onClose guard if (!memoryUploadedRef.current) stops a second completeAndFinish.
i18n discipline: user-facing strings go through t() with graceful t(key) !== key fallbacks, and the active locale is applied on mount so the first screen renders in the detected language.

areas.summary: The Settings area is visually mature (avg design 78) but not shippable as-is: it carries four confirmed P0 defects that silently break core promises — the Analytics cookie toggle is a no-op that leaves tracking ON (GDPR withdrawal fails), the "Copy invite link" button generates a guaranteed-404 /join-family URL, family-member permission toggles never persist (snake_case vs camelCase key mismatch, so revoking can_delete does nothing), and every profile input at 0.9375rem triggers iOS focus-zoom on the paid platform. Beneath those sit a dense band of P1 issues clustered on functional correctness — swallowed non-2xx responses that cause silent data loss (notifications, sharing publish, push-category writes), iOS users unable to see or revoke web-connected cloud accounts, missing i18n keys shipped as hardcoded English across nl/de/es/fr on the paid platform, and a dead settings-tour spotlight targeting a data attribute the active shell never renders. Design drift (raw hex instead of canon tokens, pure-white vs cream cards, unreskinned LegacyPanel) and accessibility/touch-target gaps (unlabeled switches, sub-44px toggles) are pervasive but secondary. Verdict: strong bones, but the P0/P1 correctness and consent bugs make this area NOT release-ready until the data-integrity and iOS/i18n regressions are fixed.

p0.title: Analytics OFF toggle does not disable analytics (removes key instead of setting "0")
p0.detail: handleCookieToggle() writes localStorage.removeItem(storageKey) when a category is turned OFF, but hasAnalyticsConsent() in analytics.ts treats a MISSING mp-cookie-analytics key as 'undecided' and falls through to mp_cookie_consent === 'accepted'. Since the banner sets mp_cookie_consent='accepted' on accept, turning Analytics OFF in Settings removes the override and analytics stays ENABLED. The banner deliberately writes the explicit string '0' to force opt-out; the settings page deletes the key instead, so a GDPR consent-withdrawal control silently fails.
p0.recommendation: For the analytics category, write '0' instead of removing on OFF (localStorage.setItem(storageKey,'0')), mirroring the banner's contract exactly — ideally via an explicit per-category off-value or a special-case for mp-cookie-analytics.

p0.title: "Copy invite link" generates a link to a route that does not exist (guaranteed 404)
p0.detail: handleCopyInviteLink builds `${origin}/join-family?group=${groupId}` and copies it as the shareable invite. No /join-family route exists anywhere (Glob returns nothing; no rewrite). Any recipient lands on a 404, so the section's primary invite affordance is fully broken. The link also carries only a raw group id with no invite token, so even if the route existed it would be an unauthenticated join-by-guessing surface.
p0.recommendation: Build the /join-family route validating a per-invite token (not a raw group id), or remove the Copy-invite-link button until it exists. If kept, point it at an existing accept flow and include a signed invite token so acceptFamilyInvite can verify the invitee by email.

p0.title: Permission toggle silently no-ops on the server (field-name casing mismatch)
p0.detail: handlePermToggle calls updateSharePermissions(shareId, table, { [field]: value }) with snake_case keys (can_add/can_edit/can_delete), but the server action only reads camelCase (canAdd/canEdit/canDelete) and builds updatePayload from those. The keys never match, updatePayload stays empty, and the UPDATE writes nothing. The optimistic UI flips the toggle with no error, so the user believes a member's add/edit/delete permission changed when it did not — a data-integrity/security-adjacent regression (revoking can_delete has zero effect).
p0.recommendation: Map snake_case to the camelCase the action expects at the call site (const camel = {can_add:'canAdd',can_edit:'canEdit',can_delete:'canDelete'}[field]), or change updateSharePermissions to accept snake_case. Add a return-value check so a server {error} triggers the revert.

p0.title: All profile form inputs use fontSize 0.9375rem — triggers iOS Safari zoom-on-focus
p0.detail: The shared inputStyle (display-name, email, username, tel/WhatsApp inputs and bio textarea) sets fontSize 0.9375rem (15px). iOS Safari auto-zooms the viewport whenever a focused input's font is below 16px and does not zoom back out — a jarring behaviour on the iOS-PAID app. Canon explicitly mandates 'Inputs fontSize 1rem (no iOS zoom)'.
p0.recommendation: Set inputStyle.fontSize to '1rem' (16px) for all editable fields. If the 15px desktop size is desired, gate it behind touch/useIsMobile() and keep >=1rem on touch devices.

p1.title: Settings tour spotlight is dead — target [data-mp-settings-tabs] does not exist in the active layout
p1.detail: SettingsTutorial step 0 measures the tab bar via querySelector('[data-mp-settings-tabs]'), but the /settings layout's stacked tab-bar <nav> carries no such attribute — only the unrelated 3D-mode SettingsInline overlay does (rendered inside MemoryPalace, not on /settings/*). So targetBox stays null, the spotlight cutout and pulse ring (guarded behind {targetBox &&}) never render, and the user gets only a floating tooltip at fallback top:80/left:16 pointing at nothing. Regression from the settings overhaul that rebuilt the nav and dropped the attribute.
p1.recommendation: Add data-mp-settings-tabs to the stacked and desktop <nav> in settings/layout.tsx, or change the selector to a nav that exists in the active shell (e.g. nav[aria-label]). Verify targetBox resolves and the spotlight lands on the real route.

p1.title: Mobile anti-zoom / touch-target fix is scoped to brittle selectors and misses styled inputs
p1.detail: The mobile <style> block enforcing fontSize:1rem and min-height:2.75rem targets inputs only by type=text/email/textarea and cards by literal attribute-substring selectors like div[style*='border-radius: 1rem']. React serializes inline styles as kebab-case, so the borderRadius:'1rem' variant never matches, and inputs of type number/tel/password/search or <select> are not covered — those still trigger iOS zoom. Makes the anti-zoom guarantee fragile and dependent on child pages using exactly the right types/radius.
p1.recommendation: Broaden to .mp-settings-mobile-content input, select, textarea { font-size:1rem } and enforce min-height on inputs/selects; drop the border-radius[*=] card selectors for a shared card className. Better: set fontSize:1rem at the input component level.

p1.title: Custom buttons (switches, pills, avatar, quiz) have no visible focus ring
p1.detail: Only .mp-settings-input receives the gold :focus-visible ring. Every interactive <button> (three role=switch toggles, language pills, palace-style pills, text-size radios, avatar, retake-quiz) is styled with background/border and suppresses the native outline, leaving keyboard users with no visible focus indicator. Canon requires a visible gold focus ring on interactive elements.
p1.recommendation: Add a shared :focus-visible rule (e.g. a .mp-settings-btn class or button:focus-visible in the <style> block) applying the same GOLD outline/offset to all custom buttons.

p1.title: Discard button does not reset the WhatsApp phone field
p1.detail: hasChanges includes whatsappPhone but the Discard handler only restores displayName, bio, and username. If a user edits only WhatsApp and clicks Discard, the value stays, hasChanges remains true, and Save/Discard never clear — Discard silently fails.
p1.recommendation: Add setWhatsappPhone(profile.whatsapp_phone) to the Discard onClick so all four fields tracked by hasChanges are reverted.

p1.title: Changing language discards unsaved profile edits without warning
p1.detail: Language buttons call setLocale(l), which performs window.location.reload(). Profile inputs (name/bio/username/WhatsApp) are only committed on Save, so tapping a language chip with pending edits reloads and silently drops them with no confirm.
p1.recommendation: Guard the language switch when hasChanges is true (confirm dialog) or use the setLocaleNoReload path on the settings surface so pending edits survive the locale change.

p1.title: Profile section-overline + link-row description strings missing from every locale
p1.detail: sectionYourDetails, sectionAccountData, sectionPreferences, connectionsRowDesc and securityRowDesc are absent from all five message files and only render via the English tf() fallback. nl/de/es/fr users see untranslated English overlines and card descriptions. Confirmed by grep: zero matches for each key.
p1.recommendation: Add these five keys (plus viewPublicProfile confirmation) to en/nl/de/es/fr settings namespaces with proper translations so tf() fallback is never hit for non-English users.

p1.title: Pervasive hardcoded hex literals instead of imported canon tokens (connections)
p1.detail: The file re-derives every canon color as a raw hex string with an inline comment rather than importing constants. libraryTokens exports INK/MUTED/HAIRLINE/TRAY/SAGE/CREAM/EMBER/GOLD and _SettingsChrome re-exports several, yet this page uses none. Drift risk: if a token shifts, literals here silently diverge; sibling pages import the tokens, this one is the odd one out.
p1.recommendation: Import { INK, MUTED, HAIRLINE, TRAY, SAGE, CREAM, EMBER } from '@/lib/libraryTokens' and replace the literals so the surface stays token-locked.

p1.title: iOS users cannot see or disconnect accounts they connected on web
p1.detail: On iOS, hideComingSoon (=isIOS()) replaces the ENTIRE provider grid with a static note; the render never maps PROVIDERS. Any account connected on web (e.g. Google Photos) becomes invisible in the iOS app and its Disconnect button is unreachable. connectedMap and accounts are still fetched but never rendered, so an iOS-only session can neither view nor revoke a cloud connection.
p1.recommendation: On iOS still render ALREADY-connected accounts (read-only card + working Disconnect) and only suppress Connect CTAs / not-yet-shipped providers. Filter PROVIDERS to connected ones when hideComingSoon is true rather than dropping the whole grid.

p1.title: iOS 'cloud unavailable' note key missing from ALL locales — hardcoded English
p1.detail: The iOS note is guarded with t('cloudUnavailableNative') !== 'cloudUnavailableNative' and falls back to a hardcoded English literal with a curly apostrophe. Confirmed by grep: cloudUnavailableNative exists in none of en/nl/de/es/fr. Every iOS user in every language sees hardcoded English — the single most-prominent copy on this surface, on the paid platform.
p1.recommendation: Add cloudUnavailableNative to the connections namespace of all 5 message files (translated), then drop the !== guard and inline literal so t() resolves normally.

p1.title: Notifications loading state is unstyled bare text, breaking the card canon
p1.detail: The initial !loaded render is a single centered 'Loading...' line with no card chrome, overline, medallion, or skeleton, so the flash reads as a broken page. It also uses raw hex #716A5E and a one-off 0.9375rem size instead of shared tokens.
p1.recommendation: Render skeleton card placeholders (SectionOverline + hairline cards with shimmer rows at TRAY #F6EBE3) matching the real layout, or at minimum wrap loading in the same SettingsPageHeader + card shell.

p1.title: Category toggle treats HTTP error responses (500/401/429) as success — silent data loss
p1.detail: handleToggleCategory awaits fetch(PATCH) but never checks res.ok. fetch only rejects on network failure, so a 500/401/429 (the route enforces 10/60s) does not throw and the catch never runs. The optimistic toggle persists to localStorage but the server never stored it; on next load email toggles silently revert and push-category prefs (never re-read) diverge permanently. Rapidly flipping several toggles hits the 429 and loses changes with zero feedback.
p1.recommendation: Capture the response: const res = await fetch(...); if (!res.ok) throw new Error(String(res.status)); so the existing catch rolls back and shows saveFailed. Surface the 429 case distinctly.

p1.title: Push-category PATCH updates zero rows when no push_subscriptions row exists
p1.detail: PATCH persists push-category prefs via .update(pushUpdates).eq('user_id', user.id) against push_subscriptions. If the subscribe insert failed or the row was pruned, the update matches 0 rows, Supabase returns no error, and PATCH resolves 200. The client shows saved but nothing was written; push categories are never re-hydrated from the server, so local store and DB stay silently out of sync for all seven push categories.
p1.recommendation: After the update, verify affected-row count (use .select('id') and check length) or upsert keyed on user_id; on 0 rows return 409/400 so the client can prompt re-enable. Also re-hydrate push categories from push_subscriptions on mount, as email prefs already are.

p1.title: Notification toggle switches have no accessible name
p1.detail: ToggleSwitch renders role='switch' aria-checked but never receives aria-label/aria-labelledby; the visible title sits in a sibling <h4>. Across ~11 switches (push master + 7 sub-categories + 3 email), a screen-reader user hears 'switch, checked/not checked' with no indication of WHICH notification each controls, making the surface unusable non-visually.
p1.recommendation: Add a label prop to ToggleSwitch and pass aria-label={t(cat.titleKey)}, or give each <h4> an id and set aria-labelledby. For the main push toggle pass t('pushNotifications').

p1.title: Notification toggle height 1.75rem (28px) is far below the 2.75rem touch minimum
p1.detail: The switch is 3rem × 1.75rem with padding:0, giving a ~48×28px hit area — 28px tall vs the required 44px. On a surface whose primary purpose is tapping toggles, every control is under-sized vertically with no invisible padding to enlarge it.
p1.recommendation: Keep the 1.75rem visual pill but expand the tap area to >=2.75rem via a min-height flex wrapper or vertical padding (padding:'0.5rem 0') with a fixed visual knob.

p1.title: Push-notification section is hidden on desktop web entirely (isMobile gate)
p1.detail: The whole push section (permission warnings, master toggle, 7 sub-toggles) renders only under {isMobile && !nativeApp}. Web Push works on desktop Chrome/Firefox/Edge, so desktop-web users can never grant permission or manage push categories — a device-class gap removing a core feature for the largest screen class; only email remains.
p1.recommendation: Gate on capability, not viewport: show whenever !nativeApp && ('Notification' in window). Reserve isMobile for layout tweaks only, not feature hiding.

p1.title: Cookie toggles never take effect in the live session (no init/opt-out call)
p1.detail: The banner calls initAnalytics()/optOutAnalytics() so decisions apply immediately, but settings-page handleCookieToggle only mutates localStorage and React state. Even after fixing the key-value bug, toggling Analytics OFF leaves PostHog capturing for the rest of the session and ON won't start until reload. GDPR consent withdrawal must be immediate.
p1.recommendation: In handleCookieToggle, after persisting, import { initAnalytics, optOutAnalytics } and for the analytics key call newValue ? initAnalytics() : optOutAnalytics().

p1.title: Preferences cookie toggle is a fully dead control
p1.detail: The 'Preferences' category persists to mp-cookie-consent (hyphen), a key referenced only in this page and read nowhere. The real banner uses mp_cookie_consent (underscore). Toggling Preferences changes no behavior — a GDPR consent control that does nothing, both a functionality bug and a compliance/trust problem.
p1.recommendation: Either wire mp-cookie-consent to actual preference behavior (and read it where preferences apply) or remove the Preferences category from COOKIE_CATEGORIES so the UI doesn't imply a control with no effect.

p1.title: Security section-overline i18n keys missing in ALL 5 locales
p1.detail: sectionSignInAccess, sectionPrivacyData, sectionDangerZone route through tf(key, fallback) and are undefined in en/nl/de/es/fr (verified). The fallback fires when t(key)===key, so nl/de/es/fr users see English section headers on every visit — the permanent shipped state, not a graceful pre-launch fallback.
p1.recommendation: Add sectionSignInAccess/sectionPrivacyData/sectionDangerZone to securityPage in all 5 files (translated) so the tf() fallback becomes a dead safety net.

p1.title: Cookie-consent toggle is a 1.625rem-tall touch target
p1.detail: The GDPR cookie consent switches (Preferences, Analytics — the only interactive controls in that block) are 3rem × 1.625rem (~26px), well under the 44px minimum, with no wrapping label hit-area to enlarge the tap zone. The primary consent controls are hard to hit on a phone.
p1.recommendation: Grow the toggle to >=2.75rem tall, or wrap it in a >=2.75rem tap target (padding on a label/button whose visual thumb stays small) so the whole row toggles consent.

p1.title: Off-canon sage #56683C used app-wide as a semantic color (family)
p1.detail: The surface repeatedly uses #56683C for the active-member dot, role glyph, contact-member button, Family Tree link zone, and the SUCCESS toast background. Canon sage is #4A6741 (T.color.sage/success). #56683C is a bespoke off-canon olive appearing nowhere in the token file, so the success toast (this hex) and error toast (correct T.color.error) draw from mismatched palettes and sage accents won't match sibling surfaces.
p1.recommendation: Replace every #56683C with T.color.sage/success (#4A6741) or a shared SAGE constant; the success toast especially should use T.color.success.

p1.title: Admin role color #8A6410 is a bespoke brown-gold, not a canon token
p1.detail: roleColor() returns #8A6410 for admin, matching no canon token (GOLD #D4AF37, GOLD_SOFT #C99A2E, or the ember/terracotta family). This invented muddy olive-gold is used for admin badges, avatar gradients and the make-admin button, so admin styling drifts from siblings and from documented gold.
p1.recommendation: Map admin to an existing canon token (GOLD_SOFT #C99A2E or T.color.goldDark #B8922E) rather than a one-off hex.

p1.title: Family page hardcodes hexes instead of the shared canon constants siblings import
p1.detail: Sibling _SettingsChrome.tsx imports INK/MUTED/EMBER/EMBER_GLYPH/HAIRLINE from libraryTokens; this page hardcodes #403B36/#716A5E/#E3D6BC/#B85C38/#9A4F2A/#FCFAF5 dozens of times with hand-written comments. Even where hexes match canon today, the surface is a maintenance liability — token changes won't propagate, and this is how the off-canon #56683C/#8A6410 slipped in.
p1.recommendation: Import INK, MUTED, EMBER, EMBER_GLYPH, HAIRLINE, GOLD, CREAM from @/lib/libraryTokens (as _SettingsChrome does) and replace the literals.

p1.title: Family text inputs use fontSize 0.9375rem — triggers iOS focus-zoom
p1.detail: The shared inputStyle sets 0.9375rem; all three inputs (group name, invite email, rename) consume it. iOS Safari/WKWebView auto-zooms when a focused input is below 16px, so tapping any field on iPhone/iPad jerks the layout and leaves it zoomed. Canon requires 1rem. Affects the primary create/invite flow.
p1.recommendation: Set inputStyle.fontSize to '1rem'.

p1.title: Family invite row and rename row never stack on mobile/portrait
p1.detail: The invite row is a fixed horizontal flex (input flex:1, button flexShrink:0) with no flex-direction switch from useIsMobile/useIsCompact/useIsPortrait. On a narrow phone the email field is squeezed to a sliver next to 'Invite'. The inline rename row (input + Save + Cancel, three items in one row) has the same issue.
p1.recommendation: Compute isMobile and set flexDirection: isMobile ? 'column' : 'row' with full-width button on mobile for both the invite and rename rows.

p1.title: Sharing card background uses pure #FFFFFF instead of canon cream #FCFAF5
p1.detail: Every card and inner tile in SharingPage sets background '#FFFFFF', but canon white is #FCFAF5 (T.color.white), which the sibling SharingSettingsPanel/EmptyState/Toggle all use. Pure-white cards read colder/brighter than the CREAM surfaces around them, creating a two-tone-white inconsistency between the page and its own slide-over panel.
p1.recommendation: Replace card-level '#FFFFFF' with #FCFAF5; keep inner tiles at #FCFAF5 and nudge card-vs-tile contrast via the existing hairline+shadow rather than pure white.

p1.title: Sharing loading states are a bare unstyled ellipsis in two of three sections
p1.detail: The Passcode and Family sections render loading as a literal '...' in a plain div — no spinner, no type ramp, no reduced-motion consideration — jarring next to the Published-content card on the SAME page, which has a proper 2.5rem ember-topped spinner + muted caption. Three cards on one screen show two different loading treatments.
p1.recommendation: Extract the Published card's spinner (border #E3D6BC / borderTopColor #B85C38 / spin keyframe + reduced-motion guard) into a shared Spinner and use it in PasscodeSection and FamilyWingSharingSection.

p1.title: Save can silently fail to publish rooms in never-published wings
p1.detail: getMyPublishableContent sets wing id = dbWing?.id || w.id, so for a wing with no DB row the id is the slug string. handleSave's publishWing({wingId: slug}) UPDATE matches zero rows and returns error=null (silent no-op), while publishRoom may INSERT wing_id:<slug> into a uuid column and fail. Both run in Promise.all with no per-op inspection, then handleSave optimistically marks everything published and shows publishSuccess — success shown while nothing (or only part) was saved.
p1.recommendation: Have publishWing upsert (create the wings row if absent) and collect results: if any r.ok===false || r.error, show error; only apply optimistic setWings for ops that succeeded.

p1.title: Passcode creation uses a wing id that may be a slug, not a DB uuid
p1.detail: PasscodeSection seeds selectedWingId from content[0].id (dbWing?.id || w.id — a slug for any wing without a DB row) and calls createPasscode({wingId}). If createPasscode writes wingId into a uuid FK column, creation fails; handleCreate only appends on result.ok && result.share, so on failure the button just spins and clears with no toast — no error UI exists in this section.
p1.recommendation: Use a guaranteed-real wing identifier (ensure the wings row exists / resolve slug server-side) and add an error toast in the !result.ok branch.

p1.title: Hardcoded English 'Wing' label in the passcode form — no i18n
p1.detail: The passcode create form's wing-selector label is a raw literal 'Wing', not routed through t(), so nl/de/es/fr users see English. Every sibling label (Duration, permission overlines) uses t(). Canon violation (no hardcoded user-facing strings).
p1.recommendation: Wrap with {t('passcodeWing') || 'Wing'} and add the key to all five locale files (reuse the sharingSettings 'wing' key if suitable).

p1.title: LegacyPanel.tsx runs on the legacy warm-stone palette, out of sync with the reskinned page
p1.detail: The LegacyPanel modal (a sibling surface for the same feature) uses the old T.color palette — T.color.linen background, warmStone header gradient, sandstone-tinted pills. The canonical legacy page.tsx uses CREAM #FCFAF5 cards on HAIRLINE borders. The two Legacy surfaces read as two different eras of the design system side by side.
p1.recommendation: Reskin LegacyPanel to match page.tsx: CREAM/#FCFAF5 surfaces, EFF2E8/sage or terracotta medallion pills instead of sandstone alpha, and the same card/shadow grammar.

p1.title: LegacyPanel scrim uses off-canon dark umber
p1.detail: The modal backdrop is rgba(42,34,24,.45), a near-black umber unrelated to canon warm-ink INK #403B36. The ConfirmModal in page.tsx uses the correct rgba(64,59,54,0.35). Pre-reskin residue that makes the overlay feel colder/heavier than the rest of the surface.
p1.recommendation: Change the scrim to rgba(64,59,54,0.35) to match the ConfirmModal / Atrium warm-ink scrim.

p1.title: Adding a legacy contact with an existing email appends a duplicate card
p1.detail: createLegacyContact upserts on onConflict 'user_id,contact_email', so re-adding an existing email silently UPDATES the row and returns result.contact with no error. The create branch then unconditionally appends: setContacts(prev => [...prev, result.contact]). The list shows two cards for one DB row; a reload collapses them. State diverges from the server and the user can't tell an add from an in-place overwrite.
p1.recommendation: Dedupe by id when merging (replace if result.contact.id already in state, else append), or have createLegacyContact report inserted-vs-updated and toast accordingly.

p1.title: Two divergent legacy contact data models coexist (LegacyPanel vs settings page)
p1.detail: LegacyPanel (still mounted twice in MemoryPalace.tsx) writes via track-actions using accessible_wings/accessible_rooms and 'selected_wings', while settings/legacy/page.tsx uses legacy-actions with wing_access/room_access and 'wings_only'/'specific_rooms'. A contact created in one surface renders with the wrong access label (or blank wings) in the other, and 'selected_wings' has no counterpart in the page's ACCESS_LEVELS list, falling through to raw string display.
p1.recommendation: Consolidate both surfaces onto one action module and one field/enum vocabulary, or retire LegacyPanel now the full settings page exists. At minimum map selected_wings<->wings_only and accessible_wings<->wing_access.

p1.title: updateLegacyContact lacks the migration-012 fallback createLegacyContact has
p1.detail: createLegacyContact detects a missing wing_access/room_access column and retries with basePayload so the save succeeds. updateLegacyContact always includes those keys and has no retry, so on a DB where migration 012 is not applied, editing a contact's access surfaces the raw Postgres error and fails. Asymmetric resilience, a plausible overhaul regression.
p1.recommendation: Mirror the create-path fallback: on a wing_access/room_access column error, strip those keys from payload and retry the update.

p1.title: Legacy text inputs, textarea and date picker use fontSize 0.9375rem — iOS focus zoom
p1.detail: The shared inputStyle sets 0.9375rem (15px) and every text/email/date input plus the message textarea (which further overrides to 0.9375rem) uses it. iOS Safari/WKWebView auto-zooms below 16px, so tapping contact name, email, subject, verifier-email or delivery-date jerks the layout. LegacyPanel got this right (1rem), so the two legacy surfaces are inconsistent.
p1.recommendation: Set inputStyle.fontSize to '1rem' and remove the textarea's 0.9375rem override so all controls render >=16px.

p1.title: Logged-out / no-session users are stuck on the subscription loading spinner forever
p1.detail: load() early-returns when there is no authenticated user, before setLoading(false) runs at the end. setLoading(false) is only reached on the success path or outer catch, so if getUser() returns no user (expired session, hydration race, transient null), the component never leaves loading and renders only t('loading') indefinitely. No route guard guarantees a user.
p1.recommendation: Wrap the body in try/finally and call setLoading(false) in finally, or move it before the early return. Handle the no-user case explicitly (redirect to /login or an error state).

p1.title: iOS IAP can only ever purchase the ANNUAL plan — monthly is unreachable
p1.detail: handleIAPUpgrade builds the product id from 'interval' state (default 'annual'). The only control that changes interval (the monthly/annual toggle) lives inside the plan-comparison block rendered only when !nativeApp. On iOS (nativeApp===true) the toggle never renders, so interval is permanently 'annual' and the price shown is always the annual product's. A real gap the IAP merge introduced by hiding the toggle wholesale.
p1.recommendation: Render a lightweight monthly/annual toggle in the current-plan card path available on iOS (guarded by isApple && iapReady), or pass an explicit interval to the IAP flow so both StoreKit products are reachable.

p1.title: Hardcoded English 'Copy' string on the reward promo-code button
p1.detail: The copy-to-clipboard button in the earned-rewards list renders a literal 'Copy' with no useTranslation call, leaking English into nl/de/es/fr. It sits in a visible interactive control (reward redemption).
p1.recommendation: Replace with {t('copy')} (or an existing copy label) and add 'copy' to the subscription namespace in all five locale files.

p1.title: Missing i18n keys manageOrCancel and inviteFriends in all 5 locales
p1.detail: Verified against en/nl/de/es/fr: subscription.manageOrCancel and subscription.inviteFriends are missing everywhere. The code uses inline guards (t('manageOrCancel') !== 'manageOrCancel' ? ... : 'Manage or Cancel Subscription' and t('inviteFriends') || 'Invite Friends'), so ALL users — including English — see the hardcoded literal and translated locales get no translation for the primary Apple-managed CTA and the invite button.
p1.recommendation: Add manageOrCancel and inviteFriends (translated) to all five files, then drop the inline English fallbacks.

p1.title: Currency <select> fontSize 0.8125rem triggers iOS Safari zoom-on-focus
p1.detail: Canon requires inputs at 1rem. The currency selector is a real focusable control at 0.8125rem (13px). On mobile Safari, tapping a control under 16px zooms the viewport, breaking the All-plans comparison layout. (Renders only on non-native/web, but web in mobile Safari still zooms.)
p1.recommendation: Set the select fontSize to 1rem (keep visual scale via padding/letter-spacing if needed).

p1.title: ExportPanel uses the legacy T theme instead of libraryTokens canon
p1.detail: ExportPanel imports only { T } from '@/lib/theme' while its shell (_SettingsChrome) is built on INK/MUTED/EMBER/EMBER_GLYPH/HAIRLINE. The panel's accent T.color.terracotta #C66B3D (bright orange) is not canon EMBER #B85C38; primary text T.color.charcoal #1F1B1A is not canon INK #403B36; secondary T.color.muted #857B70 is not canon MUTED #716A5E. The export block reads colder/oranger than the surrounding Privacy & Security surface.
p1.recommendation: Migrate ExportPanel onto libraryTokens: terracotta→EMBER, charcoal→INK, muted→MUTED, cream borders→HAIRLINE (at minimum alias them).

p1.title: ExportPanel borders use cream #FCFAF5 not canon HAIRLINE #E3D6BC
p1.detail: Every border and divider is drawn with T.color.cream #FCFAF5 — the canon BACKGROUND color, not a border color. Canon reserves HAIRLINE #E3D6BC for 1px borders. A #FCFAF5 border on a #F2EDE4 linen panel is almost invisible, so the outer card border, photo-slider card, cancel button, and the 'Shared with you'/'Other data' separators all lose definition.
p1.recommendation: Replace all 1px solid T.color.cream borders with HAIRLINE (#E3D6BC) from libraryTokens.

p1.title: Export scan failure leaves the panel open with no content, no error, no way out
p1.detail: handleScan sets exportOpen=true and scanning=true, then on any throw hits catch { /* ignore */ } and sets scanning=false with tree=null. Render is scanning ? spinner : tree ? panel : null, so on failure the opened panel renders NOTHING — no message, no Cancel (it lives in the tree branch), no retry — and the top-level Export button is hidden (gated on !exportOpen). flushSettingsToServer() and scanExportTree() are both in the swallowed try, so a network blip, expired session, or server error all produce this dead-end.
p1.recommendation: Add an error state (setScanError(true)) in the catch and render an error branch with message + Retry + Cancel that reset exportOpen/tree. Never leave exportOpen=true with tree=null and no controls.

p1.title: Legacy http(s) photos are counted as exportable then always fail, forcing a false 'partial' toast
p1.detail: The scan counts a memory as a photo whenever file_path || file_url is set, and totalSelectedPhotos inherits that. But in the download loop, any filePath starting with http(s):// is unconditionally counted as failed and skipped ('Skip legacy full URLs'). For users whose photos are full signed URLs, every one inflates the count, is skipped, and the final failedCount>0 || skipped>0 branch fires the error-styled exportZipPartial toast even though the export is as complete as it can be.
p1.recommendation: Either resolve legacy URLs through fetch as well, or exclude non-proxy URLs from storageFiles up front so they don't count toward totalSelectedPhotos or trip the partial toast; reserve the error toast for genuine proxy failures.

p2plus.title: Off-canon chevron stroke hex #C9BCA6 not in the palette
p2plus.recommendation: Use HAIRLINE (#E3D6BC) or MUTED (#716A5E) for the at-rest chevron instead of ad-hoc #C9BCA6.

p2plus.title: Hardcoded white/cream hex literals instead of tokens (shell)
p2plus.recommendation: Replace '#FCFAF5' literals with the CREAM token; consider a warm-white token for the sidebar card instead of raw #FFFFFF.

p2plus.title: Layout max-widths use unitless px rather than rem
p2plus.recommendation: Express as rem (e.g. maxWidth:'73.75rem') to scale with accessibility font settings.

p2plus.title: GOLD focus-ring color hardcoded in the <style> block
p2plus.recommendation: Interpolate GOLD into the template string so the ring can never drift from canon.

p2plus.title: Mobile card polish depends on a brittle inline-style attribute-substring selector
p2plus.recommendation: Tag cards with a shared class (.mp-settings-card) and target that in the mobile override instead of a fragile border-radius substring.

p2plus.title: Redirect page ships no styled loading/transition state
p2plus.recommendation: Acceptable given it's an instant server redirect; add a minimal CREAM loading shell only if a flash is observed.

p2plus.title: iOS subscription visibility diverges between nav and tutorial after IAP merge
p2plus.recommendation: Filter the subscription bullet with (isIOS() && !IAP_ENABLED && f.titleKey==='feat_subscription_title') so the tour mirrors the nav on iOS.

p2plus.title: Sign-out button lacks disabled/aria-busy state during in-flight sign-out
p2plus.recommendation: Pass disabled={signingOut} aria-busy={signingOut} (and type='button') to both sign-out buttons.

p2plus.title: Stacked tab bar has no active-tab auto-scroll
p2plus.recommendation: Add a ref+effect calling scrollIntoView({inline:'center'}) on the active tab when pathname changes (guard with reduced-motion).

p2plus.title: Horizontal tab bar has no roving/keyboard affordance and can hide overflow items
p2plus.recommendation: Add scroll-snap-type:x and scroll-margin, scrollIntoView the active item on mount, and consider an edge fade to signal more tabs.

p2plus.title: Tutorial spotlight overlay ignores prefers-reduced-motion for pulse/tip animations
p2plus.recommendation: Wrap pulse/entrance animations in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference), matching SettingsInline.

p2plus.title: Tutorial uses raw px offsets/radii instead of rem
p2plus.recommendation: Convert sizing constants to rem (or measure the tooltip after render) so the spotlight tracks text scaling; keep px only for the hairline border.

p2plus.title: Nav item descriptions single-line truncated, hiding info on narrow sidebar
p2plus.recommendation: Allow up to 2 lines (-webkit-line-clamp:2) or add title={navDesc(item)}.

p2plus.title: Profile inset panels use the same #FCFAF5 as their parent card, so nested rows don't recess
p2plus.recommendation: Give inset rows a recessed fill (TRAY #F6EBE3) or paint the card white/linen so nested panels sit visibly below the surface.

p2plus.title: Interactive text color inconsistent between EMBER #B85C38 and EMBER_GLYPH #9A4F2A
p2plus.recommendation: Use EMBER #B85C38 consistently for actionable links/buttons; reserve #9A4F2A for at-rest glyphs/medallion ink.

p2plus.title: Renaissance style-pill selected accent uses off-canon gilt #C8A858
p2plus.recommendation: Use EMBER #B85C38 (matching the roman pill's active grammar) or GOLD #D4AF37 if ceremonial.

p2plus.title: Profile loading/error states are bare centered text with no card/skeleton
p2plus.recommendation: Wrap loading/error in the card grammar (or a skeleton of the profile card) and give error an icon + retry.

p2plus.title: Profile canon tokens hardcoded as raw hex instead of imported
p2plus.recommendation: Import INK/MUTED/HAIRLINE/EMBER/EMBER_GLYPH/TRAY/CREAM from libraryTokens and reference tokens.

p2plus.title: Toast success color #56683C defined inline rather than via SAGE
p2plus.recommendation: Reference SAGE and T.color.error tokens for the toast palette.

p2plus.title: Persona 'Retake / Take quiz' CTA lands on /atrium with no anchor to the quiz
p2plus.recommendation: Push /atrium?persona=1 and have HomeView read it to open + scroll to the quiz.

p2plus.title: Profile can be made public before a username exists
p2plus.recommendation: Disable the visibility toggle (or prompt for a username) when profile.username is empty, mirroring the URL-row gate.

p2plus.title: Persona label reads localStorage only — stale after retaking on another device
p2plus.recommendation: Persist persona to the profiles row and hydrate from it; use localStorage only as an optimistic cache.

p2plus.title: Username under 3 chars accepted by input but rejected server-side
p2plus.recommendation: Validate length inline (disable Save or show a field hint below 3 chars) before calling the server action.

p2plus.title: Reduced-motion block strips transitions app-wide and disables hover overlay reveal
p2plus.recommendation: Scope reduced-motion overrides to the animated elements on this page rather than bare button/input/span.

p2plus.title: 'Change photo' text button touch target far below 2.75rem
