p2plus.recommendation: Add minHeight:'2.75rem' and horizontal padding, matching the retake-quiz/public-profile controls.

p2plus.title: Daylight time-of-day range input has a sub-2.75rem touch target
p2plus.recommendation: Give the range input minHeight (2.75rem) and/or a larger custom thumb via ::-webkit-slider-thumb.

p2plus.title: Avatar upload is image-only with no capture hint
p2plus.recommendation: Optional: add capture='user' if direct selfie capture is desired; otherwise no change.

p2plus.title: Language/Palace-Style selectors use aria-pressed buttons instead of radiogroup
p2plus.recommendation: Wrap in role=radiogroup with role=radio + aria-checked children, mirroring Text-Size.

p2plus.title: Connections card background is pure white #FFFFFF, off CREAM canon
p2plus.recommendation: Switch the provider card background to CREAM #FCFAF5 so cards and modal share one warm surface.

p2plus.title: Connections loading/Suspense fallbacks are unstyled bare text
p2plus.recommendation: Render 2-3 shimmer/skeleton provider cards matching the loaded layout footprint.

p2plus.title: iOS 'cloud unavailable' empty state is a bare centered paragraph
p2plus.recommendation: Wrap in a TRAY-backgrounded card with an ember-glyph medallion and hairline border, reusing the Apple Photos note grammar.

p2plus.title: Toast/destructive buttons use one-off red #A63D3D not a canon token
p2plus.recommendation: Promote danger red to a DANGER token in libraryTokens; use SAGE for success.

p2plus.title: No portrait/compact stacking control on the connections card
p2plus.recommendation: Use useIsCompact()/useIsPortrait() for the action-row wrap so it degrades at intermediate widths.

p2plus.title: Provider brand accent colors sit in a warm-canon field without softening
p2plus.recommendation: Keep brand colors on the glyph but warm/desaturate the medallion background toward TRAY.

p2plus.title: OAuth error param ignored — all failures show one generic message
p2plus.recommendation: Map known error codes to specific messages and include the provider name.

p2plus.title: 'connected' toast can fire twice (fetchAccounts deps + replaceState timing)
p2plus.recommendation: Use router.replace or a processedRef guard so the branch runs at most once per param value.

p2plus.title: Missing t in URL-param effect deps (stale closure on locale change)
p2plus.recommendation: Add t/locale to deps, or read the toast message lazily at render from a stored code.

p2plus.title: Dead defensive guard on sourcesOverline (key now exists)
p2plus.recommendation: Simplify to label={t('sourcesOverline')} and remove the literal.

p2plus.title: Provider/Apple icons decorative but not aria-hidden
p2plus.recommendation: Add aria-hidden='true' to the s prop object, matching the SettingsGlyph pattern.

p2plus.title: No iPad/compact-portrait layout — desktop leaks to iPad portrait
p2plus.recommendation: Use useIsCompact()/useIsTablet() to drive card padding + full-width buttons on iPad portrait.

p2plus.title: Fixed top-right toast can clip off-screen with long translated strings
p2plus.recommendation: On isMobile anchor to left:1rem/right:1rem or add maxWidth:calc(100% - 2rem).

p2plus.title: Icon sizes use raw pixel numbers rather than rem
p2plus.recommendation: Express icon sizes in rem or convert numeric size to a rem string inside ProviderIcon.

p2plus.title: Notifications: raw hex literals inlined instead of importing named tokens
p2plus.recommendation: Import INK/MUTED/EMBER/EMBER_GLYPH/HAIRLINE/TRAY and pass EMBER_GLYPH as a color prop into the 13 icon SVGs.

p2plus.title: Icon-tile OFF background #F6EBE3 hardcoded instead of TRAY token
p2plus.recommendation: Replace #F6EBE3 literals with the TRAY token.

p2plus.title: Push-toggle title serif vs Source-Sans sub-item titles — abrupt type-hierarchy split
p2plus.recommendation: Confirm the split is intended; if softening, keep the serif header and render sub-titles at RT.body or bump to titleS serif for a two-tier hierarchy.

p2plus.title: Inconsistent divider strategy between PUSH and EMAIL maps (unused index i)
p2plus.recommendation: Share one divider rule; drop the unused i param.

p2plus.title: Master push toggle can leave server subscribed while local pushEnabled stays false on failure
p2plus.recommendation: Wrap the enable body in try/finally and reset subscribingRef/setSubscribing in finally, or reset on every early return.

p2plus.title: Push store not persisted per-user — prefs leak across accounts on shared device
p2plus.recommendation: Scope the storage key by user id or hydrate push-category prefs from push_subscriptions on mount.

p2plus.title: Duplicate <style> block injected once per ToggleSwitch (~11 copies)
p2plus.recommendation: Hoist the <style> block to the page component or a global stylesheet.

p2plus.title: iPad portrait (768-1024px) falls through the isMobile gate and loses the push section
p2plus.recommendation: Use useIsCompact() (max-width:1024px) or capability-based gating so iPad portrait is included.

p2plus.title: Notifications loading state uses a hardcoded English fallback
p2plus.recommendation: Rely on t('loading') (present in all locales) or a neutral non-text spinner.

p2plus.title: Security tokens re-declared locally instead of imported (renamed EMBER_GLYPH)
p2plus.recommendation: Import INK/MUTED/EMBER/EMBER_GLYPH/SAGE/HAIRLINE/CREAM from libraryTokens; rename local TERRA to EMBER_GLYPH.

p2plus.title: Undocumented off-canon 'danger' color ramp (8 hexes) not in tokens
p2plus.recommendation: Add a DANGER ramp to libraryTokens and reference it so the danger register is canon-backed.

p2plus.title: Security input fontSize 0.9375rem below the iOS-zoom-safe 1rem
p2plus.recommendation: Bump inputStyle.fontSize to 1rem (at minimum on the destructive delete-confirm input).

p2plus.title: useIsMobile only gates the header — cards keep desktop padding on mobile
p2plus.recommendation: Derive card horizontal padding from isMobile (e.g. 1.25rem vs 1.75rem).

p2plus.title: Error toast red #C05050 off-canon while success correctly uses SAGE
p2plus.recommendation: Replace #C05050 with a DANGER token once the ramp is added.

p2plus.title: Commitment 'keystone' panel uses off-canon second ink #2E2A26
p2plus.recommendation: Add an INK_DEEP token (#2E2A26) or reuse an existing shadow-ink value.

p2plus.title: Analytics toggle checked state can display out of sync with runtime
p2plus.recommendation: Derive the toggle's checked state from hasAnalyticsConsent() rather than a raw '1' string check.

p2plus.title: deleteConfirmDescription bold-split silently drops text if placeholders missing
p2plus.recommendation: Fall back to the raw string when parts.length<3 and add a test asserting {boldStart}/{boldEnd} exist per locale.

p2plus.title: Password reset success shows generic toast even with no email on file
p2plus.recommendation: Surface a distinct message for social-login-only accounts and avoid the optimistic success in the unconfigured-env branch.

p2plus.title: Security page never adapts card padding for phone/iPad portrait
p2plus.recommendation: Derive padding from useIsMobile()/useIsCompact() (reduce to ~1rem on mobile).

p2plus.title: ExportPanel hardcodes 1px borders and raw px sizes instead of rem
p2plus.recommendation: Convert non-hairline px sizing to rem; keep 1px only for true hairlines.

p2plus.title: Danger-zone destructive nature isn't announced to AT
p2plus.recommendation: Wrap in <section role='region' aria-labelledby='danger-zone-heading'> with an id on the heading.

p2plus.title: Family SVGs pass rem strings to width/height presentational attributes
p2plus.recommendation: Route SVGs through the numeric FamilyIcon size prop (px) or move sizing into CSS style; don't pass rem to raw width/height attrs.

p2plus.title: Off-token surface hexes: disabled #EEE9DF, tray #F6EBE3, medallion border #E7D9C4
p2plus.recommendation: Promote to shared tokens (DISABLED/TRAY) or reuse existing canon neutrals.

p2plus.title: Family loading state is a bare centered line unlike the card-based body
p2plus.recommendation: Render SettingsPageHeader + a skeleton card (or spinner in a card) during loading.

p2plus.title: Family success toast uses ad-hoc green while gold focus ring is canon
p2plus.recommendation: Draw pending=ember/active=sage from named canon tokens so the state contrast reads as intentional.

p2plus.title: Family heading sizes have no clear type scale
p2plus.recommendation: Anchor headings to the T.fontSize scale so card titles share one Fraunces step.

p2plus.title: Invite button's enabled color and disabled logic disagree on the '@' check
p2plus.recommendation: Compute one inviteDisabled and drive both disabled and styling from it.

p2plus.title: inviteRole is shared global state and never resets between groups
p2plus.recommendation: Reset setInviteRole('member') after a successful invite and when expandedGroupId changes, or scope role per-group.

p2plus.title: Resend invite is a non-atomic delete-then-recreate that can lose the invite
p2plus.recommendation: Make resend an idempotent server action that re-sends for the existing invite row, or wrap both steps so failure restores the cancelled row.

p2plus.title: getAllFamilyGroups does per-group N+1 queries and blocking auto-repair inserts on load
p2plus.recommendation: Batch with .in(...) + Promise.all and move auto-repair inserts off the hot read path.

p2plus.title: Toast auto-dismiss effect shadows the translation function t
p2plus.recommendation: Rename the timer variable to avoid shadowing i18n t.

p2plus.title: Family role selector is aria-pressed toggles, not a radiogroup
p2plus.recommendation: Wrap in role=radiogroup with role=radio + aria-checked and arrow-key navigation.

p2plus.title: Fixed family toast can overflow the left edge on narrow phones
p2plus.recommendation: Add maxWidth and, on isMobile, span left:1rem/right:1rem so long toasts wrap.

p2plus.title: Family card/section padding fixed regardless of viewport
p2plus.recommendation: Tighten horizontal padding on isMobile and consider useIsTablet for iPad.

p2plus.title: First-invite CTA moves focus without ensuring the target is in view
p2plus.recommendation: Call scrollIntoView({block:'center'}) before focus (respect reduced-motion).

p2plus.title: Sharing panel off-grid corner radii (0.7/0.85rem) break the radius rhythm
p2plus.recommendation: Normalize to the canon 0.75rem small-control radius (card stays 1rem).

p2plus.title: Sharing slide-over scrim uses an off-canon warm-ink color
p2plus.recommendation: Use rgba(64,59,54,0.4) to match the shadow grammar.

p2plus.title: Sharing hardcodes literal accent hexes instead of imported tokens
p2plus.recommendation: Import EMBER/EMBER_GLYPH/HAIRLINE/CREAM/INK/MUTED/SAGE and reference the constants.

p2plus.title: Sharing gradient CTA diverges from the settings-shell button grammar
p2plus.recommendation: Pick one primary-button treatment for the sharing area and apply it to page CTAs and the panel confirm/share buttons.

p2plus.title: Family-share permission badge shape inconsistent with the badge system
p2plus.recommendation: Give the permission chip the canon pill radius (2rem) to match adjacent chips and PermissionBadge.

p2plus.title: Family-share passes slug where server/DB likely expects a wing id; wingLabel double-guesses
p2plus.recommendation: Use one canonical identifier end-to-end in shareWing/wing_id/wingLabel; drop the dual slug||id match.

p2plus.title: Sharing load effects have no error/catch, leaving surfaces stuck on '...' or crashing
p2plus.recommendation: Wrap loaders in try/catch, setLoading(false) in finally, render an error/retry state.

p2plus.title: Duplicate fixed toast slot: page-level and family-section toasts collide
p2plus.recommendation: Lift a single toast into the page/shared context, or offset the section toast.

p2plus.title: SharingSettingsPanel 'received' badges hardcode viewOnly=true, ignoring actual permission
p2plus.recommendation: Derive the viewOnly badge from the share record rather than a literal true.

p2plus.title: Main-page sharing toast has no ARIA live role
p2plus.recommendation: Add role='status'/'alert' or aria-live, mirroring the section-local toast.

p2plus.title: Wing/room card + pill transitions not guarded by reduced-motion
p2plus.recommendation: Move transitions into the guarded <style> block or add a reduced-motion rule zeroing them.

p2plus.title: Native checkbox hit area far below 2.75rem on touch
p2plus.recommendation: Give each row label minHeight 2.75rem so the full-row tap target meets the minimum.

p2plus.title: No compact/portrait (iPad) tuning in sharing — relies solely on flex-wrap
p2plus.recommendation: Use useIsCompact() to stack the passcode Wing/Duration/Create controls full-width on iPad portrait.

p2plus.title: Sharing loading '...' and decorative emoji icons not a11y-tuned
p2plus.recommendation: Replace '...' with ts('loading') and add aria-hidden to decorative emoji spans.

p2plus.title: LegacyPanel primary CTA is a terracotta gradient; page.tsx uses flat EMBER
p2plus.recommendation: Replace the gradient with flat EMBER #B85C38 so both Legacy surfaces share one primary-button look.

p2plus.title: LegacyPanel inputs and buttons have no visible focus ring
p2plus.recommendation: Add the GOLD :focus-visible ring (0.1875rem solid #D4AF37, offset 0.1875rem) via a shared class.

p2plus.title: Legacy page.tsx ships responsive @media in <style>, violating inline-styles-only canon
p2plus.recommendation: Drive the full/short tab-label swap from useIsCompact()/useIsMobile() and render inline, removing the @media (reduced-motion may remain).

p2plus.title: LegacyPanel Roman-temple icon mixes EMBER center column among glyph columns
p2plus.recommendation: Stroke all five columns in EMBER_GLYPH #9A4F2A at uniform 1.5 weight.

p2plus.title: Delivery-body preview uses full-strength MUTED, losing secondary hierarchy
p2plus.recommendation: Give the preview a distinct treatment (italic or a HAIRLINE left-rule) so it reads as an excerpt.

p2plus.title: Two disabled-button token values coexist for the same state
p2plus.recommendation: Promote the disabled fill (#EEE9DF) and text (#716A5E) into a named DISABLED token.

p2plus.title: Empty-body warning toast is immediately overwritten by the save-success toast
p2plus.recommendation: Gate save behind a confirm modal when body is empty, or drop the warning.

p2plus.title: Retry-delivery does a full window.location.reload(), discarding unsaved state

p2plus.title: handleTabSwitch dep array omits handlers; Arrow nav may act on stale activeSection
p2plus.recommendation: Move focus only after the switch commits, or in an effect keyed on activeSection.

p2plus.title: LegacyPanel toggle buttons lack aria-pressed

p2plus.title: LegacyPanel remove button deletes a contact with no confirmation

p2plus.title: Dead focus-visible CSS (.mp-settings-input) injected but never applied
p2plus.recommendation: Apply the class to inputs or delete the settingsFocusStyle block.

p2plus.title: LegacyPanel uses no responsive hooks; padding/typography don't adapt
p2plus.recommendation: Adopt useIsMobile()/useIsCompact() to tune header padding and body font.

p2plus.title: Subscription cards use pure #FFFFFF instead of canon cream
p2plus.recommendation: Replace '#FFFFFF' card backgrounds with CREAM so cards/tiles/base share one warm-white ladder.

p2plus.title: Subscription raw hex literals everywhere instead of importing tokens
p2plus.recommendation: Import INK/MUTED/HAIRLINE/EMBER/EMBER_GLYPH/CREAM/TRAY/SAGE and the ember CTA gradient from libraryTokens.

p2plus.title: Select-dropdown arrow uses off-canon cold gray #666
p2plus.recommendation: Change the chevron fill to URL-encoded MUTED %23716A5E.

p2plus.title: Progress-bar radius uses raw px instead of rem
p2plus.recommendation: Change borderRadius:3 to '0.1875rem'.

p2plus.title: Subscription loading state is bare text, thinner than the cards it replaces
p2plus.recommendation: Render a lightweight skeleton (cream cards, hairline borders, shimmer bars) using canon tokens.

p2plus.title: Subscription error/empty feedback relies solely on transient toasts
p2plus.recommendation: Add a canon inline notice (hairline card + MUTED + EMBER retry) when core data fails to load.

p2plus.title: Ember CTA gradient duplicated ~10x inline
p2plus.recommendation: Extract a shared emberCta style (idle + disabled) and reuse for all primary buttons.

p2plus.title: Status pill and progress colors use ad-hoc hex not in the token set
p2plus.recommendation: Reference SAGE and T.color.error/success instead of #56683C / #C05050.

p2plus.title: 'activated' success toast + refetch never fires for IAP returns; only Stripe
p2plus.recommendation: Unify post-purchase reconciliation into one helper with a short poll/backoff shared by Stripe and IAP.

p2plus.title: detectCurrency() overwrites currency AFTER load, causing a visible price flip
p2plus.recommendation: Initialize currency lazily from detectCurrency() (useState(() => detectCurrency())) so the first paint is correct.

p2plus.title: Inconsistent i18n missing-key handling (tf vs raw t!==key vs || fallback)
p2plus.recommendation: Route all fallbacks through tf(key, fallback) and drop the hardcoded English branches.

p2plus.title: Storage progressbar aria-valuemax/valuenow inconsistent when unlimited
p2plus.recommendation: When unlimited, omit role=progressbar (plain text meter) or set aria-valuenow undefined.

p2plus.title: manageSubscriptions() failures on iOS are entirely silent
p2plus.recommendation: Await it and show a toast pointing to iOS Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions on reject.

p2plus.title: Referral 'Copy link' button label reuses referralCopied string
p2plus.recommendation: Use a dedicated t('copyLink') for the button; keep referralCopied for the post-copy toast.

p2plus.title: Progressbar uses px border-radius and lacks aria-valuetext for unlimited
p2plus.recommendation: Add aria-valuetext with the ∞ label and convert borderRadius:3 to rem.

p2plus.title: Billing-interval toggle not exposed as a radiogroup for AT
p2plus.recommendation: Wrap in role=radiogroup with role=radio + aria-checked, or add aria-pressed.

p2plus.title: Subscription responsive layout relies almost entirely on isMobile
p2plus.recommendation: Add flexWrap/gap to the header row and useIsPortrait for narrow landscape; verify the 3-col grid on iPad split-view.

p2plus.title: Gradient primary CTAs have no hover/active affordance
p2plus.recommendation: Add a hover filter brightness to the gradient CTAs so all interactive controls respond on pointer devices.

p2plus.title: ExportPanel disabled CTA/progress track use off-canon sandstone #D6CCBA
p2plus.recommendation: Use TRAY (#F6EBE3) for the recessed track and a HAIRLINE/MUTED-derived fill for the disabled button.

p2plus.title: MetaIcon SVG sizing uses raw px and default stroke = T.color.muted
p2plus.recommendation: Express the icon box in rem and default the stroke to canon MUTED #716A5E or EMBER_GLYPH.

p2plus.title: Owner-name label at 0.5625rem in sandstone below legible/canon overline size
p2plus.recommendation: Raise to >=0.6875rem overline and color with MUTED; keep it subordinate via weight not shrinking.

p2plus.title: Expand caret uses a raw unicode triangle instead of the WingRoomIcons chevron
p2plus.recommendation: Use a small stroke SVG chevron matching MetaIcon line weight and EMBER_GLYPH color.

p2plus.title: Intentional photo cap (default 50) reported to the user as a failure
p2plus.recommendation: Distinguish slider-capped photos from genuine download failures; show capped counts as neutral/info, error toast only for failedCount.

p2plus.title: Scan treats logged-out/expired session as a valid empty tree
p2plus.recommendation: Have scanExportTree signal the unauthenticated case and short-circuit to an auth error/re-login prompt.

p2plus.title: family_groups meta count uses created_by while family_members is queried by user_id
p2plus.recommendation: Make the meta count reflect the union actually exported so enable/disable state and payload agree.

p2plus.title: Photo dedupe counter can loop unbounded on pathological duplicate names
p2plus.recommendation: If the 500 cap is raised, use a per-basename counter map instead of a rescanning while-loop.

p2plus.title: Chevron rotation transition has no reduced-motion guard
p2plus.recommendation: Gate the transition behind a reduced-motion check, setting transition:'none' when reduce is requested.

p2plus.title: Photo-count range slider has no accessible name or value text
p2plus.recommendation: Add aria-label={t('exportMaxPhotos')} and aria-valuetext, or an htmlFor label.

p2plus.title: Select all / Select none links are 0-padding micro-targets
p2plus.recommendation: Add padding + min touch height on touch devices; add underline/button chrome.

p2plus.title: Export primary/secondary layout not adapted for narrow portrait
p2plus.recommendation: On isMobile switch header/action rows to flexDirection:column with full-width buttons.

strengths: Rigorous canon token usage in the shell: imports CREAM/INK/MUTED/EMBER/EMBER_GLYPH/HAIRLINE/SHADOW/TOP_HIGHLIGHT from libraryTokens for background, text, borders and the sidebar card shadow, so it reads as a first-class Atrium/Library sibling.

EMBER correctly reserved for interactive/active state (active pill, active door left-rule, active medallion/label) and GOLD spent only on the :focus-visible ring — honoring the 'never spend gold on a generic accent' rule.
Disciplined rem-based spacing/sizing throughout, with the sole px use being genuine hairlines (0.0625rem) and touch targets honored at minHeight 2.75rem (tabs) / 3.5rem (doors) in the shell.

Polished sidebar: icon medallions, one-line descriptions, warm active tint rgba(184,92,56,0.08), sticky positioning, and a canon hover/active/focus @media(hover:hover) block that never overrides the active aria-current door.
Shell responsiveness done purely via useIsMobile()/useIsCompact() inline branching (no @media for layout), matching the inline-styles-only canon, with deliberate iPad-portrait stacking.
Type system stays on-canon: T.font.body (Source Sans) consistently and a coherent size ramp (0.75/0.875/0.9375rem).

Sign-out flow is genuinely robust: re-entrancy guard, single-shot navigation, 8s hang-guard tuned above signOut latency, server revoke before local cookie purge, and per-user localStorage cleanup — a well-reasoned state machine.
Active-tab detection is correct across both layouts (pathname === href || pathname.startsWith(href + '/')), highlighting parent tabs on nested sub-routes with aria-current='page' wired for a11y.

IAP/iOS nav gating uses the canonical (isIOS() && !IAP_ENABLED) pattern, with IAP_ENABLED isolated in a dependency-free module so Edge middleware can import it without pulling Capacitor — paywall-visibility logic is correct.

All i18n keys used by the shell (profile, family, subscription, sharingSettings, alerts, legacy, security, settingsNavigation, signOut, settingsTour.*) resolve to real en.json entries with graceful descKey→fallback via navDesc(); the missing-key defects are confined to specific sub-page keys.
settings/page.tsx cleanly redirects bare /settings to /settings/profile, so the index route is never a dead shell.

areas.summary: Palace3D is functionally solid at its core (robust scene-loading state machine, correct paywall gating, atomic onboarding, disciplined rem/safe-area responsiveness) but is not ship-ready: it carries one P0 and a broad band of P1 defects. The most serious issues are functional dead-ends — Add Memory / Write Story / Share Room actions are surfaced in every mode yet silently no-op (or worse, soft-lock the UI by hiding both nav bars while rendering no panel) outside a live 3D room. Visually the surface has drifted off the design canon nearly everywhere: it styles from the legacy T.color palette instead of libraryTokens, so ink, muted, accent, hairlines and scrims all read colder/harder than sibling Library/Atrium surfaces, and the touch tutorial is still legacy dark bronze-glass. iPad-portrait and several touch targets also miss the coarse-pointer sizing canon. Recommend fixing the dead-action/soft-lock cluster and the P0 reskin before release, then working the P1 canon-reconciliation and touch-target tail.

p0.title: Entire touch-controls overlay is off-canon dark bronze-glass, not CREAM/INK
p0.detail: The card background is a dark smoked-bronze glass that predates the current CREAM #FCFAF5 / INK #403B36 design canon. Every sibling surface (Atrium relay, Library, landing v2) now speaks a light warm-paper language; this touch tutorial pops up over the 3D view as a dark bubble that reads as legacy chrome and clashes with the reskinned app. This is exactly the 'leftover dark bronze-glass' the canon calls out to flag.
p0.recommendation: Reskin to canon: light frosted surface (e.g. rgba(252,250,245,0.9) CREAM glass with blur), border 1px HAIRLINE #E3D6BC, text INK #403B36 / MUTED #716A5E. Drop the umber glass entirely so it matches the Atrium/Library card grammar. Note this cascades: the text tokens, 'Got it' CTA color, diagram tints and shadow must all flip to light-canon values once relit.

p1.title: Add Memory / Write Story actions are dead (silent no-op) in Atrium & Library modes and in 3D exterior/entrance
p1.detail: useActions exposes addMemory and writeStory in the content group, so they appear in UniversalActions in EVERY mode (atrium return line 1157, library return line 1170, 3D line 1217). Both handlers do setShowUpload(true), but UploadPanel is rendered ONLY in the 3D return branch and only when activeRoomId is truthy (line 1293); it is NOT in sharedPanelOverlays. Tapping Add Memory or Write Story from Atrium or Library — or in 3D when view is exterior/entrance (activeRoomId null) — sets showUpload=true and renders nothing at all.
p1.recommendation: Either add a mode/room-agnostic UploadPanel to sharedPanelOverlays with a sensible default room target, or in onAddMemory/onWriteStory navigate to a room first (setNavMode('3d') + enterWingRoom(activeWing||'roots', default room)) before setShowUpload(true), mirroring the TrackDetailPanel 'upload' case. At minimum guard the action so it isn't offered when it cannot render.

p1.title: Opening Upload in 3D exterior/entrance soft-locks the UI (nav hidden, no panel)
p1.detail: In 3D mode both NavigationBar (line 1215) and PalaceSubNav (line 1229) are hidden whenever showUpload is true (hidden={!!selMem || showUpload || showSharing || walkthroughActive}). But UploadPanel only renders when activeRoomId is set (line 1293). If showUpload becomes true while view is exterior or entrance (activeRoomId null) — reachable via the always-available Add Memory action — the user is left with both nav bars hidden AND no upload panel: a stuck screen with no visible way back until an external event flips showUpload.
p1.recommendation: Only hide the nav/sub-nav when the panel actually mounts: hidden={!!selMem || (showUpload && !!activeRoomId) || (showSharing && !!activeRoomId) || walkthroughActive}. The identical activeRoomId-guarded render for Share (line 1306) needs the same fix.

p1.title: Share Room action is a silent no-op outside a live 3D room
p1.detail: onShareRoom (line 350) does setShowSharing(true) and is present in UniversalActions in all modes. SharingPanel renders only in the 3D return and only when activeRoomId is set (line 1306), and is absent from sharedPanelOverlays. So Share Room from Atrium/Library, or from 3D exterior/entrance, does nothing (and additionally hides the 3D nav bars per the soft-lock finding).
p1.recommendation: Route Share Room to a room first when none is active (as the TrackDetailPanel 'share' case already does: enter a default room then setShowSharing after a delay), or disable/hide the Share Room action when activeRoomId is null so it never presents as a dead control.

p1.title: Corridor picker stale-closure race silently drops a just-assigned painting
p1.detail: handleAssign/handleUpload are useCallback-memoized over `paintings` and spread `...paintings` to build the next map. The picker is intentionally kept open after an assignment. handleUpload's async FileReader.onload closure captures the `paintings` value from when the button was clicked; if the user assigns a mem (updating state) and THEN an in-flight upload's onload fires, it spreads the STALE paintings and silently drops the just-assigned painting.
p1.recommendation: Use the functional-updater form of setPaintings(prev => ...) inside handleAssign/handleUpload/handleClear and persist from the computed `next`, removing `paintings` from the dependency arrays. This eliminates the stale-snapshot race entirely.

p1.title: currentPaintings prop only seeds initial state — external changes never propagate into the open panel
p1.detail: useState is initialized with currentPaintings and there is NO useEffect syncing later prop changes (useEffect is imported at line 2 but never used, suggesting a sync effect was dropped in the overhaul). If the parent re-derives corridor paintings while the panel is mounted (memory deleted/moved, or handleResetAll elsewhere), the panel keeps its stale copy. Deleting the underlying memory does not clear the override either — the override keeps a copied dataUrl, so a removed photo can still hang on a corridor wall.
p1.recommendation: Add useEffect(() => setPaintings(currentPaintings), [currentPaintings]) (or key the panel on wing.id) so external updates flow in, and remove the unused import if truly not needed.

p1.title: Editing a wing then tapping icon/color swatch discards the typed name & subtitle
p1.detail: When a wing row is in edit mode, the name <input> has NO onBlur handler (only the subtitle <textarea> saves onBlur). The icon and accent-swatch button onClick handlers both call setEditingId(null) directly without saveEdit. So if a user types a new wing name (or subtitle) then taps the icon or color swatch, the in-progress rename/description is silently dropped and never persisted. The only save paths are form submit (Enter in name field) or the textarea losing focus.
p1.recommendation: Call saveEdit(wing.id) before setEditingId(null) in the icon and color-swatch onClick handlers, and add onBlur={() => saveEdit(wing.id)} to the name <input> so committing works consistently regardless of how focus leaves the field.

p1.title: EntranceHallScene missing joystick guard → double-move-control conflict in bottom-left
p1.detail: The MobileJoystick renders on the entrance view and sits in the bottom-left corner. CorridorScene (line 1643) and InteriorScene (line 2221) disable their native left-side move zone whenever the joystick is mounted, via the guard `&& !document.querySelector('[data-mp-joystick]')`. EntranceHallScene's equivalent onTS handler OMITS that guard, so its native left-move zone (rx<0.25 && ry>0.75) is live in the exact region as the joystick. Touches that land bottom-left but miss the round joystick puck get captured by the scene's native move handler, producing two competing movement mechanisms and inconsistent behavior versus corridor/room.
p1.recommendation: Add the same guard the other two scenes use: `if (rx < 0.25 && ry > 0.75 && touchMoveId === null && !document.querySelector('[data-mp-joystick]'))` so movement defers to the joystick on entrance exactly as in corridor/room.

p1.title: Room split-screen tutorial diagram is effectively unreachable — single shared LS key set by an earlier view
p1.detail: TouchControlsOverlay uses one shared localStorage flag LS_KEY='mp_touch_tutorial_seen' set on the first dismissal of ANY view's tutorial (line 26), firing for corridor, room and entrance. The only branch that renders the move/look diagram is the room branch (line 78). But real navigation order is exterior→entrance→corridor→room, so the entrance/corridor tutorial fires and permanently sets the key first (via the 5s auto-dismiss timer or Got it). By the time the user reaches a room the key is truthy and the room tutorial — the only one with the actual diagram — never shows.
p1.recommendation: Use per-context keys (mp_touch_tutorial_seen_corridor and mp_touch_tutorial_seen_room), or gate the shared key so the room diagram is guaranteed to show once on first room entry independent of the corridor/entrance hint.

p1.title: Corridor picker modal has no focus trap, no aria-modal, no Escape handler
p1.detail: When a painting slot is tapped, a second full-screen overlay (pickingSlot) renders on top of the already-open drawer. Unlike the parent drawer it has no role='dialog', no aria-modal, no useFocusTrap, and no Escape-to-close handler. Keyboard/screen-reader users can tab out to the obscured drawer behind it, and Escape does not dismiss it (only a background click does). This is the primary interaction surface for choosing/uploading a painting.
p1.recommendation: Give the inner picker container role='dialog' aria-modal='true' aria-label={t('title')}, wire a second useFocusTrap, and add onKeyDown to close on Escape. Move initial focus to the modal and restore focus to the originating slot button on close.

p1.title: iPad portrait renders the desktop panel with sub-2.75rem touch targets (useIsTablet/useIsCompact never imported)
p1.detail: Both manager panels only consume useIsMobile(), whose MOBILE_QUERY is '(max-width: 767px), (max-height: 500px)'. iPad portrait (768–1024px, coarse pointer) reports DESKTOP, so isMobile=false and the tighter desktop sizing path is taken: standard-icon buttons 2.5rem, emoji buttons 1.75rem, reorder arrows 1.375×1.125rem, color swatches 2rem, panel narrows to min(400px,92vw). A touch user on iPad thus gets fine-pointer-sized controls even though the codebase ships useIsCompact()/useIsTablet() precisely for this case.
p1.recommendation: Import useIsTablet()/useIsCompact() and treat tablet-touch as mobile for SIZING (e.g. const touch = useIsMobile() || useIsTablet()) so iPad-portrait gets >=2.75rem control sizes and the full-width/wider panel.

p1.title: Reorder arrow buttons are below the 2.75rem touch target even on phones
p1.detail: The up/down reorder buttons are 2rem wide × 1.625rem tall in the mobile branch (1.375×1.125rem on desktop). Both dimensions are well under the 2.75rem minimum, and they sit stacked with only 0.125rem gap, making mis-taps likely on a phone — the exact modality where reordering is most needed.
p1.recommendation: Give each reorder button minWidth/minHeight 2.75rem on touch (expand hit area with padding while keeping the glyph small if compactness is desired), or combine into a single-column 2.75rem control.

p1.title: 'Got it' dismiss button is far below the 2.75rem touch-target minimum on a touch-only overlay
p1.detail: The only interactive control in an overlay explicitly built for touch devices is a small button: padding 0.375rem 1.5rem with fontSize 0.75rem yields a hit height of roughly 1.35rem (~21px) — under half the 2.75rem canon minimum, with no min-height/min-width backstop.
p1.recommendation: Add minHeight:'2.75rem' (and adequate minWidth) to the button, or increase vertical padding, so the primary touch action meets the >=2.75rem target on the touch-only surface.

p1.title: Bust name inputs use sub-1rem fontSize → iOS auto-zoom on focus
p1.detail: iOS Safari zooms the viewport when a focused input has computed font-size below 16px (1rem). Both text inputs in BustBuilderPanel set fontSize under 1rem, so tapping the name field on iPhone/iPad jarringly zooms the modal. The canon explicitly requires input fontSize 1rem to prevent this.
p1.recommendation: Set fontSize:'1rem' on both <input> elements (bust-name-plaque line 305 and bust-name-ready line 526). Reduce visual size via padding/height if a smaller footprint is needed, but keep the font at 1rem.

p1.title: Surface styles from legacy T.color palette, not canon libraryTokens — MUTED, EMBER and INK all drift off-canon
p1.detail: The entire Palace 3D surface styles from @/lib/theme's T.color.*, whose values diverge from the canon in src/lib/libraryTokens.ts. Canon MUTED is #716A5E but secondary text uses T.color.muted=#857B70 (lighter, greyer); canon EMBER is #B85C38 but the accent/CTA is T.color.terracotta=#C66B3D (more orange); canon INK is #403B36 but primary text uses T.color.charcoal=#1F1B1A (near-black). Subtle but pervasive — every toast, modal and pill reads slightly colder/harder than sibling canon surfaces.
p1.recommendation: Reconcile the two token systems: realign T.color.muted→#716A5E, add a canon EMBER (#B85C38) for interactive accents, and soften charcoal→INK #403B36; or migrate the surface's user-facing chrome (toasts, era picker, storage prompt) to import from libraryTokens directly.

p1.title: Modal/overlay scrims use cold black/neutral rgba instead of the warm-ink rgba(64,59,54,x) grammar
p1.detail: Canon scrims are one warm ink rgba(64,59,54,x). Several overlays use cold/off-hue scrims: DelayedFallback spinner backdrop is pure black rgba(0,0,0,.3) with a white spinner; era-picker backdrop rgba(44,44,42,.6); storage-full prompt rgba(44,44,42,.5); track-celebration rgba(42,34,24,.5). The pure-black fallback in particular looks generic and off-brand.
p1.recommendation: Standardize all scrims to rgba(64,59,54,0.5-0.6) and recolor the DelayedFallback spinner to a warm-ink/ember ring on a warm-ink scrim so lazy-load flashes stay on-brand.

p1.title: GOLD spent on generic media buttons — violates the palace-only gold rule
p1.detail: Canon reserves GOLD #D4AF37 for 'the palace itself' (wing seals, focus rings, on-this-day frames, sealed time-capsule) — 'Never spend gold on a generic button, filter, divider or accent.' Here the AV-remote play triangle is stroked in T.color.gold and the corridor media-pill grid icon is filled with T.color.gold. These are generic utility buttons, not ceremonial palace elements. (The room media pill correctly falls back to the wing accent first.)
p1.recommendation: Recolor these utility icons to the wing accent (wingData.accent) or terracotta/ember interactive ink, matching the room media pill's accent-first pattern. Reserve gold for seals/focus/frames only.

p1.title: Off-canon text ink: charcoal #1F1B1A instead of canon INK #403B36 in room/wing managers
p1.detail: Every heading, room/wing name and input text uses T.color.charcoal, which theme.ts defines as #1F1B1A (near-black). The canon specifies INK #403B36 (the warm dark ink used across Atrium/Library via libraryTokens.INK). The result is a colder, harder text tone than sibling surfaces, breaking visual consistency across the palace.
p1.recommendation: Switch text fills from T.color.charcoal to canon INK #403B36 (import from libraryTokens or add an ink token) so both managers match the Atrium/Library ink tone.

p1.title: Hairlines rendered in CREAM (#FCFAF5) instead of canon HAIRLINE #E3D6BC — borders nearly invisible
p1.detail: Card borders, the close button, icon-picker chrome and reorder buttons all use `1px solid ${T.color.cream}` where cream is #FCFAF5 (the background). On the linen panel (#F2EDE4) a cream border has almost no contrast, so room/wing cards lose their defined edge. Canon prescribes HAIRLINE #E3D6BC for 1px borders.
p1.recommendation: Replace T.color.cream border colors with canon HAIRLINE #E3D6BC so cards read as crisp warm-tan hairline cards like the Library/Atrium surfaces.

p1.title: Bust builder status pills use fully off-canon green/orange Material palette
p1.detail: The face-calibration feedback banner is styled from hardcoded module constants nowhere in the warm palette: cool clinical green (#E8F5E4/#A5D6A0/#2E7D32) for success and Material-orange (#FFF3E0/#FFB74D/#E65100) for warning. These read as generic Material Design toasts and clash with the cream/terracotta surface around them. Canon has SAGE (#56683C) for positive and EMBER/rustDeep for caution.
p1.recommendation: Replace both constants with warm-canon tokens: success from SAGE (#56683C on a rustTint/sage-tint bg), warning from EMBER (#B85C38 on creamGlow/rustTint), with warm-ink hairline borders. Derive from T.color/libraryTokens rather than free hex.

p1.title: Leftover dark bronze gradient in the renaissance bust silhouette
p1.detail: The 'creating' stage draws a bust-body silhouette whose renaissance variant is a dark bronze gradient (#6A5840 → #5A4830) — exactly the 'leftover dark bronze-glass' the canon flags: a muddy near-brown block on the cream linen dialog. The roman variant beside it (#E8E0D4 → #D8D0C4) reads fine, so the renaissance branch stands out as an un-reskinned relic.
p1.recommendation: Re-tone the renaissance silhouette to a warm patinated bronze in the palette (e.g. T.color.walnut → a lighter sandstone, or a rustDeep-derived warm ramp) so the loading illustration stays inside the cream/terracotta family.

p1.title: Touch-tutorial text uses legacy linen token + hardcoded white rgbas, not canon INK/MUTED
p1.detail: All copy is drawn with T.color.linen (#F2EDE4) and ad-hoc rgba(250,250,247,x) values because the panel is dark. None of the canon text tokens (INK #403B36, MUTED #716A5E, CREAM #FCFAF5) appear. Once the panel is relit to canon these must flip to dark ink so contrast and palette are correct.
p1.recommendation: Replace linen/white rgbas with INK for primary hint text and MUTED for the move/look labels once the surface is light; import from libraryTokens.ts instead of hand-rolling opacities.

p1.title: 'Got it' button is translucent white glass, not the EMBER CTA
p1.detail: The primary dismiss action uses a low-contrast frosted-white pill. Canon reserves EMBER #B85C38 for interactive/CTA affordances; the app's other confirm buttons are ember-filled or ember-outlined. A ghost-white pill on dark glass is both off-canon and low-affordance.
p1.recommendation: Make it an EMBER #B85C38 filled pill (CREAM text) or an EMBER-outlined pill on the relit light surface, matching the app's standard confirm button.

p2plus.title: Hairline and accent borders declared in px, not rem
p2plus.recommendation: Convert to rem: 1.5px→0.09375rem, 2px→0.125rem, to match the media pills' 0.0625rem hairlines and the rem discipline used everywhere else.

p2plus.title: Storage-full CTA gradient uses terracotta→walnut with white text, off canon EMBER CTA
p2plus.recommendation: Use a solid EMBER (#B85C38) or ember→rustDeep (#9A4F2A) gradient with CREAM (#FCFAF5) text, aligning with the canon interactive color.

p2plus.title: Toast/celebration box-shadows use bespoke tinted rgba instead of canon warm-ink SHADOW ramp
p2plus.recommendation: Replace bespoke shadow tints with SHADOW[2]/HOVER_SHADOW from libraryTokens (rgba(64,59,54,x)) so all elevation shares one warm-ink shadow language.

p2plus.title: Track 'Explore Wings' navigation lands in the Entrance Hall, not the wing corridor
p2plus.recommendation: If the intent is the wing corridor, change the track 'wings' case to enterCorridor(wing); if the intent is the wing-picker hub, use enterEntrance() and drop the misleading activeWing set. Consider removing/renaming enterWing.

p2plus.title: Onboarding-finish error toast and generic error message are hardcoded English strings
p2plus.recommendation: Replace the literal with a translated string, e.g. tPalace('onboardingFinishError') added to en/nl/de/es/fr.

p2plus.title: No reduced-motion guard on the palace's continuous/flash animations
p2plus.recommendation: Wrap transition/pulse/flash animations in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) or read a useReducedMotion() hook to drop animation on the portalAnim flash and toast entrances.

p2plus.title: MobileJoystick control geometry is hardcoded in px, not rem
p2plus.recommendation: Drive the SVG/knob from the same rem base as the container, or keep touch math in the element's measured getBoundingClientRect so it scales with the container.

p2plus.title: Portal-flash and media-pill glass tints predate the canon and read as leftover warm-glass chrome
p2plus.recommendation: Acceptable over a live 3D canvas where glass aids legibility, but tie the amber portal flash to GOLD (#D4AF37) and the glass border to HAIRLINE-derived alpha so HUD tokens trace back to canon.

p2plus.title: moreMenuOpen gate is permanently false — dead state
p2plus.recommendation: Remove the unused moreMenuOpen state and the !moreMenuOpen term from the joystick visible expression, or wire setMoreMenuOpen to whatever menu was supposed to gate the joystick.

p2plus.title: MemoryMap onNavigate wing inference silently defaults custom rooms to 'roots'
p2plus.recommendation: Resolve the wing from the actual room store (find the wing owning roomId via getWingRooms/customRooms) instead of a fixed prefix table, and factor the duplicated inference into one helper.

p2plus.title: Era-picker style choice lacks radiogroup semantics and uses a px border
p2plus.recommendation: Wrap the two era buttons in role='radiogroup', give each role='radio' with aria-checked reflecting styleEra, and convert the 2px border to 0.125rem.

p2plus.title: Fallback English literals inline in storage-full copy
p2plus.recommendation: Drop the `|| '...'` English fallbacks now that the keys are complete, so a future missing key surfaces during QA instead of masquerading as English copy.

p2plus.title: Muted secondary text off-canon (#857B70 vs canon MUTED #716A5E)
p2plus.recommendation: Map T.color.muted usages here to canon MUTED #716A5E for consistent secondary-text tone across managers.

p2plus.title: Interactive/CTA color is terracotta #C66B3D, not canon EMBER #B85C38
p2plus.recommendation: Use canon EMBER #B85C38 for interactive/CTA states (Add button, selected-icon rings) instead of T.color.terracotta.

p2plus.title: GOLD spent on a generic Add-Wing affordance (canon says palace-only)
p2plus.recommendation: Replace the gold dashed border with EMBER or the wing accent (matching RoomManagerPanel's add-room dashed border) to respect the gold-is-palace-only rule.

p2plus.title: Hardcoded off-canon hex + non-warm shadows (ERROR_BG #FDF0F0, rgba(0,0,0,.12))
p2plus.recommendation: Derive the delete strip bg from T.color.error at low alpha (as WingManagerPanel does with `${T.color.error}08`) and switch swatch/card shadows to warm-ink rgba(64,59,54,x).

p2plus.title: 'Max wings reached' state shows no feedback — Add Wing block disappears entirely
p2plus.recommendation: Add an else branch rendering a 'maximum wings reached' message (mirroring RoomManagerPanel's maxRoomsReached), or keep the counter visible and only disable/hide the input.

p2plus.title: Emoji-preset picker buttons under-sized for touch (2.25rem mobile / 1.75rem desktop)
p2plus.recommendation: Raise emoji cell size to >=2.75rem on touch (fewer columns if needed) so each swatch meets the tap-target floor; keep glyph fontSize as-is.

p2plus.title: Accent color swatch (per-wing) is 1.75rem with no minimum — a primary control under target on all devices
p2plus.recommendation: Enforce minWidth/minHeight 2.75rem on the swatch button (keep the colored dot smaller via an inner span) so the tap area meets the target.

p2plus.title: Single-select icon/color pickers lack radiogroup/aria semantics
p2plus.recommendation: Wrap each picker in role='radiogroup' with an accessible label, give each option role='radio' aria-checked; add aria-expanded to the customEmoji disclosure button.

p2plus.title: Panel entrance animations have no prefers-reduced-motion guard
p2plus.recommendation: Wrap the keyframe/animation in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){ animation: none } inside the injected <style>, or gate on a usePrefersReducedMotion() check.

p2plus.title: rem-unit inconsistency: WingManager add-input uses px font-size while RoomManager uses rem
p2plus.recommendation: Change the Add-Wing input to fontSize:'1rem' to match RoomManagerPanel inputs and the rem-only canon.

p2plus.title: Overlay scrim uses off-canon umber rgba(42,34,24,.4) rather than warm-ink
p2plus.recommendation: Standardize the scrim on the shared warm-ink modal-overlay token, e.g. rgba(64,59,54,.4).

p2plus.title: Room rename via Enter double-fires saveEdit (form submit + input onBlur)
p2plus.recommendation: Guard saveEdit against double invocation (early-return if editingId !== id) or drop the onBlur in favor of the form submit plus an explicit blur-commit only when editing is active.

p2plus.title: Shared showEmoji state means emoji section state leaks across pickers
p2plus.recommendation: Reset setShowEmoji(false) when a picker opens/closes, or scope the expand state per-picker, so the emoji drawer always opens collapsed.

p2plus.title: Custom wing rooms use emoji icon id that RoomIcon may not resolve to an SVG
p2plus.recommendation: Verify RoomIcon renders arbitrary emoji strings as text fallback; if not, seed custom-wing default rooms with a valid ROOM_ICON_MAP key (e.g. 'ro1').

p2plus.title: Room-list rename target caret glyphs lack scalable hit padding on touch
p2plus.recommendation: Increase the rename row's vertical padding (or min-height) toward 2.75rem on touch so the rename tap target is comfortable on phones.

p2plus.title: Primary bust CTAs use terracotta→walnut gradient instead of canon EMBER interactive color
p2plus.recommendation: Swap the CTA fill to flat EMBER #B85C38 or the landing ctaGrad (linear-gradient(135deg,#9A4F2A,#6B3318)) so bust builder buttons match the ember CTA convention.

p2plus.title: Off-canon near-black text + pure-black overlays instead of warm ink in bust builder
p2plus.recommendation: Route text to INK #403B36 (T.color.inkSoft), secondary to MUTED #716A5E; recolor every scrim/shadow to warm-ink rgba(64,59,54,x). Replace rgba(0,0,0,*) with warm equivalents.

p2plus.title: Hairline borders use CREAM instead of canon HAIRLINE in corridor gallery
p2plus.recommendation: Standardize hairline borders on canon HAIRLINE #E3D6BC across both panels so slot tiles and modal edges are visible; reserve cream for fills only.

p2plus.title: Emoji camera glyph as the upload illustration breaks the icon system
p2plus.recommendation: Replace the camera emoji and inline check/warning glyphs with stroked SVG icons (camera/upload in EMBER/accent, check/warning in SAGE/EMBER) matching the app's icon system.

p2plus.title: Corridor gallery lists source memories by raw mem.title, ignoring titleKey — seeded memories show untranslated English
p2plus.recommendation: Resolve the display title via titleKey when present (mirror the room-name pattern: `(mem.titleKey && t(mem.titleKey)) || mem.title`).

p2plus.title: Bust preview WebGL renderer not disposed if the panel unmounts before/during the 'done' transition
p2plus.recommendation: Call el.__cleanup() at the START of renderBustPreview before creating a new renderer, and force GL context loss (renderer.forceContextLoss()) in cleanup; hold the renderer in a ref disposed in a stage-scoped effect.

p2plus.title: handleCreate has no guard on croppedFace failure — silently builds a bust from an un-cropped preview; objectURL leak
p2plus.recommendation: Revoke the previous objectURL when replacing preview and on unmount (track in a ref, URL.revokeObjectURL on cleanup/next upload); add a guard on croppedFace failure.

p2plus.title: Reset-all clears overrides but does not restore DEFAULT_CORRIDOR_PAINTINGS, contradicting the 'Reset to defaults' label
p2plus.recommendation: Reset to defaults: use `const def = DEFAULT_CORRIDOR_PAINTINGS[wing.id] ? {...DEFAULT_CORRIDOR_PAINTINGS[wing.id]} : {}` and save/emit that; or remove the localStorage key so loadCorridorPaintings re-applies defaults.

p2plus.title: Remove-painting control is a role=button span nested inside a button and below 2.75rem touch target
p2plus.recommendation: Render the slot as a non-button container with two sibling <button>s (choose + remove), or move remove into the picker modal; make remove a real <button> with hit-slop >=2.75rem.

p2plus.title: Source filter (all/wing) buttons lack radiogroup/aria-pressed semantics; no-op ternary in grid columns
p2plus.recommendation: Wrap filter buttons in role='radiogroup' with each role='radio' aria-checked (or add aria-pressed). Also gridTemplateColumns repeat(${isMobile?2:2},1fr) is a no-op ternary — simplify or make mobile 1 column.

p2plus.title: Corridor animations run without prefers-reduced-motion guards
p2plus.recommendation: Gate animations behind a prefers-reduced-motion check so entrance slides and infinite pulses are disabled when the OS requests reduced motion.

p2plus.title: Picker upload/filter buttons use minHeight 2.5rem, below 2.75rem touch minimum
p2plus.recommendation: Raise minHeight to 2.75rem for the upload and filter buttons.

p2plus.title: Bust profile persistence best-effort .catch(()=>{}) swallows all server failures with no user feedback
p2plus.recommendation: Capture the rejection and surface a non-blocking warning ('Saved locally — will sync when online') or set stage='error' on hard failure.

p2plus.title: Calibration status messages from detectAndCropFace are hardcoded English, shown verbatim in Ready stage
p2plus.recommendation: Return a message key/enum from detectAndCropFace and translate in the component via t(), rather than returning localized prose from the 3D util.

p2plus.title: 3D bust preview renders at fixed pixels, ignoring the rem/responsive canon
p2plus.recommendation: Derive renderer size from the container's measured clientWidth/clientHeight (or root font-size) so the WebGL preview scales with rem/accessibility zoom.

p2plus.title: No visible focus ring on corridor slot tiles / picker rows / chips
p2plus.recommendation: Add the canon gold :focus-visible ring (libraryTokens focusRing) to tile buttons, picker rows, filter chips, close buttons and CTAs in both panels.

p2plus.title: No useIsPortrait/orientation handling in either corridor panel despite canon toolkit
p2plus.recommendation: Use useIsPortrait() to switch the ready-stage crop preview to a vertical stack in portrait and tighten vertical padding in landscape, reducing scroll on short viewports.

p2plus.title: Touch-tutorial box shadow is a cold grey, not the canon warm-ink shadow
p2plus.recommendation: Use canon SHADOW.2 = '0 0.5rem 1.5rem rgba(64,59,54,0.14)' (or HOVER_SHADOW) and express offset/blur in rem not px.

p2plus.title: Diagram tint colors are off-token approximations of SAGE/EMBER
p2plus.recommendation: Derive the two halves from canon SAGE #56683C and EMBER #B85C38 (apply opacity to those exact hex) so the movement/camera coding matches the palette.

p2plus.title: fadeUp entrance animation has no reduced-motion guard
p2plus.recommendation: Gate the animation behind a prefers-reduced-motion check, consistent with the motion tokens in T.motion.

p2plus.title: mobileHint copy describes split-screen controls but the room actually ships a joystick
p2plus.recommendation: Reword to reflect the joystick (e.g. 'Joystick to move · Drag to look · Tap memories to view') across all five locales, or decide on one input model and align copy + diagram to it.

p2plus.title: Joystick knob math uses hardcoded px radii while the element is sized in rem
p2plus.recommendation: Derive OUTER_R from the measured element via getBoundingClientRect() (rect.width/2) captured in handleTouchStart, so the math tracks the actual rendered size at any root font-size.

p2plus.title: Overlay not announced to assistive tech (no role/aria-live); decorative SVGs not hidden
p2plus.recommendation: Add role='status' aria-live='polite' to the outer overlay div and aria-hidden='true' to both decorative SVGs so only translated text/labels are read.

p2plus.title: Hint selection keys on view type, not modality — 'desktopHint' shown on touch corridor/entrance
p2plus.recommendation: Rename keys to reflect the real axis (corridorHint/roomHint) so the touch-vs-view distinction is explicit and edits can't surface desktop-only guidance on the touch-only overlay.

p2plus.title: Auto-dismiss on a 5s timer with no reduced-motion / cognitive pacing accommodation
p2plus.recommendation: Persist LS_KEY only on explicit user dismiss (not the timeout), lengthen/remove the auto-timer under prefers-reduced-motion, and/or pause the timer while the overlay has focus.

p2plus.title: Joystick stays visible during room tour even while blocking panels are open
p2plus.recommendation: Combine the guards, e.g. visible={(roomTourOpen || !selMem) && !showUpload && !showSharing && !moreMenuOpen} so open panels always hide the joystick.

p2plus.title: Tutorial i18n key names (desktopHint) shown to touch users are misleading maintenance hazards
p2plus.recommendation: Rename keys to intent-neutral names (corridorHint/roomHint) since this overlay is always a touch overlay.

p2plus.title: Sub-canon micro type sizes for the move/look labels
p2plus.recommendation: Raise the move/look labels to at least the canon overline size 0.6875rem with a small-caps/tracked treatment to match RT.overline.

p2plus.title: Raw pixel values in SVG diagram + mixed px units
p2plus.recommendation: Size the icon wrappers in rem and keep only true 1px hairlines in px; align stroke colors to INK/MUTED once the surface is light.

p2plus.title: Instruction glyph labels ('Move'/'Look') sit at 0.5625rem — near-illegible on small screens
p2plus.recommendation: Raise the caption toward >=0.75rem and consider higher-opacity text for legibility, since these are functional labels.

strengths: Consistent, disciplined rem-based sizing throughout the enormous render tree (heights, paddings, radii, font-sizes all in rem), with px reserved almost exclusively for hairline borders — strong adherence to the units rule.

Responsiveness done correctly via inline styles keyed off isMobile/touchControls hooks and safe-area env() insets on all fixed chrome (AV pill, media pills, toasts) — zero @media queries, honoring the iOS-seal canon.
Typography is coherent: Fraunces for titles/headings and Source Sans for body/meta across every modal, toast and pill — matches the canon font pairing.
Core touch targets are respected where present: AV pill height/minWidth 2.75rem and achievement icon 2.75rem meet the >=2.75rem rule.

Loading/error states are polished and on-brand — PalaceLoadingScreen uses a warm sandstone-linen gradient, the palace mark, and italic loading phrases; scene overlay fade choreography is carefully tuned.

Robust scene-loading state machine (showSceneOverlay/hideSceneOverlay/handleSceneReady with sync ref mirrors, per-transition fade timing, fixed-timer safety fallbacks) dismisses precisely on onReady yet can never get permanently stuck.

Onboarding tri-state gate correctly prevents a returning account from being re-onboarded on a slow/failed profile fetch, and handleFinishOnboarding is atomic (keeps wizard mounted if finishOnboarding() throws).
Paywall/IAP gating is correct throughout: storage-full upgrade CTA uses (!isNative() || (isIOS() && IAP_ENABLED)) and StorageBanner self-gates — no Stripe leak on iOS, no dead CTA on Android.

palaceStore.fade() cleanly supersedes in-flight transitions (clears prior _timer and cancelAnimationFrame) with a done-guard, so rapid double navigation cannot double-apply a view change or leak timers.

Browser back/forward is wired end-to-end (pushState on navMode/showSettings, popstate restore, initial-path reconciliation via replaceState) and deep-link entry paths are handled (kep_navigate, ?help, ?mode, ?notifications) with per-path cleanup.
Good a11y-adjacent visual polish: :focus-visible gold outlines on era buttons and layout selects, role=dialog/status semantics, hover-only affordances gated behind !isMobile.

areas.summary: The Import area is close to shippable but not yet clean: ImportHub itself is exemplary canon (inline Atrium tokens, Tuscan SVG line-art, gold-focus discipline, layered file-size guarding, blob-URL revocation), yet the three sibling panels it launches (Upload/Mass/Cloud) drift off it in visible ways. Two P1s are pure cohesion regressions (colder-brown scrim vs warm-ink, emoji vs terracotta line-art) and three are functional/mobile defects: a manual-mode mass import that lands on an empty Review tab, sub-16px selects that trigger iOS auto-zoom, and an under-44px queue-remove target. None are P0 (no data loss or hard blocker), but the manual-review emptiness and iOS-zoom issues will read as broken to real users, so this needs a P1 pass before it feels premium. Multimodal readiness lags design/function slightly due to the mobile touch-target and select-zoom defects concentrated in the mass/cloud flows.

p1.title: Sibling panels use an off-canon backdrop scrim (colder brown) while ImportHub uses the correct warm-ink
p1.detail: Canon warm-ink scrim is rgba(64,59,54,x); ImportHub uses rgba(64,59,54,0.55). Verified: UploadPanel L171 background rgba(42,34,24,.4), MassImportPanel L270 rgba(42,34,24,.5), CloudImportPanel L828 rgba(42,34,24,.5) — a colder/browner ink. Opening the hub then a child panel visibly shifts the scrim hue, breaking cohesion on one surface.
p1.recommendation: Replace rgba(42,34,24,.4/.5) with the canon warm-ink scrim rgba(64,59,54,0.55) in all three panels so every layer of the Import surface shares one scrim.

p1.title: Heavy emoji usage breaks the Tuscan line-art icon language ImportHub established
p1.detail: ImportHub renders clean Roman/Tuscan SVG line-art in canon terracotta #9A4F2A (DropZoneIcon, ComputerIcon, CloudIcon). The siblings lean on OS color emoji for the same affordances: UploadPanel drop-zone 📸/✨, GPS 📍, context 🌍, take-photo 📷; MassImportPanel 📦 header chip, 📥/✨ drop-zone, 🚀 process CTA, 🎉 done, 🏛️ commit CTA. Emoji render multicolor/non-terracotta, sit off the type baseline, and look markedly less ceremonial than the SVG hub they launch from.
p1.recommendation: Swap the emoji for the same terracotta-stroke SVG line-art vocabulary used in ImportHub (or the TypeIcon set) so the whole Import surface speaks one glyph language.

p1.title: Manual-mode mass import lands on an empty Review tab (items hidden by default)
p1.detail: Verified: the non-AI branch marks every ready item needsReview:false (L204: store.updateItem(item.localId, { status:'ready', needsReview:false })). The Review step opens on tab='review' where filteredItems('review') = items.filter(i => i.status==='ready' && i.needsReview). Because needsReview is false for all manual items, the default Review tab is empty and shows the noItemsInTab empty-state even though every file processed successfully; the user must know to switch to 'All'. Confusing regression for the entire Manual (privacy/no-AI) pipeline.
p1.recommendation: Either set needsReview:true in the manual branch, or default tab to 'all' when store.mode==='manual', or make the review filter fall back to all ready items when the review subset is empty.

p1.title: Target-room select inputs use 0.8125rem font — triggers iOS auto-zoom
p1.detail: iOS Safari/WKWebView zooms the viewport when a focused <select>/<input> has computed font-size below 16px. Verified 0.8125rem is used pervasively in MassImportPanel (30 occurrences). The wing/room destination selects (drop step L405/416 and ReviewCard L754/764/773) and both CloudImportPanel selects (L748/773) are 0.8125rem, so tapping them on iPhone/iPad zooms and reflows the modal. ImportHub's own selects correctly use isMobile?'1rem'.
p1.recommendation: Raise select fontSize to isMobile?'1rem':'0.8125rem' in the MassImportPanel target/ReviewCard selects and the CloudImportPanel target selects; the sibling text inputs already use 1rem — mirror that.

p1.title: ImportHub queue remove button is 1.25rem — far below 2.75rem touch minimum
p1.detail: The per-thumbnail delete button in the preview queue is a 1.25rem x 1.25rem circle with a 0.875rem trash glyph (~20px), well under the 44px/2.75rem touch target. On mobile the drag zone is hidden and the file-picker queue is the primary flow, so users must hit a tiny target to remove a wrongly-added photo. The header close button (icon 1.25rem + 0.25rem padding ~1.75rem) is likewise under 2.75rem.
p1.recommendation: On mobile give the remove button a >=2.75rem hit area (enlarge or wrap with padding / an invisible expanded tap zone) and bump the header close button to minWidth/minHeight 2.75rem as UploadPanel does.

p2plus.title: Close controls use a raw text '✕' character instead of the shared SVG CloseIcon
p2plus.recommendation: Extract ImportHub's CloseIcon into a shared component and use it for every close button; standardize the ghost-button treatment (transparent bg, muted->ink on hover).

p2plus.title: UploadPanel accent falls back to off-canon T.color.terracotta (#C66B3D)
p2plus.recommendation: Change the fallback to canon EMBER #B85C38 (or EMBER_GLYPH #9A4F2A) so the panel never renders the off-canon #C66B3D.

p2plus.title: CloudImportPanel 'loading accounts' state is bare text with no spinner, unlike its other loading states
p2plus.recommendation: Reuse the existing cloudSpin spinner (defined L678) in the loadingAccounts state for a consistent, animated first impression.

p2plus.title: Processing progress bar can stall below 100% because errored files are never counted as processed
p2plus.recommendation: Increment processed in the catch branch too, or compute completion as (processed + errors)/total for the bar and aria-valuenow.

p2plus.title: handleImportAll swallows import errors and closes the modal, losing the user's queue on failure
p2plus.recommendation: On catch, keep the modal open, retain the queue, and show an inline error surfacing the caught error; only clearQueue()/onClose() on success.

p2plus.title: CloudImportPanel user plan fetched via .single() errors (stays 'free') for users with zero subscription rows
p2plus.recommendation: Use .maybeSingle() so a missing row returns null without error; surface genuine query errors instead of silently defaulting to free (which gates paid users out of Keeper providers).

p2plus.title: UploadPanel drawer width uses raw px (min(380px,92vw)) instead of rem
p2plus.recommendation: Convert to rem: width isMobile?'100%':'min(23.75rem, 92vw)' so it respects root-font scaling and matches canon.

p2plus.title: UploadPanel URL 'Load' button and demo-image buttons are below 2.75rem touch target
p2plus.recommendation: Add minHeight:'2.75rem' (and slightly larger padding on mobile) to the URL Load button and demo buttons to meet the touch-target minimum.

p2plus.title: Two different terracotta oranges used interchangeably for the same at-rest accent role
p2plus.recommendation: Keep the values but add a comment (or use the named EMBER/EMBER_GLYPH tokens) so the rest-vs-interactive split is legible and cannot drift.

p2plus.title: ImportHub cloud provider brand-color SVGs sit against the muted Tuscan palette
p2plus.recommendation: Acceptable for recognizability, but consider a consistent chip framing (brand mark in a hairline pill) so loud brand colors read as intentional badges; align CloudImportPanel to the same treatment.

p2plus.title: ImportHub per-file status UI (uploading spinner / done check) is dead — status never advances
p2plus.recommendation: Either drive real per-item status from the import callback or remove the dead uploading/done/progress UI to avoid maintenance confusion.

p2plus.title: Drag-enter file size is hard-coded to 0, so the drop-count line never shows size and totals are meaningless
p2plus.recommendation: Drop the size field from dragFileInfo (only count is knowable at dragenter), or compute size on drop where dataTransfer.files is available.

p2plus.title: Cloud import EXIF geolocation/date pulled from AI but manual review has no editable date field
p2plus.recommendation: Optionally add an editable date field to the ReviewCard, or surface the resolved createdAt so users can correct it before commit.

p2plus.title: Cloud import progress is faked: single batch POST reports totals but no per-item progress and no timeout
p2plus.recommendation: Add an AbortController with a reasonable timeout and a Cancel button that resets importing/importProgress so a stalled cloud import is recoverable.

p2plus.title: ImportHub cloud-provider tab strip and MassImport source toggle can overflow without horizontal scroll on mobile
p2plus.recommendation: On small phones let these strips scroll (overflowX:'auto', flex-wrap, or a scrollable row) as CloudImportPanel's provider tabs already do, to avoid label truncation.

strengths: ImportHub is exemplary: every color is an inline canon hex with a /* Atrium token */ comment (ink #403B36, muted #716A5E, hairline #E3D6BC, ember #B85C38, glyph #9A4F2A, gold #D4AF37 focus), warm-ink shadows rgba(64,59,54,x) at S1/S2, and clean Tuscan SVG line-art.

Consistent, correct gold #D4AF37 focus ring across all four panels via :focus-visible, honoring the 'gold = palace/focus only' rule and never spending gold on buttons (CTAs use the ember->glyph gradient).
Rigorous rem sizing throughout (px only for hairlines/borders), fontSize:1rem on text inputs to prevent iOS zoom, and >=2.75rem touch targets enforced on most buttons/close controls.
Responsiveness done entirely with useIsMobile() inline branching plus env() safe-area insets — no @media layout hacks — matching the house rule.
prefers-reduced-motion is guarded in every panel (animations/transitions disabled), and spinners/progress bars use the canon ember/sage gradients.

MassImport and CloudImport deliberately pre-mix opaque state tints (#EFDCD2, #DDDFD2, #F6EBE3, #FBF2EC) instead of alpha overlays, with explanatory comments — thoughtful adherence to the flat sandstone aesthetic.
Blob object URLs are consistently revoked to avoid leaks: ImportHub on removeFromQueue/clearQueue, MassImportPanel on unmount, and importStore.reset() revokes all blob: URLs.

Layered, correct file-size guarding: MassImportPanel filters oversized files before queueing, tracks a dismissible skippedOversized banner, and readFileAsDataUrl rejects oversized defensively; UploadPanel shows a role=alert size error.

Robust type detection with iOS/HEIC fallbacks: fileToQueued infers MIME from extension when the browser reports empty type, and addFiles accepts by MIME OR extension so empty-type mobile files still queue.

IAP/platform gating is a single source of truth (filterAccountsForPlatform) applied on initial load and retry, using isIOS() && !IAP_ENABLED to restrict to google_photos — matching the approved App Review posture.

Good empty/loading/error coverage in CloudImportPanel: distinct no-accounts, loading-accounts, error-with-retry, loading-files, no-files, and import-complete (skipped-vs-real-error separation) states.
Solid a11y plumbing: focus traps, Escape-to-close, radiogroup/tablist semantics, reduced-motion guards, and Enter/Space handlers on the custom role=button drop zones and grid items.

areas.summary: The Kep area is functionally rich but not production-ready: three confirmed P0 defects break core flows and accessibility. Two P0s cause silent data loss/dead-ends — routeCaptures removes every requested id from the queue even when the server routed nothing (captures vanish with no memory created and no feedback), and the wizard's source cards are non-interactive divs, making the mandatory step-1 gate completely unreachable by keyboard/screen-reader. The design layer systematically diverges from canon across all three surfaces (off-canon terracotta CTAs instead of EMBER, cold charcoal/black shadows instead of warm INK, GOLD misused on generic controls, a stray cold-blue AI callout), and several P1 error paths (create failures, fetch failures, empty WhatsApp env) are swallowed with zero user feedback. Strong rem/typography/responsive discipline and clean i18n coverage give a solid foundation, but the P0s and pervasive canon drift must be resolved before ship.

p0.title: Wizard source cards are click-only divs — no keyboard access, no radiogroup/radio a11y
p0.detail: StepSource renders each source option as a bare <div onClick={...}> with no role, no tabIndex, no onKeyDown, and no aria-checked/aria-selected. Keyboard and screen-reader users cannot select a source, which is the mandatory step-1 gate (isValid requires source_type !== null), so the entire wizard is unusable without a pointer. This is the core multimodal-input control of the surface.
p0.recommendation: Wrap the two options in a container with role="radiogroup" and aria-label, and make each card role="radio" aria-checked={selected} tabIndex={0} with onKeyDown handling Enter/Space (and ideally arrow-key navigation). Add a visible :focus outline (GOLD #D4AF37) so the selection is reachable and visible via keyboard.

p0.title: Routing silently drops captures when the server routes nothing (data desync)
p0.detail: The PATCH /api/keps/pending route loops per capture and `continue`s (skips) any capture that is not found or not in pending/processed status; if a bad/stale room_id is supplied or the captures were already routed, it still returns HTTP 200 with `{ results: [] }`. The store's routeCaptures only checks `res.ok`, then unconditionally removes ALL requested ids from pendingCaptures. Result: captures vanish from the UI as if routed, but no memory was created and their DB status is unchanged — they silently disappear from the user's queue with zero feedback.
p0.recommendation: Have routeCaptures parse the JSON `results` and only remove the ids the server actually reports as routed (and surface a message for the rest). On the API side, distinguish a partial/empty result from full success (e.g. return the skipped ids) rather than always returning 200.

p0.title: Pending page's AI-suggestion box uses off-canon cold blue hex
p0.detail: The AI suggestion callout is styled with a cold sky-blue palette (background #eff6ff, border #bfdbfe) that appears nowhere in the warm Memory Palace canon (CREAM/INK/EMBER/GOLD, warm-ink shadows). A blue box on a cream/terracotta app reads as a stray Tailwind default and instantly breaks the ceremonial warmth of the surface. It sits directly beside sage/terracotta chrome, making the clash obvious.
p0.recommendation: Replace with a warm token treatment: background `${T.color.gold}0D` or `${T.color.sage}12`, border `1px solid ${T.color.gold}35` (mirroring the gold phone-pill pattern already used on keps/page.tsx), so the AI hint feels native to the palace.

p1.title: Interactive CTAs use off-canon terracotta, not EMBER
p1.detail: Canon designates EMBER #B85C38 as the single interactive/CTA color. Every primary action on this surface (Save-number button, step badges, settings link, FAB pulse shadow) instead uses the legacy Tuscan terracotta #C66B3D (C.terracotta). It is a visibly different, more orange hue than EMBER, so the Kep page's calls-to-action read as a different accent than canon sibling surfaces. Note theme.ts even documents the canon value as roman.secondary '#B85C38' but the page never uses it.
p1.recommendation: Introduce/reference an EMBER token (#B85C38) and swap C.terracotta -> EMBER for btnPrimary, StepBadge gradient, settings link color, and the terracotta swatches in the illustrations, so CTAs match canon and sibling surfaces.

p1.title: Headings use near-black charcoal instead of warm INK
p1.detail: Canon INK is warm #403B36 (present in theme as inkSoft). All headings/labels on this surface use C.charcoal #1F1B1A, a cold near-black that clashes with the warm cream/linen palette and reads harsher than canon text on sibling surfaces. Both h1, h2, h3 stepTitle, and SVG stroke colors use charcoal.
p1.recommendation: Use C.inkSoft (#403B36 = canon INK) for all heading/body text; reserve charcoal only for the illustration's intentional dark silhouette fills.

p1.title: Cold rgba(0,0,0) shadows instead of warm-ink shadows
p1.detail: Canon requires warm-ink shadows rgba(64,59,54,x). Every card on this page renders through TuscanCard whose variant shadows are all rgba(0,0,0,x); the StepBadge and fabPulse also mix in shadows. Cold black shadows give the cream surface a grey cast rather than the warm ambient shadow canon prescribes. This is a shared-component issue but is fully visible on this surface.
p1.recommendation: Replace rgba(0,0,0,x) with rgba(64,59,54,x) across TuscanCard variant shadows (and the StepBadge boxShadow which correctly uses terracotta tint) to match canon warm-ink shadows.

p1.title: Off-canon hairline/border colors and hardcoded hex fallbacks
p1.detail: Canon HAIRLINE is #E3D6BC. Borders here use C.lineFaint (#EBE3D4) plus a hardcoded '#e5e2dc' fallback repeated in btnSecondary and the command <code> pills, and TuscanCard borders use C.cream as a border color. None match canon HAIRLINE, so card/pill edges are a lighter, cooler line than sibling surfaces.
p1.recommendation: Add a HAIRLINE token (#E3D6BC) and use it for all 1px borders; remove the hardcoded '#e5e2dc' fallbacks.

p1.title: Empty WhatsApp env var produces a dead CTA and a broken vCard download with no guard
p1.detail: waPhone falls back to "" when NEXT_PUBLIC_KEP_WHATSAPP_NUMBER is unset. In that state the page still renders fully usable-looking controls: the WhatsApp button becomes <a href="#" target="_blank"> which opens a blank new tab, and the primary 'Save' button calls downloadVCard("") which builds a vCard with 'TEL;TYPE=CELL:+' (no number) and downloads a broken Kep-Memory-Palace.vcf. The phone pill also renders empty. handleCopy is the only control that guards emptiness. The var is not present in .env.local/.env.local.example, so this depends entirely on the Vercel prod env being set — if it is ever missing/misnamed, users get silently broken save/message flows rather than a graceful hidden/disabled state.
p1.recommendation: When !waPhone, hide or disable the WhatsApp <a> and the Save/Copy buttons (or render an inline 'Kep is temporarily unavailable' i18n message). At minimum, guard downloadVCard with `if (!phone) return;` and render href={waLink} only when waPhone is truthy so the CTA never opens a blank tab.

p1.title: TuscanCard elevated/glass variants render off-canon white-glass + cool-black shadows under every Kep step card
p1.detail: The panel wraps all four step cards in <TuscanCard variant="elevated"> and the settings card in variant="glass". Those variants are the OLD Tuscan system: elevated = background rgba(255,255,255,0.55) with boxShadow "0 0.5rem 2rem rgba(0,0,0,0.08)" and glass = rgba(255,255,255,0.45). Canon requires warm-ink shadows rgba(64,59,54,x) and warm cream/linen surfaces, not translucent pure-white with rgba(0,0,0) cool-black shadows. So the panel's own carefully-annotated warm-ink shell sits on top of cards that visually break canon.
p1.recommendation: Either introduce a canon variant (solid cream #FCFAF5 / linen surface, HAIRLINE border, warm-ink rgba(64,59,54,x) shadows) and switch the Kep step/settings cards to it, or restyle these cards with plain inline warm-ink styles matching the panel shell instead of the legacy glass variants.

p1.title: Settings card carries a permanent GOLD top border on a generic control — direct canon violation
p1.detail: The "Settings link" card uses variant="glass", and TuscanCard's glass variant hardcodes borderTop: 2px solid T.color.gold (#D4AF37). Canon THE ONE RULE: GOLD is palace-only (wing seals, focus rings, on-this-day, sealed capsule) and must never be spent on a generic button/filter/divider/accent. A settings-connection helper card is exactly a generic accent, so this gilds something canon says should never be gilded.
p1.recommendation: Do not use the gold-topped glass variant here. Switch to a canon solid/cream card with a HAIRLINE (#E3D6BC) border and no gold. Reserve gold strictly for palace-seal surfaces.

p1.title: KepCreationWizard renders on a bare page with no cream canvas or card shell
p1.detail: The wizard is a max-width 36rem column with padding but no background surface — it inherits whatever the route background is. Sibling surfaces (KepCapturePanel, Atrium/Library) establish an explicit CREAM/linen surface with HAIRLINE border and warm-ink shadow.
