The wizard has no titlebar rhythm, no card container, no canon canvas, making it look unfinished next to the polished capture panel it conceptually pairs with.
p1.recommendation: Wrap the wizard in a canon surface: set the page/canvas to CREAM #FCFAF5, put the steps in a TuscanCard-equivalent cream panel with HAIRLINE border and a warm-ink shadow, so it visually matches the capture panel and Atrium siblings.

p1.title: Wizard silently swallows create failures — no error surfaced to the user
p1.detail: handleCreate calls createKep(payload); on failure createKep returns null and sets error in the store, but the wizard never reads that error. useKepStore is destructured as { createKep, isCreating } only — error is ignored. So when the POST /api/keps fails (auth expired, 500, duplicate, network), the Create button spinner resets, nothing navigates, and the user sees no message at all. They're stuck on the review step with zero feedback and will likely mash the button.
p1.recommendation: Also pull error from useKepStore and render it near the Create button (e.g. an inline error row when handleCreate returns null / when error is set). Clear it on retry via clearError().

p1.title: Routing step promises room selection but only exposes an auto-route toggle
p1.detail: StepRouting's copy is wizardStep3Desc = 'Where should memories go?' and the payload carries default_wing_id / default_room_id, but the StepRouting UI renders ONLY the auto_route_enabled toggle. There is no wing or room picker anywhere in the wizard, so default_wing_id and default_room_id are always the INITIAL_WIZARD_DATA empty strings and get dropped to undefined in buildCreatePayload. A user who turns auto-route OFF has no way to set a destination — captures will have neither AI routing nor a manual default, effectively orphaning them.
p1.recommendation: Either add a wing/room selector to StepRouting (shown when auto_route_enabled is false) that writes default_wing_id/default_room_id, or change the step copy to reflect that it only controls AI auto-routing so the UI matches its stated purpose.

p1.title: Pending page headings render in default sans, not Fraunces
p1.detail: Every text element on the pending page (h1 'pendingCaptures', h2 'noPending', capture titles, batch bar) has no fontFamily set, so it falls back to the browser default sans-serif. The canon mandates Fraunces (display serif) for headings and Source Sans for body. Sibling surface keps/page.tsx correctly applies F.display to its h1/h2/h3. The pending page therefore looks like an un-themed admin table next to its polished sibling.
p1.recommendation: Add fontFamily: T.font.display to the h1/h2 headings and T.font.body to paragraphs/labels/buttons, matching the stepTitle/stepDesc style objects on keps/page.tsx.

p1.title: Pending page uses px for input fontSize instead of rem 1rem
p1.detail: The route-room input hard-codes fontSize: "16px". The canon requires rem for sizing (px only for hairlines) and specifies inputs at fontSize 1rem to prevent iOS zoom. 16px happens to equal the zoom threshold but violates the rem rule and is inconsistent with the rest of the token system.
p1.recommendation: Change to fontSize: "1rem" to satisfy both the rem-sizing rule and the no-iOS-zoom requirement in one canonical value.

p1.title: Pending page has raw white hex and inconsistent button styling vs canon CTAs
p1.detail: Action buttons use color: "#fff" literals and flat T.color.sage / T.color.error fills with no radius/weight consistency with the sibling surface. keps/page.tsx defines shared btnPrimary/btnSecondary style objects (terracotta CTA, cream text, 0.5rem radius, gradient step badges). The pending page's ad-hoc 0.25rem-radius sage/red/blue buttons look like a different product and never use the canon EMBER interactive color.
p1.recommendation: Use T.color.cream instead of "#fff", raise radius to 0.5rem, and route the primary action through an EMBER/terracotta CTA style consistent with btnPrimary on keps/page.tsx; reserve red only for the destructive reject action.

p1.title: Store errors are never surfaced on the pending page
p1.detail: kepStore sets `error` when fetchPendingCaptures/routeCaptures/rejectCaptures fail, but PendingCapturesPage never reads `error` from the store. On a failed fetch the page falls through to the empty state (isLoading false, pendingCaptures []) showing 'No pending captures' — indistinguishable from a real empty queue. On a failed route/reject the user sees nothing at all. There is no retry affordance.
p1.recommendation: Destructure `error` from useKepStore and render an error banner (with a retry that calls fetchPendingCaptures) distinct from the empty state; also surface route/reject failures via a toast or inline message.

p2plus.title: No prefers-reduced-motion guard on six staggered entrance animations
p2plus.recommendation: Add a global @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){ *{animation:none!important;transition:none!important} } inside TuscanStyles, or guard the page animations behind a usePrefersReducedMotion hook.

p2plus.title: Muted secondary text uses off-canon muted grey
p2plus.recommendation: Point secondary text at a MUTED token equal to #716A5E (or update C.muted) for caption/label consistency with canon.

p2plus.title: Phone-number pill and code chips use GOLD/monospace as body accent
p2plus.recommendation: Keep gold as a subtle graphic tint but render the phone number in INK (or EMBER) via Source Sans with tabular-nums; if a mono look is desired for commands, define a canon mono token rather than the raw 'monospace' keyword.

p2plus.title: Page background is linen, not canon CREAM base
p2plus.recommendation: Consider CREAM (#FCFAF5) as the page base with linen reserved for lifted bands/cards, per canon, once the surface is migrated off the legacy Tuscan tokens.

p2plus.title: vCard download is not wired to any anchor cleanup / can fail silently on some mobile browsers
p2plus.recommendation: Append the anchor to document.body before click() and remove it after, and/or detect the native app (Capacitor) to fall back to the wa.me deep-link. Consider wrapping in try/catch to at least log/telemetry a failed save so a silent no-op is detectable.

p2plus.title: NavigationBar shows Atrium as the active mode while on the Kep page
p2plus.recommendation: Either pass a neutral/no-active state (if NavigationBar supports it) or accept the Atrium highlight deliberately; if kept, add a code comment noting the intentional 'Kep is reached from Atrium' active-state choice.

p2plus.title: WhatsApp prefilled message and vCard NOTE/FN are hardcoded English (not i18n)
p2plus.recommendation: Pull the prefill text and vCard FN/NOTE from the kepLanding i18n namespace (add keys like waPrefill, vcardName, vcardNote) so the initiated conversation and saved contact match the user's language.

p2plus.title: Kep landing surface is now a server-side redirect with no renderable UI to audit
p2plus.recommendation: Re-scope the audit to the actual destination surface at src/app/(app)/palace/keps/page.tsx. Optionally add a next.config redirect (or middleware) instead of a component so the /kep path never ships a client bundle at all.

p2plus.title: Wizard body typography drops to browser default sans on labels, source titles, and toggle labels
p2plus.recommendation: Add fontFamily: T.font.body to all wizard body text (labels, source titles/descriptions, toggle label/desc, review rows, inputStyle) so it renders in Source Sans, matching the rest of the canon.

p2plus.title: StepReview uses emoji check/cross and emoji source glyphs instead of canon iconography
p2plus.recommendation: Replace emoji with canon SVG marks (e.g. a SAGE #56683C check, MUTED cross) and a small source glyph consistent with the panel's WhatsApp SVG.

p2plus.title: KepFlowIllustration bakes literal English labels and a raw brand-green into the SVG
p2plus.recommendation: Dial the WhatsApp green to a smaller accent (icon only) rather than a full tinted panel, and drive the three captions from tokens/i18n rather than baked SVG <text>.

p2plus.title: Panel and cards use theme.ts linen/warmStone/sandstone rather than canon CREAM/TRAY tokens
p2plus.recommendation: Where practical, source neutrals from libraryTokens (CREAM/TRAY/HAIRLINE/SAGE) instead of theme.ts linen/warmStone/sandstone so the Kep surface shares one source of truth with its siblings.

p2plus.title: Disabled Next button uses sandstone fill with cream text — low-contrast, non-canon disabled state
p2plus.recommendation: Give disabled a clearer canon treatment (e.g. TRAY fill with MUTED #716A5E text, or reduced-opacity ember).

p2plus.title: Photos-source Kep can be created with no Google account connected
p2plus.recommendation: When source_type === 'photos', check connected-accounts state; if Google Photos isn't linked, block Next / show a 'Connect Google Photos' CTA (link to /settings/connections).

p2plus.title: Escape-to-close on the capture dialog is unreliable — dialog is not focusable
p2plus.recommendation: Add a document-level keydown listener in a useEffect for Escape, or give the dialog tabIndex={-1} and focus it on mount via a ref. Also move initial focus into the dialog.

p2plus.title: formatPhone assumes exactly 9 national digits after the country code
p2plus.recommendation: Use a real phone-formatting lib (libphonenumber-js) or format loosely (group in 3s/4s) rather than hard-coding a 9-digit national length.

p2plus.title: Photos date-range end defaults to a full ISO timestamp instead of a date
p2plus.recommendation: Use a date-only string for the fallback (e.g. new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)) so startDate and endDate share the same YYYY-MM-DD format the scanner expects.

p2plus.title: Review step shows hardcoded 'WhatsApp' / 'Google Photos' value strings
p2plus.recommendation: Reuse t('sourceWhatsapp')/t('sourcePhotos') (already localized in all 5 locales) so the review summary matches the localized choice, with the emoji marked aria-hidden.

p2plus.title: Wizard step transitions are not announced / no focus move on step change
p2plus.recommendation: On step change, move focus to the step's <h2> (add tabIndex={-1} + ref.focus()) or wrap step content in an aria-live="polite" region.

p2plus.title: KepCapturePanel command chips are English-only literals
p2plus.recommendation: Keep the command keyword literal but source the example argument ('Kitchen'/'Holidays') from a translation key, or add a translated caption clarifying these are commands.

p2plus.title: GOLD spent on a generic phone-number pill (ceremonial-color misuse)
p2plus.recommendation: Recolor the pill with EMBER/terracotta or walnut ink and keep gold reserved for genuinely ceremonial framing.

p2plus.title: Emoji glyphs used for empty/loading state and media icons instead of canon SVG iconography
p2plus.recommendation: Replace the empty-state emoji with a small warm SVG (stroke C.sage/C.walnut) and swap media/AI emoji for the app's SVG icon set.

p2plus.title: Loading and empty states lack Fraunces heading + warm styling / spacing rhythm
p2plus.recommendation: Wrap empty/loading in a centered TuscanCard-lite block, give the h2 F.display, use inkSoft/muted per canon, and add the shared fade-slide-up animation.

p2plus.title: Two surfaces diverge on background + text tokens (linen/charcoal vs canon CREAM/INK)
p2plus.recommendation: Standardize both palace-kep surfaces on CREAM (#FCFAF5) page background and INK (#403B36) primary text (theme exposes inkSoft = #403B36); set an explicit background on the pending page.

p2plus.title: Hardcoded English 'Select all' string bypasses i18n
p2plus.recommendation: Add a 'selectAll' key to the kep section of all five message files and render {t("selectAll", { count: String(pendingCaptures.length) })}.

p2plus.title: formatPhone / vCard mishandle short or malformed phone numbers
p2plus.recommendation: Guard the Save/WhatsApp/copy controls (disable or hide) when !waPhone, and validate digit length before rendering the pill / building the vCard.

p2plus.title: NavigationBar highlights 'Atrium' while on the Keps page
p2plus.recommendation: Either pass no active highlight for this sub-route or add explicit handling so no primary tab reads as active while on the Keps landing.

p2plus.title: pending page fetch has no dependency-stability guard against duplicate fetches
p2plus.recommendation: Add a simple in-flight flag (or AbortController) so concurrent fetchPendingCaptures calls are deduped/cancelled.

p2plus.title: "Copy" secondary button on keps page is below 2.75rem touch height
p2plus.recommendation: Add minHeight: "2.75rem" (and adequate horizontal padding) to btnPrimary, btnSecondary, and btnWhatsApp so all tappable CTAs meet the touch minimum on phones.

p2plus.title: SVG flow-illustration labels are hardcoded English, not translated
p2plus.recommendation: Add a kepLanding.flowRoomLabel key across the 5 locales and pass t() into the illustration for the 'Your Room' caption.

p2plus.title: vCard contact name is hardcoded English, downloaded onto every user's phone
p2plus.recommendation: Source FN/ORG/NOTE from t() (e.g. kepLanding.vcardName / vcardNote) so the saved contact matches the user's locale.

p2plus.title: Command chips 'ROOM Kitchen / NEW Holidays / ROOMS' hardcoded in JSX array
p2plus.recommendation: If the WhatsApp bot accepts localized room names, move the example arguments (Kitchen/Holidays) into i18n; otherwise add a short localized caption clarifying these are English commands.

p2plus.title: AI-suggestion banner and status colors bypass canon and reduced-motion/contrast norms
p2plus.recommendation: Recolor the suggestion banner with C.sage/C.gold tokens, and gate the keps-page entrance animations behind a prefers-reduced-motion check.

strengths: Consistent rem-based sizing throughout (spacing, radii, font sizes, touch targets) with px reserved only for 1px hairlines and SVG geometry, matching canon unit discipline.
Fully inline-style responsive design driven by useIsMobile()/useIsCompact() hooks with no @media queries, exactly as canon requires; safe-area-inset padding handled on the mobile bottom nav.
Correct Fraunces (F.display) for headings and Source Sans (F.body) for body/labels, applied consistently on the keps landing surface.
Touch targets meet the 2.75rem minimum (close button is exactly 2.75rem square); step badges and buttons are comfortably sized.
Thoughtful bespoke SVG porter + flow illustrations that give the surface a distinct, polished identity while pulling their fills from the shared palette.
Copy button has a clear visual success state (sage background + Copied label), a nice piece of interaction polish.
The /kep entry point redirects cleanly to the real Kep surface; because (app) is a Next.js route group it does not alter the URL, so redirect("/palace/keps") resolves correctly — no broken route.

All i18n keys referenced by the keps page (navTitle, title, subtitle, quickStep1-4, settingsHint/Link, commandsHint) exist in en/nl/de/es/fr — verified across all 5 locales, no missing-key fallthrough.
handleCopy correctly guards the empty-phone case (if (!waPhone) return) and has a .catch(() => {}), and the copied state auto-resets after 2s.
downloadVCard properly manages the object URL lifecycle (createObjectURL then revokeObjectURL after click), avoiding a memory leak.
All theme color tokens used exist in src/lib/theme.ts, so nothing renders an undefined color.
Navigation handlers are correctly wired: handleModeChange routes atrium/3d/library, and close/settings push to real, existing routes (/atrium, /settings/connections).

areas.summary: The Interview area is functionally solid but visually unshipped: its two supporting panels (History, Library) are meticulously reskinned to the cream Atrium canon, yet the core InterviewPanel still renders on a bespoke dark bronze-glass palette (verified: DARK_PALETTE.bg #2E2921), so opening any template from the cream Library slams the user into a jarring dark modal mid-flow — exactly the leftover relic the design brief forbids. Layered on top are a visible string bug on the quota/paywall surface ("Next interview available {date} 8/5/2026" from an un-interpolated t() call, confirmed at line 555) and four missing/hardcoded i18n keys that leave Dutch/German/Spanish/French free users with broken or English-only quota UI. The underlying state machine, capture/resume logic, cleanup, and IAP gating are genuinely strong. Not ready to ship: one P0 reskin plus six P1 defects (design + multilingual correctness) must land first.

p0.title: InterviewPanel is a full-screen DARK bronze-glass surface — the exact off-canon relic the design system forbids
p0.detail: The entire active-interview experience renders on a dark umber gradient with a bespoke DARK/DARK_PALETTE hex palette (bg #2E2921, surface #3A352D, border #4A453D, text #F5F0E8 — verified at lines 20/34). Canon is CREAM #FCFAF5 bg / INK #403B36 text. Its two sibling panels (History, Library) were fully reskinned to the light Atrium canon, so opening a template from the cream Library slams the user into a dark modal — a jarring, embarrassing mode switch mid-flow. This is precisely the 'leftover dark bronze-glass' the brief flags.
p0.recommendation: Reskin InterviewPanel onto the cream Atrium canon like its siblings: CREAM/linen surface, INK text, HAIRLINE #E3D6BC borders, EMBER #B85C38 for the record/CTA gradient, SAGE #56683C for AI reflections, warm-ink SHADOW ramp. Delete the DARK/DARK_PALETTE constants entirely so the three interview surfaces read as one continuous experience.

p1.title: Interactive/CTA gradients use T.color.terracotta #C66B3D, not canon EMBER #B85C38
p1.detail: accentColor = T.color.terracotta (verified line 387) resolves to #C66B3D and drives every primary CTA, record button, progress bar and mode toggle. Canon's interactive color is EMBER #B85C38. The Library panel already correctly hardcodes the in-progress pill to #B85C38 / rgba(184,92,56,0.12), so within the same feature two different 'active' oranges ship — a token-drift inconsistency that persists even after any dark->light reskin.
p1.recommendation: Import EMBER from libraryTokens and use it (with EMBER_GLYPH/walnut for gradient depth) for all interactive surfaces, matching the Library's in-progress ember. Stop routing interactive color through the legacy T.color.terracotta.

p1.title: AI 'sage' accent uses T.color.sage #4A6741, off from canon SAGE #56683C used in siblings
p1.detail: aiColor = T.color.sage = #4A6741 drives the AI acknowledgment/follow-up cards and spinner, while both sibling panels use canonical Atrium sage #56683C / #7A8C64 and rgba(86,104,60,x) medallions (e.g. CompletedCheckIcon stroke #56683C, difficultyColors light text #56683C). The two greens sit side-by-side across the feature, breaking the 'AI = sage' color contract's consistency.
p1.recommendation: Use SAGE #56683C (and SAGE_SOFT #7A8C64) from libraryTokens for all AI-reflection surfaces so the interview's green matches the completed-check / sage medallions in the History and Library panels.

p1.title: Quota respawn line renders an unreplaced {date} token AND a duplicate date
p1.detail: When a free user is out of interviews, the intro renders t("nextInterviewDate") with NO interpolation params, then manually appends the date after it (verified line 555). The message string in en.json is "Next interview available {date}" — so t() returns that literal (the {date} placeholder is never substituted) and the component then appends the real date. Result on screen: "Next interview available {date} 8/5/2026". A visible, embarrassing string bug on the paywall/quota surface.
p1.recommendation: Pass the date into t as a param and drop the manual append: t("nextInterviewDate", { date: new Date(quota.nextRespawnDate).toLocaleDateString(locale as string) }). Remove the trailing {...toLocaleDateString()} expression.

p1.title: Missing i18n keys interviewsRemaining / upgradeForUnlimited make the || fallbacks dead and text English-only
p1.detail: The quota block calls t("interviewsRemaining") and t("upgradeForUnlimited"), but neither key exists in ANY messages file (en/nl/de/es/fr; grep of src/messages confirmed 0 occurrences). Because useTranslation's t() returns the KEY string on a miss (value = ... ?? (key as string)), the returned value is the truthy string "interviewsRemaining" / "upgradeForUnlimited" — so the `|| "interviews remaining"` fallback NEVER runs and users would literally see the raw key strings.
p1.recommendation: Add interviewsRemaining and upgradeForUnlimited to the interview section of all 5 message files. The `|| fallback` pattern is not a safety net here because t() never returns empty; the keys must exist.

p1.title: Quota / upsell strings hardcoded in English across ALL 5 locales
p1.detail: Four user-facing quota strings resolve to `t(key) || "English literal"`, but interviewQuotaReached, interviewsRemaining, nextInterviewDate, and upgradeForUnlimited do NOT exist in the interview section of en/nl/de/es/fr. Because they are absent even in en.json, t() returns the raw key (truthy), so the `|| "..."` fallback never fires and every locale shows the bare key or English. Dutch/German/Spanish/French free users hitting the interview cap see broken or English-only quota UI.
p1.recommendation: Add interviewQuotaReached, interviewsRemaining, nextInterviewDate, upgradeForUnlimited to the interview section of all five message files and drop the `|| "..."` English literals. Since the key is missing even in en.json, this is currently broken for every language, not just translations.

p2plus.title: Emoji fallbacks in History panel break the hand-drawn line-art icon system
p2plus.recommendation: Replace both emoji with the existing stroke icons (InterviewIcon fallback star for the in-progress row; a line-art microphone/InterviewIcon at wing-accent color for the empty state) so every icon in the feature shares the same warm line-art language.

p2plus.title: Surface background uses T.color.linen #F2EDE4 instead of canon CREAM #FCFAF5
p2plus.recommendation: Set the drawer surface to CREAM #FCFAF5 (or TRAY #F6EBE3 for a deliberately recessed sandstone tray) to match the canon board color; reserve linen for genuinely lifted card bands, not the base surface.

p2plus.title: Progress bar and record ripple mix an ad-hoc peach #D4A07A / #D4926A outside the token set
p2plus.recommendation: During the canon reskin, collapse these peaches into the EMBER ramp (EMBER #B85C38 -> EMBER_GLYPH #9A4F2A / walnut) so the whole feature uses one interactive orange rather than terracotta + two peaches.

p2plus.title: autoSummaryTriggered ref is never reset — a second interview in the same mount silently cannot auto-summarize
p2plus.recommendation: Reset autoSummaryTriggered.current = false in handleStart (or in a useEffect keyed on currentSession?.id) so each session can auto-summarize.

p2plus.title: Skipping every question produces a 'completed' interview with an empty/placeholder narrative
p2plus.recommendation: Guard completion when responses.length === 0: either keep the session in_progress and show an empty-state message, or block Save Story until at least one response exists.

p2plus.title: processResponse error-branch completion check uses potentially stale isComplete
p2plus.recommendation: Drop the stale isComplete term and rely solely on the index comparison, matching handleContinue's logic, to avoid confusion/regression.

p2plus.title: Blocking native confirm() dialog used for leave-confirmation (bypasses the design system)
p2plus.recommendation: Replace the native confirm/alert with an in-canon confirmation sheet/modal (CREAM surface, INK text, EMBER primary + muted secondary button), focus-managed, consistent with the app's other custom dialogs.

p2plus.title: Recording waveform / timer / live-transcript region has no aria-live announcement
p2plus.recommendation: Wrap the recording status/timer and the live transcript preview in role='status' aria-live='polite' so state changes are announced. The apiError already uses role='alert' (good) — apply the same pattern here.

p2plus.title: Stop-recording button uses raw red #C75040/#A03030 — off-palette alarm color
p2plus.recommendation: Recolor the stop control to the EMBER ramp (an active pulsing EMBER dot) so 'recording/stop' stays inside the warm system, or at minimum align to canon T.color.error #C05050 rather than a bespoke brighter red.

p2plus.title: Mobile recording waveform animates only in 250ms steps (Date.now() read in render with no rAF driver)
p2plus.recommendation: Drive the mobile waveform with its own rAF/short-interval tick (~60ms useState counter) or a pure CSS keyframe animation, instead of relying on the 250ms recordingSeconds re-render.

p2plus.title: Speech-unsupported users are silently forced to text but the mode toggle can leave inputMode='voice' after an error
p2plus.recommendation: Optional: keep the apiError visible in text mode and/or leave inputMode unchanged so users who genuinely want voice can retry without re-toggling.

p2plus.title: Horizontal wing-filter tab strip has no scroll affordance or aria semantics on small screens
p2plus.recommendation: Add a subtle fade/scroll affordance and consider scroll-snap; optionally add role='tablist' + aria-selected on FilterTab for a11y.

strengths: History and Library panels are meticulously reskinned to the Atrium/Library canon: hardcoded INK #403B36, MUTED #716A5E, HAIRLINE #E3D6BC, sage/terracotta-glyph medallions with correct alpha, warm-ink SHADOW ramp (rgba(64,59,54,0.07/0.14)), and pill radii — with inline comments citing each Atrium token.
The bespoke InterviewIcon line-art system (per-template stroke SVGs + wing-accent colors + CompletedCheckIcon) is a genuinely polished, on-brand touch giving the Library real warmth and identity.
Disciplined use of rem for all sizing with px reserved only for hairline borders (0.0625rem), and correct GOLD #D4AF37 :focus-visible rings across all three panels.

Correct responsiveness via useIsMobile() inline branching (no @media in JS), >=2.75rem touch targets, textarea/input fontSize 1rem on mobile to avoid iOS zoom, and reduced-motion guards on every animated surface.
On-brand typography: Fraunces (T.font.display) for titles/questions/AI reflections, Source Sans (T.font.body) for body, and the 0.6875rem 700/0.12em uppercase overline matching the canon RT ramp.

Library difficulty/status pills correctly encode state color: SAGE for completed, terracotta-glyph for medium/retake, and canon EMBER #B85C38 for in-progress/active — the one place ember is spent correctly.

Coherent intro->question->recording->ai-responding->review-ai->summary->complete state machine, with every network call (ai-interview, summarize, quota) wrapped in try/catch with graceful degradation (save+advance or concatenated-transcript fallback).
Recording timer and speech-recognition lifecycles are cleaned up correctly (clearInterval in effect cleanup, recorder unmount revokes object URLs and stops tracks), avoiding leaks/zombie mics.

Robust cross-platform capture: mobile skips MediaRecorder to avoid mic contention with SpeechRecognition, desktop runs both; empty-transcript is detected and the user is redirected to text rather than saving an empty answer.

Sound resume/completion flow: startSession/resumeSession persist a RESUME_KEY, resumeSession recomputes the next unanswered question index, and completeCurrentSession clears the key — sessions are genuinely resumable.
IAP/paywall gating is canon-correct: upsell renders only when (!isIOS() || IAP_ENABLED) and routes via navigateInApp('/pricing'), so iOS never sees an external-purchase steering surface.
Good a11y wiring: role=dialog/aria-modal, Tab-cycling focus trap, Escape-to-exit, role=button + Enter/Space on clickable cards, apiError role=alert, and gold focus-visible rings.

areas.summary: The FamilyTree area is functionally capable and its chrome (toolbar, dialogs, popovers) is a model of Atrium-canon discipline, but it is not release-clean: the diagram body and the entire shared/[token] surface drift off-canon onto the legacy T palette (terracotta vs EMBER, charcoal vs INK, linen vs CREAM), and one P0 — the shared-link not-found/expired page — renders in Cormorant Garamond + Manrope with raw hex, a completely unbranded voice that is the first thing a share recipient sees. Functionally, three real bugs need attention: manual Add Person silently drops birth_place/death_place, fitToView uses offset math that diverges from renderTree (mis-framing any multi-tree forest), and auto-fit runs setState during render so the initial fit can silently never fire. Multiple text inputs sit at 0.875rem, triggering iOS focus-zoom on the paid app. Ship-blocking the P0 and clearing the P1 color/data/layout defects should precede release; the strong tree-building, export hardening, and multimodal input layer are already in good shape.

p0.title: Not-found error state uses fonts and hex found nowhere else in the app (fully off-canon)
p0.detail: The server-rendered error/not-found state hardcodes 'Cormorant Garamond' for the heading and 'Manrope' for the body, plus raw colors #2C2C2A (heading) and #746B60 (paragraph). Canon is Fraunces (display) + Source Sans 3 (body) with INK #403B36 and MUTED #716A5E. These two typefaces appear only here — they are not even in the T theme the rest of this surface uses — so the error page renders in a completely different, unbranded voice from every sibling surface. This is the first thing a recipient of a stale/expired share link sees.
p0.recommendation: Import T from @/lib/theme and use T.font.display / T.font.body, T.color.charcoal for the heading and T.color.muted for the body. Better still, use the canon INK/MUTED tokens. Wrap it in the same linen/cream background used by the tree view so the error state feels part of the palace.

p1.title: PNG export bakes off-canon 'Manrope' font into shared artifacts
p1.detail: handleExportPng injects an SVG <style> forcing font-family 'Manrope' for all text/foreignObject before serializing to canvas. Manrope is not part of the canon type system (Fraunces display + Source Sans 3 body). Every exported/downloaded family-tree PNG therefore renders in a font that appears nowhere else in the product, and the same string is duplicated in the shared/[token] page.
p1.recommendation: Replace 'Manrope' with the canon body stack (T.font.body / 'Source Sans 3') and Fraunces for the title text, so exported PNGs match on-screen typography. Fix the identical hardcode in shared/[token]/page.tsx too.

p1.title: Two different 'muted' greys used for secondary text on the same surface
p1.detail: The page chrome hardcodes the canon MUTED #716A5E for secondary text (person count, hints, disabled labels), but PersonCard renders last name, lifespan, and death-cross using T.color.muted, which resolves to #857B70 — a lighter, greener grey. Adjacent muted text (toolbar subtitle vs card subtitle) therefore does not match, a subtle but real inconsistency in the core node component.
p1.recommendation: Standardize card secondary text on canon MUTED #716A5E (or realign T.color.muted to #716A5E globally if safe). Pick one muted value across chrome and cards.

p1.title: Node/link palette relies on legacy T.color tokens off the canon ladder
p1.detail: The tree body (as opposed to the chrome) is built almost entirely from legacy theme tokens that are not canon: T.color.walnut (#8B7355) for icons/link strokes/gender silhouettes, T.color.sandstone (#D6CCBA) and warmStone (#E5DDD0) for tracks/photo fills, T.color.terracotta (#C66B3D) for spouse hearts, relationship-count badges and the keyboard focus ring, and T.color.charcoal (#1F1B1A) for the primary name. Canon interactive/ceremonial reds are EMBER #B85C38 and GOLD #D4AF37, and canon ink is #403B36 — so the diagram reads in a slightly different, older bronze palette than the toolbar wrapping it.
p1.recommendation: Align the tree body with the chrome: use EMBER #B85C38 (not terracotta #C66B3D) for the accent red in hearts/badges/focus ring, INK #403B36 for the primary name instead of charcoal #1F1B1A, and canon walnut/sandstone equivalents for link strokes, so the SVG visually matches the Atrium-canon toolbar.

p1.title: Manual Add Person silently drops birth_place and death_place
p1.detail: AddPersonForm collects birthPlace/deathPlace and passes them in AddPersonData (data.birth_place / data.death_place), and the addPerson server action explicitly accepts birth_place/death_place/notes. But the page's handleAdd only forwards first_name, last_name, birth_date, death_date, gender to addPerson — birth_place and death_place are never sent. A user who fills in birth/death place on manual add loses that data with no error; the same fields ARE saved on GEDCOM import, making the behavior inconsistent. This also lowers the PersonList completeness score (which rewards birth_place).
p1.recommendation: Add birth_place: data.birth_place and death_place: data.death_place (and notes if the form later collects it) to the addPerson call in handleAdd so manually entered places are persisted.

p1.title: AddPersonForm text inputs use 0.875rem font — triggers iOS focus-zoom
p1.detail: The shared inputStyle in AddPersonForm sets fontSize 0.875rem (14px) with NO mobile override, applied to the first-name, last-name, birth-place and death-place text inputs. Any input under 16px causes iOS Safari/WKWebView to auto-zoom on focus, which on the PAID iOS app throws off the whole add-person flow. The sibling DateInputAssisted proves the team knows the fix (it uses fontSize isMobile ? '1rem' : '0.875rem'), so this is an inconsistency rather than an unknown.
p1.recommendation: Set fontSize to isMobile ? '1rem' : '0.875rem' (or just '1rem') on inputStyle, matching DateInputAssisted, so focusing any add-person field never triggers iOS zoom.

p1.title: TreeSearch input uses 0.875rem font — iOS zoom on mobile search
p1.detail: The tree search field is the primary way to find a person on a large tree and is explicitly expanded on mobile (icon → full-width input). Its input font is a hardcoded 0.875rem with no mobile branch, so focusing search on iOS zooms the viewport, then the tree canvas is left mis-scaled after dismissal.
p1.recommendation: Use fontSize: isMobile ? '1rem' : '0.875rem' on the search input so the mobile-expanded search does not trigger iOS zoom.

p1.title: Entire shared surface is built on the legacy T palette, not the canon libraryTokens palette
p1.detail: SharedTreeView and PersonCard color everything from T.color.* whose values diverge from canon: linen #F2EDE4 (canon bg = CREAM #FCFAF5), charcoal #1F1B1A (canon INK #403B36), terracotta #C66B3D (canon EMBER #B85C38), muted #857B70 (canon MUTED #716A5E), walnut #8B7355 (no canon equivalent). The interactive terracotta used for the header icon, heart bond, focus dash and count badge is a different orange from EMBER, so this surface reads as a slightly different family from Atrium/Library which are keyed to libraryTokens. Fonts are correct (T.font resolves to Fraunces/Source Sans), so this is purely color drift.
p1.recommendation: Migrate this surface (and the shared PersonCard) onto libraryTokens: CREAM bg, INK text, MUTED secondary, EMBER for interactive, GOLD for the self/ceremonial ring, HAIRLINE for borders. If a full migration is out of scope, at minimum align charcoal→INK, muted→MUTED and terracotta→EMBER so it matches sibling surfaces.

p1.title: Empty-tree state is bare, unstyled, and shows a hardcoded English string
p1.detail: When persons.length === 0 the canvas renders only muted body text 'This tree is empty.' centered on a blank linen field — no icon, no card, no Fraunces heading, and the string is not run through t(). Compared to the polished header and node cards, this empty state looks unfinished and breaks visual rhythm (surrounding surface has depth via shadows/gradients; this has none).
p1.recommendation: Give the empty state the canon treatment: a centered TreeBranchIcon in EMBER_GLYPH, a Fraunces title and a Source Sans supporting line, on the cream field, with rem spacing. (Also move the copy into t() for i18n.)

p1.title: fitToView multi-tree offset diverges from render offset — Fit View mis-frames any forest with >1 tree
p1.detail: In fitToView, minX/maxX/minY/maxY are declared once before the forEach and never reset per tree, yet the running offset uses them: offsetX += maxX - minX + horizGapPx * 3. Because maxX/minX keep growing globally, the per-tree horizontal step is wrong. Meanwhile renderTree computes a fresh per-tree treeMinX/treeMaxX and steps by offsetX += treeMaxX - treeMinX + horizGapPx * 3. So the coordinate system fitToView measures does NOT match where nodes are actually drawn. For any tree with multiple disconnected components (very common: in-laws, unlinked people), clicking Fit View (and the auto-fit on load) will center/zoom on the wrong region, potentially showing an empty or clipped canvas.
p1.recommendation: Compute a per-tree bounding box inside the forEach (reset local treeMinX/treeMaxX each iteration, mirroring renderTree), advance offsetX by the per-tree width, and accumulate the GLOBAL min/max separately from the offset step. The two functions must share identical offset math — ideally factor the offset computation into one helper used by both.

p1.title: Auto-fit triggers setState during render (side effect in component body)
p1.detail: The auto-fit block runs directly in the render body and calls setInitialFitDone(true) plus schedules fitToView (which calls setZoom/setPan) via requestAnimationFrame. Mutating state during render is a React anti-pattern: it works only because the guard flips initialFitDone, but it depends on containerRef.current being populated at first render-with-layout, which is not guaranteed on the first commit. If treeLayouts is ready before the ref is attached, the condition is false and never re-checked (no dependency re-render is guaranteed), so the initial auto-fit can silently never fire, leaving the tree unfitted until the user clicks Fit View.
p1.recommendation: Move auto-fit into a useEffect keyed on [treeLayouts] (and a mounted flag) so it re-evaluates after the ref is attached and after layout changes, e.g. useEffect(() => { if(treeLayouts.length) requestAnimationFrame(fitToView); }, [treeLayouts]).

p1.title: Not-found page bypasses i18n system, hardcodes wrong fonts, and is off-canon
p1.detail: The error/expired-link branch renders its own inline Record<string,string> maps (notFoundTitle/notFoundDesc) rather than useTranslation, and hardcodes fontFamily 'Cormorant Garamond' / 'Manrope' plus color #2C2C2A and #746B60. This is the entire visible page for an expired share link (a very common state for a shared surface). Fonts are not the canon Fraunces/Source Sans, colors are raw hex not tokens, and because it is a server component it uses only the mp_locale cookie sliced to 2 chars — no graceful locale negotiation.
p1.recommendation: Route these strings through the shared i18n message files (familyTree namespace keys e.g. sharedTreeNotFoundTitle/Desc) and use T.font.display / T.font.body + T.color tokens so the expired-link page matches canon and stays translatable.

p2plus.title: Page base gradient uses linen (#F2EDE4), not canon CREAM (#FCFAF5)
p2plus.recommendation: Anchor the gradient endpoints on canon CREAM #FCFAF5 (T.color.cream) with a very light warm-stone mid-stop, matching the lighter base used on sibling surfaces.

p2plus.title: Loading and share-loading states are unstyled bare text / ellipsis
p2plus.recommendation: Replace the '...' with a proper localized loading label and a small canon spinner/skeleton; give the tree loading state a subtle branded loader (e.g. the TreeBranchIcon with a reduced-motion-safe pulse) to match the polish of the empty state.

p2plus.title: Gender tint colors are off-canon ad-hoc pastels
p2plus.recommendation: Derive gender tints from warm canon tones (e.g. a rose from the terracotta/ember family and a muted warm-blue/sage rather than cool #A0B8D4) so the coding stays legible without breaking the warm palette.

p2plus.title: CompletionRing 'partial' color #D4A840 is a bespoke amber, not GOLD
p2plus.recommendation: Use a defined warning/amber token (or canon goldDark #B8922E) for the mid state, or restyle the ring so the ceremonial GOLD is not visually echoed on non-self nodes.

p2plus.title: GEDCOM import never recreates sibling / half-sibling / step relationships
p2plus.recommendation: Either encode sibling/half-sibling/step relationships in the GEDCOM (e.g. via FAM structures or custom tags) and recreate them on import, or surface a warning that these relationship types are not preserved by GEDCOM export/import.

p2plus.title: Focus mode and Descendancy view can be active simultaneously with conflicting data
p2plus.recommendation: Make the two modes mutually exclusive: clear descendancyRootId when entering focus and clear focusPersonId/focusedNodeId when entering descendancy (and vice-versa on exit).

p2plus.title: Share button can create a duplicate/second share link due to load race
p2plus.recommendation: Fetch the active share fresh when the dialog opens (or gate the button until loadData completes) and have createShareLink be idempotent / return the existing active share instead of minting a new token when one already exists.

p2plus.title: Keyboard 'f' focus and Enter open handlers read from focus-filtered persons, so they no-op once focus mode is active
p2plus.recommendation: Look up the focused person in the full persons array (not effectiveData.persons) for Enter/F handlers, or ensure layoutOrderIds and effectiveData.persons are always derived from the same set.

p2plus.title: AddPersonForm text inputs use fontSize 0.875rem, below the 1rem iOS no-zoom threshold (duplicate/detail of P1)
p2plus.recommendation: Raise the input fontSize to 1rem (16px) for the text inputs to disable iOS focus-zoom, keeping labels at the smaller size.

p2plus.title: FocusBanner imports FamilyTreeRelationship but never uses it (dead import)
p2plus.recommendation: Drop FamilyTreeRelationship from the type import if it isn't referenced by the component, or confirm the build's TS config tolerates unused imports.

p2plus.title: Mobile zoom-control buttons are 2rem — below the 2.75rem touch-target minimum
p2plus.recommendation: Raise the mobile zoom button size to at least 2.75rem (keep the circular shape), or add invisible hit-padding so the tappable area reaches 2.75rem.

p2plus.title: Toolbar action pills and view-switcher below 2.75rem touch height
p2plus.recommendation: Bump the action pills to minHeight 2.75rem and the view-switcher buttons to 2.75rem on touch (isMobile), or add hit-area padding to reach the minimum.

p2plus.title: View-mode switcher lacks radiogroup/radio semantics
p2plus.recommendation: Wrap the three buttons in role="radiogroup" with an aria-label, give each role="radio" and aria-checked={isActive} (or use aria-pressed on toggle buttons) so the active view is announced.

p2plus.title: Share-link readonly URL input uses 0.8125rem — iOS zoom + tiny target
p2plus.recommendation: Set the share URL input fontSize to 1rem on mobile and give it minHeight 2.75rem to avoid iOS zoom and give a comfortable tap target.

p2plus.title: Keyboard-nav hint and arrow-key controls are desktop-only, with no touch equivalent surfaced
p2plus.recommendation: Consider a lightweight touch hint or a visible focus/step control for touch users so the focus-mode multimodal feature is reachable without a keyboard.

p2plus.title: Hairline borders use px, not the canon HAIRLINE color/rem rule
p2plus.recommendation: Use 1px solid ${HAIRLINE} (from libraryTokens) for both. Keep px width (canon allows px for hairlines) but drop the alpha-hex suffix so the seam is the warm sand tone.

p2plus.title: Fit-view button and close button are below the 2.75rem touch target and lack canon button styling
p2plus.recommendation: Raise both to minHeight/minWidth 2.75rem. Replace the literal 'x' with the existing CloseIcon SVG from PersonCard (color MUTED). Give the fitView button the canon ghost-button treatment (HAIRLINE border, INK label, EMBER on hover).

p2plus.title: Detail-panel overlay is a cold pure-black scrim instead of a warm-ink veil
p2plus.recommendation: Use rgba(64,59,54,0.2) for the scrim and the canon SHADOW[2] (0 0.5rem 1.5rem rgba(64,59,54,0.14)) for the panel so the veil is warm-ink consistent.

p2plus.title: Relationship rows and notes block use cream as a divider/fill, reducing contrast and rhythm
p2plus.recommendation: Use HAIRLINE for the row dividers and TRAY (#F6EBE3, the recessed sandstone tray) for the notes fill so both read against the cream panel.

p2plus.title: Link paths and shadow rects use bare px stroke/offsets and neutral sandstone links
p2plus.recommendation: Stroke links with HAIRLINE (or EMBER_GLYPH at low opacity) for warmth, and consolidate the card drop-shadow onto a single warm-ink rgba(64,59,54,x) value matching the SHADOW ramp.

p2plus.title: Hardcoded English empty-state string bypasses i18n
p2plus.recommendation: Replace with {t("sharedTreeEmpty")} (or similar) and add the key to all five locale message files.

p2plus.title: Dead notes panel block — notes are always null-redacted server-side
p2plus.recommendation: Remove the notes block from the shared view (or add a code comment noting notes are always redacted here) so intent is explicit and the panel matches the sanitized data contract.

p2plus.title: Not-found fallback uses wrong fonts/colors and a separate hardcoded string map instead of i18n + design canon
p2plus.recommendation: Use the existing server translation helper (serverT/getServerLocale, already imported in family-tree-actions) to resolve these strings from the shared messages files, and align fonts/colors to the theme tokens for consistency.

p2plus.title: Single-finger tap detection (moved flag) computed but never consumed
p2plus.recommendation: Either remove the moved tracking as dead code, or wire it: in the node tap path, ignore selection when touchRef.current?.moved is true.

p2plus.title: Close button uses literal 'x' glyph rather than an icon/× entity
p2plus.recommendation: Replace the 'x' text with a × entity (×) or a small icon component for a cleaner close affordance.

p2plus.title: onWheel calls e.preventDefault() on a passive React listener
p2plus.recommendation: Attach a non-passive native wheel listener via useEffect/ref addEventListener('wheel', fn, { passive: false }) instead of the React onWheel prop, or set touch-action/overscroll-behavior on the container.

p2plus.title: Detail-panel close control is a literal 'x' glyph with sub-target tap size
p2plus.recommendation: Give the close button minWidth/minHeight 2.75rem, center content, and use the imported-style CloseIcon SVG instead of a literal 'x'.

p2plus.title: Canvas relies on useIsMobile only; no landscape/iPad-specific tuning and fixed 100vh
p2plus.recommendation: Use 100dvh (or a --vh var) for the shell, and consider useIsCompact for the sheet-vs-modal switch so iPad portrait also gets the bottom sheet; scale fitToView pad by viewport.

p2plus.title: fitView / person-card / report controls lack explicit 2.75rem touch sizing
p2plus.recommendation: Add minHeight:'2.75rem' (and adequate width) to the fitView button; consider a minimum zoom floor or larger hit-padding so cards remain tappable when zoomed out on touch.

p2plus.title: No reduced-motion guard on auto-fit animation frame / zoom transitions
p2plus.recommendation: Gate any animated camera transition behind a prefers-reduced-motion check; the instant setPan/setZoom here is acceptable but document/guard it if a transition is ever added.

strengths: Chrome (toolbar, pills, dialogs, popovers) is carefully built to Atrium canon: hardcoded hairline #E3D6BC, ink #403B36, muted #716A5E, ember #B85C38, warm-ink shadows rgba(64,59,54,x), and gold #D4AF37 focus ring — all annotated with intent.
Correct canon type system: T.font.display = 'Fraunces' and T.font.body = 'Source Sans 3' are used consistently for titles vs body throughout the page and PersonCard.

Fully rem-based sizing with px reserved only for hairlines; responsiveness done purely via useIsMobile()/useIsCompact() inline branches with a reduced-motion @media guard and gold focus-visible ring in a scoped <style> — matches canon rules.

Touch targets in the chrome respect the 2.75rem minimum (close/zoom/quick-add buttons enforce minHeight/minWidth 2.75rem), and the primary empty-state is a genuinely polished, on-brand illustration+CTA composition.

GOLD is correctly reserved as ceremonial: it marks the 'self' node (glow, laurel, YOU badge) and focus ring only, with an explicit comment that gold is reserved for the palace so couple-links use sage instead.

Robust view-state persistence: pan/zoom/mode/root are debounced-saved to sessionStorage and restored on load with type-guarded parsing (loadViewState validates typeof zoom/pan.x before use), so a corrupt entry can't crash the page.

Tree-building (buildForest) carefully de-duplicates spouses via consumedAsSpouse/visited sets, propagates parents to siblings, sorts roots by descendant depth to avoid generation collapse, and falls back to orphan nodes so no person is ever dropped from the render.

Comprehensive error/empty/loading handling in the container: distinct loading text, OnboardingWizard vs empty-state, per-person try/catch during GEDCOM import with success/error counts surfaced via Toast, and TreeErrorBoundary wrapping both the SVG and FanChart.

GEDCOM import is defensively coded: 10MB size cap, skips nameless INDIs, remaps IDs, only creates spouse/parent rels when both endpoints resolved, and auto-opens the DuplicateDetector when post-import duplicates are found.

PNG/SVG export clones the SVG, strips pan/zoom transforms, replaces cross-origin <image> with placeholder rects to avoid tainted-canvas failures, and reports exportPngError on every failure path (onerror, no-ctx, toBlob null).

Responsiveness is driven by hooks not @media: useIsMobile()/useIsCompact() gate layout (mobile scroll action-bar, fixed vs absolute zoom controls, mobile legend popover, iPad-portrait treated as compact so the toolbar scrolls) exactly as canon requires.

Rich multimodal input: full touch handling (two-finger pinch-zoom + single-finger pan with a 3px move threshold, touchAction:none), mouse drag/wheel, and complete keyboard nav (Tab/Shift-Tab cycle, arrow-key pan, Enter to open, F for focus, Escape) via a window listener that correctly ignores input/textarea/select targets.

areas.summary: The Social area has a coherent, well-built modal shell (SharingPanel is a genuine canon exemplar) but ships three verified P0 dead-link/dead-row defects that break its core promise: the QR + generic 'Copy share link' target /palace?shared= which nothing reads, the passcode 'Copy Link' lands on an empty form because /passcode never reads the code, and accepted wing shares render as nameless un-navigable cards in Shared-with-me. Compounding this, PublishModal silently swallows every publish/unpublish failure and always shows success, so users can believe content is published when it is not. On top of the functional gaps, gold-vs-ember canon is violated on primary CTAs and active states across all three surfaces, and several panels can hang on 'loading' forever after a failed fetch. Not shippable as-is: the P0 share/passcode/wing paths and the publish false-success must be fixed before release.

p0.title: QR code and generic share link point to /palace?shared= which nothing reads — shared context is silently lost
p0.detail: QRShareModal is opened by SharingPanel with url=`${origin}/palace?shared=${roomId}`, and copyGenericLink builds the identical URL. Verified: a grep of the whole app (including src/app/(app)/palace/page.tsx) finds zero readers of a `shared` search param. A recipient who scans the QR or opens the copied 'share link' lands on the generic palace with no shared-room routing, access grant, or scroll-to-room. The DB-backed public link (copyPublicLink -> /public/{slug}) DOES work, making the broken generic/QR path especially confusing side-by-side.
p0.recommendation: Either add a handler in palace/page.tsx that reads ?shared= and resolves/opens the shared room (validating access), or repoint the QR + generic link to the working /public/{slug} URL guarded on publicShare?.is_active. Do not ship a share affordance whose target param is never consumed.

p0.title: Copied share LINK is non-functional — lands on an empty passcode form
p0.detail: PasscodeModal builds the share URL as a bare '/passcode' with no code or slug embedded, then presents it as 'Copy Link'. Verified: PasscodeEntry (the /passcode page) never reads any query param (no searchParams/window.location.search) — it only accepts manually typed codes. A recipient who clicks the shared link sees a blank passcode field with no code pre-filled and no context. Only the separately-copied 6-char code works, and only if the sender communicates it out-of-band, defeating the point of one shareable artifact.
p0.recommendation: Embed the code (or slug) in the URL, e.g. `${origin}/passcode?code=${createdShare.passcode}` (or /passcode/${slug}), and in PasscodeEntry read the param on mount (useSearchParams) to pre-fill `code` and optionally auto-validate, making the link self-contained.

p0.title: Wing shares are unclickable dead rows in Shared-with-me panel
p0.detail: getAcceptedShares() returns wing-type shares (type:'wing' with a `rooms` array and wingName, but no roomId/roomName). Verified: the panel's AcceptedShare interface and rendering only model room shares — it prints {share.roomName} (undefined -> blank title) and its click handler is `share.roomId && onNavigateToRoom?.(share.roomId)`, so for a wing share the button is a permanent no-op with an empty name. Any accepted wing shows up as a broken, un-navigable, nameless card; the `rooms` array the server assembled (invite-actions.ts) is never rendered.
p0.recommendation: Branch on share.type. For type==='wing', render the wing name/icon and expand its `rooms` list (each with its own roomId) as navigable sub-rows, or at minimum navigate to the wing. Add rooms/type/wingId to the AcceptedShare interface and stop assuming every share is a room.

p1.title: PublishModal swallows all publish/unpublish failures; error state is unreachable and success is always shown
p1.detail: handlePublish pushes publishWing/unpublishWing/publishRoom/unpublishRoom into `ops` and does `await Promise.all(ops)`. Those server actions never throw — they return {ok:false, error} on failure (e.g. 'Not authenticated', RLS/db errors). The returned objects are discarded with no `.ok` inspection, so Promise.all always resolves, setError is never called (the error state + its render branch are dead code), and the modal unconditionally shows the success checkmark and closes after 1200ms even if every publish silently failed. User believes content is published when it may not be.
p1.recommendation: Capture results: `const results = await Promise.all(ops)` and if results.some(r => r && r.ok === false) call setError(t(...)) and skip the done/close path. Wrap in try/catch for network rejections too.

p1.title: Privacy toggles (Allow download, Show in public palace) start from hardcoded defaults, never seeded from server — mutate wrong baseline
p1.detail: allowDownload defaults to true and showPublicPalace to false in useState, with no effect loading real DB values (fetchRoomShares/fetchPublicShare only populate shares + publicShare; sharing-actions has no allow_download read). When the panel opens for a room whose stored value differs, the toggle shows the wrong position and flipping it writes the hardcoded-derived value. Worse, the Allow-download toggle loops over `shares` and writes to every share; if `shares` is empty the click updates nothing yet flips the UI, so state and DB diverge with no feedback.
p1.recommendation: Seed both toggles from server state on mount (extend fetchRoomShares or a new fetch to return allow_download + public visibility), and surface success/error from updateShareDownloadPermission/updateRoomPublicVisibility instead of firing them fire-and-forget.

p1.title: Per-collaborator permission edit and privacy toggles are fire-and-forget with no rollback on failure
p1.detail: Unlike addPerson/removePerson (which roll back), the permission editor optimistically sets local permission then awaits updateSharePermission(share.id,p) and ignores the result; same for updateShareDownloadPermission and updateRoomPublicVisibility. If the server action returns an error, the UI stays in the new state while the DB does not, and no error toast appears — an inconsistency regression against the rest of the panel's error-handling contract.
p1.recommendation: Inspect the returned {error} and revert local state + setError on failure, matching removePerson's rollback pattern.

p1.title: Primary CTA gradient uses GOLD instead of canon EMBER
p1.detail: Canon reserves GOLD #D4AF37 for ceremonial/focus and EMBER #B85C38 for interactive/CTA. Both the Publish button and the QR Download button paint their primary action with a gold gradient, reading as ceremonial rather than actionable and conflicting with SharingPanel, whose primary buttons correctly use the ember accent.
p1.recommendation: Repaint the primary CTA in EMBER (T-token or #B85C38, or an ember->rustDeep gradient) to match SharingPanel's accent buttons; keep gold only for focus rings and ceremonial marks.

p1.title: Pure-black scrim breaks warm-ink canon and sibling consistency
p1.detail: PublishModal and QRShareModal dim the backdrop with pure black, while sibling share surfaces use a warm umber scrim. Canon shadows/overlays are warm-ink (rgba(64,59,54,x)); pure black is cooler and visibly inconsistent when these modals open over the same app chrome.
p1.recommendation: Switch both scrims to the warm umber used by siblings (rgba(42,34,24,.5)) so all four share surfaces dim identically.

p1.title: Primary CTAs painted GOLD, violating the 'gold is palace-only' rule
p1.detail: The main action buttons (Submit report, Create passcode, Create another) use a gold->goldDark gradient. Canon (libraryTokens.ts) is explicit: GOLD #D4AF37 is ceremonial/palace-only (wing seals, focus rings, on-this-day frames) and 'Never spend gold on a generic button, filter, divider or accent.' The interactive/CTA color is EMBER #B85C38. Using gold on a moderation/report submit button is exactly the misuse the canon forbids.
p1.recommendation: Repaint primary CTAs with EMBER (#B85C38) — solid fill or ember->rustDeep gradient — and reserve gold strictly for focus rings / ceremonial framing.

p1.title: Selection/active state (wing & expiry chips) tinted GOLD instead of EMBER
p1.detail: Selected wing chips and the active expiry chip use gold border, `${gold}15` fill and goldDark text to signal ACTIVE/interactive state, and the checkboxes' accentColor is gold. Canon assigns the active/interactive/selected state to EMBER #B85C38; gold must not carry a filter/toggle state.
p1.recommendation: Drive selected/active chip and checkbox accentColor with EMBER (#B85C38) at rest-to-active; keep gold out of toggle states entirely.

p1.title: Multi-wing selection silently drops all but the first wing
p1.detail: The wing picker is built as a multi-select: selectedWingIds is an array, toggleWing adds/removes, and multiple chips can appear selected with active styling. But handleCreate only ever uses selectedWingIds[0]. A user who selects three wings gets a single passcode covering only one wing, with no warning — the UI promises multi-wing sharing the backend call never delivers.
p1.recommendation: Either loop createPasscode over every selectedWingIds entry and surface a combined result, or constrain the picker to single-select (radio semantics) so the UI matches one-wing-per-share behavior.

p1.title: Block failure shows raw window.alert with a hardcoded English string
p1.detail: confirm.ts exists specifically to avoid raw system dialogs in WKWebView (they render origin-prefixed — an Apple 'wrapped website' tell), and the codebase routes confirms through confirmDialog. But the block failure path calls window.alert directly with an un-i18n'd fallback 'Could not complete this action.' This violates the branded-dialog canon and surfaces an untranslated English string (res.error from the server is also raw English like 'Not authenticated').
p1.recommendation: Replace with an inline error state (like the report dialog's role='alert' block) or a branded toast, using a translated key such as t('safetyBlockError'); do not surface the raw server error string to users.

p1.title: Navigation to a shared room guesses the wing from an ID prefix and silently lands in the wrong wing
p1.detail: The onNavigateToRoom callback derives the wing purely from the room-id prefix (ro->roots, tv->travel, ne->nest, cf->craft, pa->passions, else roots). The AcceptedShare already carries the real wingName/wingIcon and a placedInWingId, but the panel passes only roomId, forcing this brittle guess. Any custom room, renamed room, or room whose id doesn't match a known 2-char prefix defaults to 'roots' and enters the wrong wing.
p1.recommendation: Change onNavigateToRoom to accept the wing explicitly (like OnThisDay/TimeCapsuleReveal which pass (wingId, roomId)). Pass share.placedInWingId (or the resolved wing) from the panel instead of prefix-guessing.

p1.title: Failed fetch leaves both panels stuck on the loading state forever
p1.detail: Both panels call the server action with .then(...) only — no .catch() and no error/empty fallback on the fetch. If getAcceptedShares()/getPendingInvites() rejects (transient network error, auth expiry, server exception), setLoading(false) never runs, so the panel is pinned on 'loading...' with no retry and no recovery except closing and reopening.
p1.recommendation: Add a .catch(() => { setLoading(false); setError(...) }) (or try/finally in an async effect) so loading always clears, and surface a retry/empty state. Apply the same fix to InviteNotificationsPanel's getPendingInvites effect.

p1.title: getPendingInvites builds an unescaped .or() filter from user email — invites can silently fail to load
p1.detail: The pending/accepted queries interpolate the raw email into a PostgREST .or() string: `shared_with_email.eq.${userEmail},shared_with_id.eq.${user.id}`. PostgREST .or() parsing treats commas and parentheses as syntax; emails containing a '+' tag or other reserved characters (sub-addressing is common) can break the filter or match nothing, so a legitimately-invited user sees an empty invites/shared list.
p1.recommendation: Quote the value per PostgREST rules (e.g. shared_with_email.eq."${userEmail}") or run two separate .eq() queries and merge in JS, so emails with reserved characters resolve reliably.

p1.title: ReactionBar spends GOLD on a generic interactive state, violating the palace-only rule
p1.detail: The active/reacted reaction pill uses GOLD for its border, background tint and text. libraryTokens codifies GOLD (#D4AF37) as palace-only and explicitly 'Never spend gold on a generic button, filter, divider or accent.' A user-selected reaction chip is a generic active-toggle, so this is a canon misuse that makes reactions read as ceremonial rather than interactive.
p1.recommendation: Swap the reacted state to EMBER: border/text #B85C38 (or EMBER_GLYPH #9A4F2A for text on light) with a `${EMBER}15` tint background, mirroring the InviteNotificationsPanel accept-CTA palette.

p1.title: ReactionBar uses off-canon walnut/sandstone/black instead of INK/MUTED/HAIRLINE and warm-ink shadow
p1.detail: ReactionBar predates the Atrium reskin its siblings received. Text uses T.color.walnut #8B7355 ('non-text ink'), borders T.color.sandstone #D6CCBA instead of HAIRLINE #E3D6BC, the + button T.color.muted #857B70 instead of canon MUTED #716A5E, and the picker popup casts a cold black shadow rgba(0,0,0,0.1) instead of warm-ink rgba(64,59,54,x). Placed next to canonized panels it visibly drifts (grayer text, greener-gray borders, cold shadow).
p1.recommendation: Retoken ReactionBar to canon: text INK #403B36, secondary MUTED #716A5E, borders HAIRLINE #E3D6BC, and shadow SHADOW[1] = 0 0.25rem 1rem rgba(64,59,54,0.07) from libraryTokens.

p2plus.title: Off-canon black modal shadow (also px units)
p2plus.recommendation: Use a warm-ink shadow in rem, e.g. 0 0.5rem 2rem rgba(64,59,54,0.18).

p2plus.title: Primary text uses cool charcoal #1F1B1A, not canon INK #403B36
p2plus.recommendation: Point primary text at canon INK (T.color.inkSoft / #403B36) in PublishModal, QRShareModal and ShareCard.

p2plus.title: PublishModal selection accent is GOLD where EMBER is expected
p2plus.recommendation: Use EMBER for selected border/tint and checkbox accentColor; reserve gold for the ceremonial 'Published' badge.

p2plus.title: QR frame & canvas borders use near-invisible non-canon hairlines
p2plus.recommendation: Use canon HAIRLINE #E3D6BC (1px) for card/canvas frames.

p2plus.title: QRShareModal action buttons fall below the 2.75rem touch target
p2plus.recommendation: Add minHeight: T.touch (2.75rem) to Copy/Download/Close buttons.

p2plus.title: Publish/QR modals skip responsive hooks used elsewhere on the surface
p2plus.recommendation: Adopt useIsMobile()/useIsCompact() inline adjustments for padding and touch sizing.

p2plus.title: QRShareModal generate effect omits t from deps, so a locale switch leaves a stale error message
p2plus.recommendation: Add t to the dependency array (or read the error string lazily at catch time from a ref).

p2plus.title: ShareCard image OG render is async but download/share can fire before onload completes
p2plus.recommendation: Track a cardReady state set true after render and disable/soft-block Download/Share until true, mirroring QRShareModal.

p2plus.title: QRShareModal copy-link fallback comment is a no-op — clipboard failure gives the user nothing
p2plus.recommendation: Implement the promised fallback (select URL text / execCommand copy) or surface a brief 'copy failed' hint.

p2plus.title: PublishModal publish diff can no-op silently when server returns already-published rooms filtered out of the tree
p2plus.recommendation: Ensure getMyPublishableContent returns and renders any currently-published wing/room so users can always unpublish.

p2plus.title: SharingPanel 'QR' button label is hardcoded, not translated
p2plus.recommendation: Route the aria-label (and ideally visible label) through t(), e.g. aria-label={t('shareViaQR')}.

p2plus.title: PublishModal has no focus trap and no reduced-motion guard on its spinner
p2plus.recommendation: Add useFocusTrap(true) and wrap the spin keyframe in a prefers-reduced-motion guard, as SharingPanel does.

p2plus.title: QRShareModal lacks a focus trap and its buttons dip below touch minimum
p2plus.recommendation: Add useFocusTrap(true) and minHeight 2.75rem on Copy/Download/close buttons.

p2plus.title: ShareCard social share links lack per-platform aria-labels; some platform names are English literals
p2plus.recommendation: Localize the Email label while keeping proper-noun brand names as-is.

p2plus.title: ShareCard OG canvas hardcodes Georgia/serif — non-Latin locale titles may render poorly
p2plus.recommendation: Optionally load the brand webfont for canvas rendering or verify wrapText handles longer DE/FR strings.

p2plus.title: Cold black overlays/shadows instead of warm-ink rgba(64,59,54,x)
p2plus.recommendation: Replace overlay/shadow rgba with warm ink: scrims rgba(64,59,54,0.5), shadows via SHADOW/HOVER_SHADOW tokens.

p2plus.title: BlockedAccountsPanel uses hardcoded #FFF surface and cream (not HAIRLINE) borders
p2plus.recommendation: Use cream/linen surface and canon hairline #E3D6BC borders.

p2plus.title: Secondary text uses walnut #8B7355 rather than canon MUTED #716A5E
p2plus.recommendation: Use T.color.muted for secondary/hint text and ghost-button labels; prefer canon #716A5E.

p2plus.title: No focus-ring / visible focus styling; gold canon focus ring unused
p2plus.recommendation: Apply the canon gold focus ring on keyboard focus for chips, copy buttons and modal actions.

p2plus.title: Native emoji glyphs as iconography — inconsistent, unstyled polish
p2plus.recommendation: Replace literal glyphs with the project's SVG/icon components, sized in rem and canon-colored.

p2plus.title: Report dialog error state not cleared when the dialog is reopened
p2plus.recommendation: Add setError(false) alongside setDone(false) in the report menu-item onClick.

p2plus.title: getMyPasscodes failure is swallowed with no user feedback
p2plus.recommendation: Add a .catch and handle res.ok===false to set a lightweight inline notice.

p2plus.title: Custom passcode length not validated before submit; round-trip failure only
p2plus.recommendation: Validate customPasscode length (4-20) client-side and disable create / show inline hint when invalid.

p2plus.title: Motion effects have no reduced-motion guard
p2plus.recommendation: Read a usePrefersReducedMotion()/matchMedia hook and drop transitions (and optionally blur) when reduced motion is requested.

p2plus.title: Dialogs lack focus trap, initial focus, and focus restoration
p2plus.recommendation: Focus first control on open, trap Tab, restore focus to opener on close, add Escape-to-close to the SafetyMenu report dialog.

p2plus.title: Menu popover and dialogs never consult responsive hooks (mobile/portrait)
p2plus.recommendation: Use useIsMobile()/useIsPortrait() to promote the safety menu and long PasscodeModal to a bottom-sheet on phones.

p2plus.title: Radio and checkbox labels give an undersized tap surface
p2plus.recommendation: Give radio/checkbox label rows minHeight 2.75rem and align-items center.

p2plus.title: ReactionBar mixes raw px into border sizing, breaking rem discipline
p2plus.recommendation: Express as 0.0625rem solid/dashed #E3D6BC to match sibling hairline convention.

p2plus.title: Panel surfaces use linen (#F2EDE4) not canon CREAM (#FCFAF5) as the base
p2plus.recommendation: Lift the panel base toward CREAM (`${T.color.cream}f8`) or document linen-as-frosted-glass as deliberate.

p2plus.title: Focus-ring styling is inconsistent between the two sibling panels
p2plus.recommendation: Add the same .swm-panel button:focus-visible gold focus ring block so both panels share the canon ring.

p2plus.title: Room cards and header/meta rows collapse the type ramp to a single 0.8125rem size, flattening hierarchy
p2plus.recommendation: Bump the room-name line to RT.body 0.9375rem (or titleS) and keep metadata at 0.8125rem.

p2plus.title: ReactionBar '+' add-reaction affordance is a bare typographic plus, off the icon language
p2plus.recommendation: Replace '+' with a small canon plus/smiley-add SVG stroked in currentColor; align hover to the picker's warmStone background.

p2plus.title: Reaction counts never reconcile with the server (stale multi-user counts)
p2plus.recommendation: After toggleReaction resolves, re-fetch getReactionSummary or have toggleReaction return the fresh summary.

p2plus.title: memoryCount renders 'undefined' when the count is missing
p2plus.recommendation: Coalesce to 0: String(share.memoryCount ?? 0), and skip the memories chip for wing rows once the wing-share fix lands.

p2plus.title: Reaction SVG icons injected via dangerouslySetInnerHTML have no accessible label on the count chip
p2plus.recommendation: Add aria-label={t(`reaction_${r.emoji}`)} and aria-pressed={r.reacted} to the chip buttons.

p2plus.title: SharedWithMePanel lacks the visible focus outline InviteNotificationsPanel provides
p2plus.recommendation: Add a .swm-panel button:focus-visible gold outline rule mirroring InviteNotificationsPanel.

p2plus.title: SharedWithMe room-card buttons have no explicit min-height (borderline touch target)
p2plus.recommendation: Add minHeight 2.75rem to the room-card button.

p2plus.title: ReactionBar picker is not viewport-aware and animates without a reduced-motion guard
p2plus.recommendation: Flip the picker to a bottom sheet on useIsMobile() and drop transition:'all' or wrap motion in a prefers-reduced-motion guard.

p2plus.title: Inline SVG reaction icons are not marked decorative for assistive tech
p2plus.recommendation: Add aria-hidden='true' to icon spans and ensure each reaction button exposes an accessible name.

strengths: SharingPanel is the canon exemplar for the whole surface: warm-ink scrim rgba(42,34,24,.4), warm-ink shadow rgba(64,59,54,0.14), #E3D6BC hairlines, EMBER (#B85C38) toggles/CTAs, GOLD (#D4AF37) focus ring, reduced-motion gate, useFocusTrap, and useIsMobile responsive padding/touch targets.

SharingPanel uses optimistic UI with correct rollback: addPerson, removePerson and handleToggle all revert local state (and re-apply prevShares) when the server action returns {error} — the pattern the other fire-and-forget handlers should follow.

Consistent modal skeleton across all four files: role=dialog + aria-modal, cream/linen panels, min(Xrem,Yvw) widths, 90dvh maxHeight, safe-area-inset-bottom padding, mp-scroll, plus Escape-to-close and backdrop-click-to-close (PublishModal correctly guards both against closing mid-transition via !isPending).
Correct type system throughout: Fraunces (T.font.display) for H2/H3 and Source Sans (T.font.body) for body/buttons, with a uniform scale (1.375rem titles, 0.8125rem hints) across the four files.

QRShareModal generation is robust: async qrcode import guarded by a cancelled flag + null canvasRef check, a proper try/catch surfacing t('qrError') on failure, and a download button disabled until qrReady.

PublishModal's wing/room selection state machine is coherent: toggleWing cascades to child rooms, toggleRoom auto-selects/deselects the parent wing on last/first child change, and selectAll/deselectAll cover both sets.
publishRoom server action correctly reconciles local room IDs (regex ^[a-z]{2}\d+$) to DB UUIDs, creating the row if missing before updating publish state.
Sizing is rem-based with px reserved for hairlines; ShareCard's OG canvas correctly stays in px and documents it as intentional.
Touch-target discipline in SharingPanel and ShareCard (explicit minHeight 2.75rem on interactive buttons), and SharingPanel bumps input fontSize to 1rem on mobile to prevent iOS zoom.
The DB-backed public link path (copyPublicLink -> /public/{slug}) genuinely works, giving a correct model to repoint the broken QR/generic-link path toward.

areas.summary: The Visit area is not production-ready: two P0 defects break its core purpose and privacy contract. Guests can walk into a published palace and see memory paintings, but tapping one does nothing — the entire payoff of reading someone's memories is unreachable — while the 2D deep-view gallery leaks every memory regardless of the owner's "displayed" visibility flag. On top of that, the whole surface has drifted off-canon (gold spent on generic buttons/dividers, near-black instead of warm ink, frosted-glass backgrounds, video rendered as a static img) and carries a cluster of visibility-contract ambiguities in visit-actions.ts. The shared TuscanCard system, server-side gating, and 3D input-modality handling are strong, but the P0s must be fixed before this ships.

p0.title: Clicking any memory painting in the visitor walk does nothing (no memory viewer)
p0.detail: InteriorScene fires onMemoryClick with the actual memory object for normal painting taps (InteriorScene.tsx line 2207 'else onMemoryClickRef.current(hovMem.current)'), plus '__upload_painting__' and '__upload__'. The visitor walk handler only reacts to '__back__' and silently ignores everything else. In the owner palace the same callback is handleMemClick which opens a memory-detail viewer (MemoryPalace.tsx line 1187). So a guest can walk into a room, see the paintings, tap one, and nothing happens — the core payoff of visiting a published palace (reading the memories) is unreachable.
p0.recommendation: Add a read-only memory-detail modal: when mem is an object (not a control string), set a selectedMemory state and render a viewer (title/desc/media). Keep '__upload_painting__' and '__upload__' as no-ops so guest upload stations do nothing gracefully.

p0.title: Deep-view room gallery leaks ALL memories, ignoring the owner's 'displayed' visibility flag
p0.detail: getPublishedMemories (the sole data source for the room deep view) selects every row for the room with no visibility filter. The 3D visitor paths (getVisitorWingData / getVisitorPalaceData) DO read and honor 'displayed' (they map displayed: m.displayed !== false), but the deep-view 2D gallery does not. Any memory the owner has hidden from display is still rendered publicly on /visit/[userId]/[wingSlug]/[roomId]. This is an inconsistency between the two visitor surfaces and a privacy/data-leak regression.
p0.recommendation: Add `.neq("displayed", false)` (or `.not("displayed","is",false)`) to the getPublishedMemories query, mirroring the displayed handling used by getVisitorWingData/getVisitorPalaceData, so hidden memories don't leak into the deep view.

p1.title: Primary CTA, Follow, and Passcode buttons all spend GOLD — violating THE ONE RULE (gold is palace-only, EMBER is the interactive color)
p1.detail: Canon codifies that GOLD (#D4AF37) is ceremonial/focus ONLY ('Never spend gold on a generic button, filter, divider or accent') and EMBER (#B85C38) is THE interactive/CTA color. On this surface EMBER is never used; instead the hero 'Walk through 3D' CTA, the Follow button, and the Passcode submit button are all gold/terracotta gradients, and the wing 'Walk through 3D →' link is goldDark. Gold is being spent on every generic button while the canonical interactive color is entirely absent, so nothing reads as the true primary action and the surface drifts from its sibling Library/Atrium (which reserve gold and drive CTAs with ember).
p1.recommendation: Repaint the primary CTA, Follow, and Passcode submit with EMBER #B85C38 (or the ember gradient used by sibling surfaces) and reserve gold strictly for the sealed/ceremonial header accent and focus rings.

p1.title: Headings use near-black charcoal #1F1B1A instead of canon INK #403B36
p1.detail: Every heading, strong stat number, and modal title on both surfaces is painted T.color.charcoal = #1F1B1A, a cold near-black. Canon INK is the warm #403B36 (present in the theme as inkSoft/land.inkBody but not used here). The result is text that is colder and higher-contrast than the warm-ink specified by canon, breaking visual consistency with Library/Atrium which use #403B36.
p1.recommendation: Switch primary text from T.color.charcoal (#1F1B1A) to canon INK #403B36 (T.color.inkSoft) across headings, stat numbers, and modal titles on both files.

p1.title: Clicking a wing building on the exterior does nothing; only the front door works
p1.detail: ExteriorScene calls onRoomClick with arbitrary wing/hit ids (InteriorScene analog lines 3084/3115 'onRoomClickRef.current(hits[0].object.userData.roomId)') and with '__entrance__' for the door. handleExteriorClick only navigates when wingId === '__entrance__' and ignores every other id. A guest who taps a wing building on the exterior gets no response, with no tooltip or feedback to explain that they must click the central door instead.
p1.recommendation: Handle wing-id clicks from the exterior (navigate to entrance, or directly to that wing's corridor if the id matches a published wing slug) so exterior wing clicks are not silently swallowed.

p1.title: getPublishedRooms / getVisitorWingData return ALL rooms in a published wing, ignoring per-room published_at
