p1.detail: getPublishedRooms selects rooms only by wing_id with no filter on published_at (line 90-93) — comment says 'if the wing is published, all its rooms are visible'. getVisitorWingData does the same (line 326-329) and getPublishedMemories returns every memory in the room with no displayed/published filter (line 174-178). If a room or memory was never intended to be public, publishing the wing exposes it to guests. This is a data-visibility/functionality contract question introduced/assumed by the overhaul; at minimum it makes room-level publish state (published_at is selected on rooms elsewhere) meaningless here.
p1.recommendation: Confirm the intended contract. If per-room publishing exists, filter rooms by .not('published_at','is',null) and filter memories by displayed !== false. If wing-level publish is authoritative, remove the misleading published_at selection to avoid future confusion.

p1.title: GOLD spent as generic card/divider accent across the whole surface (canon violation)
p1.detail: libraryTokens codifies THE ONE RULE: GOLD #D4AF37 is 'the palace itself' ONLY (wing seals, focus rings, on-this-day frames) and 'Never spend gold on a generic button, filter, divider or accent.' On this surface gold is spent exactly that way in two places that repeat on every render: every glass TuscanCard carries a gold top hairline, and every TuscanSectionHeader (Memory Gallery, Guestbook) draws a gold underline rule. The room banner, breadcrumb, cards and section rules all end up gilded, so gold loses its ceremonial meaning.
p1.recommendation: Per canon, drop the gold card top-border and gold section-underline on this ordinary content surface. Use a wing-accent rule (accentRule(wingAccent(wing.slug))) or a neutral HAIRLINE #E3D6BC seam for section headers, and reserve gold for a genuine palace seal/focus ring only.

p1.title: Off-canon page background and card glass instead of CREAM canvas
p1.detail: The page canvas is a linen/warmStone/sandstone gradient (#F2EDE4 / #E5DDD0 / #D6CCBA) and content sits on translucent 'glass' TuscanCards (backdrop-blur over rgba(255,255,255,0.45)). Canon bg is a flat CREAM #FCFAF5 with warm-ink shadowed cards. The greyish-stone gradient + frosted glass reads as a different, older visual language than the current libraryTokens surfaces (Library/Atrium).
p1.recommendation: Move the surface toward canon: CREAM #FCFAF5 page background, opaque cards on HAIRLINE #E3D6BC borders with SHADOW ramp, and retire backdrop-blur glass here so Visit matches the reskinned Library/Atrium.

p1.title: Room deep view never verifies the room itself is visible/published — only the wing
p1.detail: RoomVisitPage gates on the wing's published_at (`.not("published_at","is",null)`) but fetches the room only by id + wing_id with no published/visibility check, then renders it. rooms carries a published_at column (getPublishedRooms selects it) yet it is ignored here. If room-level publishing is meant to be independent, an unpublished room inside a published wing is fully exposed via a direct link.
p1.recommendation: Decide the visibility model. If rooms are independently published, add `.not("published_at","is",null)` to the room query; if all rooms of a published wing are public by design, add a code comment stating that so the omission is clearly intentional (keep consistent with getPublishedRooms comment).

p1.title: Video memories render as a static , so playback is impossible
p1.detail: MemoryCard treats type 'video' as an image: isImage includes 'video' and the only media element rendered for images is . A video file_url pointed at an tag will show a broken/blank image with no controls and no way to play it. Audio has a dedicated
p1.recommendation: Split 'video' out of isImage and render a `

p2plus.title: Cold black shadows rgba(0,0,0,x) everywhere instead of canon warm-ink rgba(64,59,54,x)
p2plus.recommendation: Replace rgba(0,0,0,x) shadows with the canon warm-ink SHADOW ramp rgba(64,59,54,x) (import SHADOW/HOVER_SHADOW from libraryTokens) on both files.

p2plus.title: Hero CTA hover offsets and avatar shadow use px, not rem
p2plus.recommendation: Convert transform/shadow offsets to rem (translateY(-0.125rem), 0 0.375rem 1.25rem ...), ideally reusing HOVER_LIFT/HOVER_SHADOW tokens.

p2plus.title: Passcode input font-size 0.875rem risks iOS zoom and uses raw monospace
p2plus.recommendation: Raise input to fontSize '1rem' and use a defined monospace token or Source Sans with letter-spacing rather than the raw 'monospace' keyword.

p2plus.title: Interactive wing cards and passcode input have no visible focus ring
p2plus.recommendation: Add a canon GOLD focus ring (outline 0.1875rem solid #D4AF37, offset 0.1875rem) on :focus-visible for the wing cards and restore a visible focus style on the passcode input.

p2plus.title: Overview 'Enter 3D Palace' CTA and Wing cards use owner?.id which can be undefined, producing a broken /visit/undefined/... route
p2plus.recommendation: Guard on owner before rendering the CTA/wing grid, or derive a required ownerId prop from the server (params userId) instead of owner?.id so routes can never contain 'undefined'.

p2plus.title: PalaceSubNav management callbacks are all empty no-ops in visitor mode without disabling the controls
p2plus.recommendation: Pass a visitor/read-only flag to PalaceSubNav so owner-only management buttons are hidden entirely, instead of rendering buttons bound to empty handlers.

p2plus.title: Hardcoded English user-facing strings in overview stats and section header
p2plus.recommendation: Route wing/Wing labels and the 'X's Palace' title through useTranslation with proper plural/interpolation keys across all 5 locales.

p2plus.title: Guestbook error/'Failed' fallback strings are hardcoded English (both fallbacks)
p2plus.recommendation: Replace with a translated fallback, e.g. t("guestbookSendError") / t("commentFailed"), added across en/nl/de/es/fr.

p2plus.title: Guestbook close button below 2.75rem touch target
p2plus.recommendation: Bump width/height to 2.75rem (keep the 14px icon centered), or add hit-slop via padding so the tappable area reaches 44px.

p2plus.title: Mobile guestbook FAB and passcode submit/input are under 2.75rem tall
p2plus.recommendation: Enforce minHeight: '2.75rem' (and equivalent minWidth for icon-only circles) on the guestbook FAB, passcode input, and passcode submit button.

p2plus.title: Walk overlay error toast uses off-canon web-red #c0392b and pure #fff
p2plus.recommendation: Use T.color.error for the toast background and T.color.cream for its text to match the success toast and the warm palette.

p2plus.title: 'X's Palace' possessive and 'Wing'/'wings' labels are hardcoded English, off-brand vs i18n'd siblings
p2plus.recommendation: Route the palace-title and wing-count labels through translation keys so the header reads as a single, brand-consistent voice in all locales.

p2plus.title: No reduced-motion guard on the many entrance animations
p2plus.recommendation: Gate the animation property behind a reduced-motion check (usePrefersReducedMotion() returning animation: 'none') so motion-sensitive visitors get a static render.

p2plus.title: Guestbook toggle relies on title tooltip only for its accessible name on mobile
p2plus.recommendation: Add aria-label={t('guestbook')} to the guestbook toggle button so its purpose is announced when the text label is hidden on mobile.

p2plus.title: Card shadows use cold black rgba(0,0,0,x) instead of warm-ink rgba(64,59,54,x)
p2plus.recommendation: Replace all rgba(0,0,0,x) card shadows with the canon warm-ink ramp (SHADOW[1]/SHADOW[2] = rgba(64,59,54,0.07 / 0.14) and HOVER_SHADOW rgba(64,59,54,0.16)).

p2plus.title: Off-canon MUTED secondary text color (#857B70 vs canon #716A5E)
p2plus.recommendation: Align secondary text to canon MUTED #716A5E (theme has land.inkMutedLight: '#716A5E') for the breadcrumb, room subtitle and empty-state copy.

p2plus.title: Breadcrumb link hover spends GOLD (goldDark) on ordinary navigation
p2plus.recommendation: Use EMBER #B85C38 for the breadcrumb hover color instead of goldDark, matching canon interactive state.

p2plus.title: Loading skeleton is off-canon and inconsistent with the room surface it fronts
p2plus.recommendation: Rebuild the skeleton on CREAM #FCFAF5 at maxWidth 56rem mirroring the real room layout (banner block, title bar, memory-card grid of placeholders) so the loading→loaded transition is seamless and canon-colored.

p2plus.title: Breadcrumb wing/owner links build /visit/undefined/... when owner profile is null
p2plus.recommendation: Use the route's userId (always defined) instead of owner?.id for the wing crumb href; thread a userId prop through and build `/visit/${userId}/${wing.slug}`.

p2plus.title: recordVisit is fire-and-forget from a server component and may be dropped
p2plus.recommendation: Either await recordVisit(...) (it already dedups and self-suppresses errors) or move it into the client via a useEffect that POSTs to a route handler after mount, so its lifetime isn't tied to the render response.

p2plus.title: No prefers-reduced-motion guard on the surface's entrance animations
p2plus.recommendation: Add a @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block to TuscanStyles disabling animation/transition, or gate animation props via a useReducedMotion() hook.

p2plus.title: Reaction picker only dismisses on mousedown; no touch or Escape close
p2plus.recommendation: Listen on 'pointerdown' (covers mouse+touch) and add a keydown handler closing on Escape; consider aria-expanded on the trigger and role='menu' on the popup.

p2plus.title: Room-visit surface relies solely on useIsMobile (no compact/portrait/landscape branch)
p2plus.recommendation: Consider useIsCompact for landscape-phone/iPad-split tuning of maxWidth and header banner heights; low priority given the fluid grid.

p2plus.title: Text-only and audio memory cards lean on saturated HSL banners that clash with the warm palette
p2plus.recommendation: Constrain memory-hue banners toward warm/desaturated values (or overlay a cream veil) so they harmonize with canon, and consider a lightweight custom audio affordance rather than the raw native control.

p2plus.title: Wing deep-view page silently collapses all wing links to the palace overview
p2plus.recommendation: If wing pages are gone, point the wing breadcrumb at /visit/${userId} directly (matching the redirect target) to avoid an extra hop; or restore a lightweight wing view so the crumb is meaningful.

p2plus.title: Guests (logged-out visitors) get reaction/comment controls that will fail server-side
p2plus.recommendation: Gate interactive reaction/comment affordances on currentUserId (show a 'sign in to react' prompt for guests), or have handleToggle reconcile with the server result and revert the optimistic update when {ok:false}.

p2plus.title: Reaction picker popup lacks aria roles / labelling
p2plus.recommendation: Add aria-haspopup='true' and aria-expanded={showPicker} to the trigger, role='menu' to the popup, and aria-label={t('reaction_x')} on each option button (not just title).

strengths: Consistent use of the shared TuscanCard / TuscanSectionHeader system and ANIM.tuscanFadeSlideUp animation grammar gives the overview page a coherent, self-consistent rhythm with staggered card reveals.
Fraunces (T.font.display) for headings and Source Sans (T.font.body) for body/meta is applied correctly and consistently across both surfaces, matching the canon type pairing.
Sizing is almost entirely in rem with px reserved for hairlines, and the hand-drawn SVG villa/arch/guestbook illustrations are a polished, on-brand warm-terracotta touch.
Empty/degenerate states are handled gracefully (conditional room-chip block, singular/plural wing labels, visitCount hidden when 0) so the layout never shows orphaned zeros or empty rails.
The 3D walk overlays reuse shared PalaceLoadingScreen and PalaceSubNav chrome, keeping the visitor walk visually aligned with the owner's own palace walk.
Robust server-side guarding on the overview page: non-public profiles, blocked relationships, and empty/zero-wing palaces all correctly notFound() before any client render (page.tsx lines 26-33).
recordVisit is correctly fire-and-forget with .catch(() => {}) and self-visits are skipped, so visit-recording can never break the page or inflate the owner's own counts.

Data-layer name resolution is defensive: mp_custom_rooms / mp_custom_wings are parsed with typeof checks and try/catch on JSON.parse, falling back to WING_ROOMS/WINGS defaults, so malformed owner settings won't throw.
The walk scene state machine (exterior -> entrance -> corridor -> room) with fade() transitions and guarded Suspense render conditions prevents rendering a scene with missing data.
GuestbookPanel handles loading, empty, sent, and error states explicitly and optimistically appends the new comment, with graceful catch for unauthenticated comment loads.

Input-modality gating is correct: the 3D MobileJoystick is shown via useTouchControls() (native + coarse-pointer + useIsMobile), never viewport width alone, so iPad/WKWebView touch users are never stranded (VisitorPalaceWalk.tsx:443).
No @media reliance anywhere — all responsiveness is inline styles keyed off useIsMobile()/useIsCompact(), including grid columns, padding, header height, and font sizes.

areas.summary: Auth is functionally solid on the happy path and on the hard-won iOS OAuth/MFA edge cases (fail-closed MFA, robust signOut, wedge-proof social buttons), but it is not release-clean: the surface carries a systemic canon-design break (wrong base font Manrope, off-canon gradient, terracotta instead of EMBER, GOLD misused as a primary CTA, and a passcode screen that reads as a different product) plus two real functional dead-ends — MFA-enrolled users lose /kep deep-link redirects, and wing-only passcode shares validate then 404. It also has three confirmed accessibility regressions (the mfaDigit aria-label is missing in all five locales so screen readers announce the raw key, the passcode error is never announced, and secondary links miss the 2.75rem touch minimum). Twelve P1s should be cleared before this area is considered done; the underlying auth logic is trustworthy, but the presentation, deep-link fidelity, and a11y need a focused pass.

p1.title: Auth layout base font is Manrope, not canon Fraunces/Source Sans
p1.detail: The (auth) layout wrapper sets the base font-family to 'Manrope' for the whole login/register surface. Canon body font is Source Sans and display is Fraunces. Child components override font on most text nodes via T.font, but any element that does NOT set fontFamily (native checkbox label fallback, browser autofill, placeholder inheritance) renders in a third, off-canon typeface. A sibling-inconsistent font family at the container root is a systemic canon break.
p1.recommendation: Replace the Manrope base with the canon stack "'Source Sans 3', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif" (i.e. T.font.body) so unstyled nodes inherit the canon body face.

p1.title: Layout background gradient uses off-canon hexes ending in a muddy taupe
p1.detail: The page background is a 3-stop gradient of #FAFAF7 / #F2EDE7 / #D4C5B2. None are canon: canon page bg is CREAM #FCFAF5. The final stop #D4C5B2 is a dull greyed taupe that reads cooler/dirtier than the warm CREAM used across the Atrium/Library, so the auth surface does not sit in the same tonal world as its sibling surfaces.
p1.recommendation: Rebuild the gradient from canon tokens, e.g. CREAM #FCFAF5 -> linen T.color.linen (#F2EDE4) -> warmStone (#E5DDD0), keeping it warm; drop #D4C5B2.

p1.title: Interactive color is terracotta #C66B3D, not canon EMBER #B85C38
p1.detail: Every CTA gradient, link, focus/active input border and icon uses T.color.terracotta = #C66B3D. Canon EMBER for interactive/CTA is #B85C38. C66B3D is visibly more orange/lighter, so the primary button gradient linear-gradient(terracotta, walnut) does not match the canon ember on the Atrium/Library CTAs, breaking cross-surface consistency of the single most prominent control.
p1.recommendation: Point the interactive color at canon EMBER #B85C38 (links, CTA gradient start, active input border, icons). Simplest durable fix: correct T.color.terracotta to #B85C38, or import EMBER from libraryTokens for these surfaces.

p1.title: Inputs have no visible focus ring; GOLD focus token unused
p1.detail: Every input sets outline: none and only animates border-color; there is no :focus style wiring a visible ring, and inline styles cannot express :focus. Canon reserves GOLD #D4AF37 for focus rings (focusRing in libraryTokens). The ceremonial GOLD is never used anywhere on this surface, and keyboard focus is effectively invisible on text inputs (polish + a11y-adjacent gap).
p1.recommendation: Add onFocus/onBlur handlers (or a small styled wrapper) applying the canon gold focusRing / EMBER border on focus, so keyboard users get a visible canon-gold ring and GOLD earns its ceremonial role.

p1.title: MFA success path drops /kep/ redirects (and any non-invite redirect)
p1.detail: For a normal password login, signIn preserves both /invite/ and /kep/ redirects (actions.ts 118-122) and handleSubmit honors result.redirect for any value. But when the user has MFA enrolled, the challenge-verify success branch only special-cases /invite/ and otherwise forces /atrium. A user who followed a /kep/ share link and has 2FA on is silently dumped to /atrium after entering their code, losing the destination a non-MFA user keeps. mfaRedirect is populated from result.redirect, so the data is present; the client just ignores it.
p1.recommendation: Honor the stored redirect the same way the password path does: navigate to mfaRedirect when it starts with /invite/ OR /kep/ (mirror the actions.ts allowlist), else /atrium. Ideally extract one shared safe-redirect helper so the two paths cannot drift again.

p1.title: MFA input aria-label key `mfaDigit` is missing in ALL 5 locales — screen readers announce the raw key
p1.detail: Each of the 6 MFA code inputs sets aria-label={tc("mfaDigit", { n: String(i + 1), total: "6" })}. common.mfaDigit is undefined in en, nl, de, es AND fr. useTranslation's fallback chain is sectionMessages[key] ?? enMessages[key] ?? key, so with the key absent everywhere it returns the literal "mfaDigit"; {n}/{total} never interpolate. All six inputs get the identical meaningless VoiceOver/TalkBack label "mfaDigit" instead of "Digit 1 of 6" — a real accessibility regression on the 2FA screen.
p1.recommendation: Add a `mfaDigit` key with interpolation to the `common` section of en/nl/de/es/fr, e.g. en: "Digit {n} of {total}". Add a build-time i18n key-presence test so aria-label keys can't silently fall through to the raw key.

p1.title: Passcode screen uses a completely different visual family from the other two Auth surfaces
p1.detail: forgot-password and reset-password render inside the warm-glass auth shell (gradient #FAFAF7->#D4C5B2, blurred cream card, terracotta CTAs). PasscodeEntry instead uses a linen->warmStone flat gradient, a solid TuscanCard, a monospace 1.5rem input, and GOLD-gradient buttons. Three sibling password/passcode-entry screens read as three different products, with no shared shell or token bridge between them.
p1.recommendation: Align PasscodeEntry to the auth shell: same gradient/card treatment, EMBER primary CTA, Source Sans body. Reserve the TuscanCard/gold look for its non-auth public-share context only, or wrap all three in one shared AuthCard.

p1.title: Passcode CTA uses GOLD as the primary interactive color (canon reserves GOLD for ceremonial/focus)
p1.detail: Both the submit button and the post-validation 'Enter Palace' button are painted with a gold->goldDark gradient and the lock/header icon is stroked in gold. Canon says GOLD (#D4AF37) is ceremonial/focus only; the interactive/CTA color is EMBER. The sibling forgot/reset buttons correctly use the terracotta->walnut EMBER-family gradient, so the passcode buttons look off-brand next to them.
p1.recommendation: Switch the passcode primary buttons to the EMBER gradient used elsewhere (linear-gradient(135deg, terracotta, walnut)), keeping gold only as the focus-ring / header accent.

p1.title: Wing-only passcode shares 404 at the destination (/public/[slug] assumes a room)
p1.detail: createPasscode() explicitly supports wing-only shares (inserts room_id: input.roomId || null when only wingId is given) and validatePasscode() returns such a share as valid, so PasscodeEntry shows 'Valid' and navigates to /public/${slug}. But getShareData() does supabase.from('rooms').eq('id', share.room_id).single() then `if (!room) return null`. For a wing share room_id is null, so the room lookup returns nothing and the page renders not-found. The passcode flow validates successfully but dead-ends.
p1.recommendation: Handle wing-only shares in getShareData(): when share.room_id is null, load the wing (and its rooms/gallery) instead of returning null, or have createPasscode/validatePasscode reject wing-only shares if /public only supports rooms. Keep the passcode 'valid' state and the public destination in agreement.

p1.title: Passcode error message is not announced to screen readers (no role=alert / aria-live)
p1.detail:
On the passcode surface a validation failure renders the error only as a plain

. Unlike forgot-password and reset-password (which wrap errors in role="alert"), this error is silent for assistive tech, and the input has no aria-invalid / aria-describedby link to it. A blind user submitting a wrong code gets no feedback beyond the border color changing.
p1.recommendation:
Wrap the error in

, add aria-invalid={!!error} and aria-describedby={error ? "passcode-error" : undefined} to the input, matching the forgot-password pattern.

p1.title: Text-only 'back to sign in' / 'back home' links fall short of the 2.75rem touch target
p1.detail: All three surfaces expose their secondary navigation as bare inline text links with only font-size and no padding/min-height. On a phone these are ~1.2rem tall tap targets, well under Apple's 2.75rem (T.touch) minimum, making them hard to hit and easy to mis-tap on the adjacent link.
p1.recommendation: Give these links display:inline-block; minHeight:2.75rem; padding:0.5rem 0.75rem (or wrap in a padded tappable area) so the interactive box meets the 2.75rem minimum on touch.

p2plus.title: Secondary text and input borders use off-canon MUTED and non-HAIRLINE tokens
p2plus.recommendation: Map muted->#716A5E, input/divider borders->HAIRLINE #E3D6BC, and body text->INK #403B36 (T.color.inkSoft already equals #403B36) for canon-accurate contrast and warmth.

p2plus.title: Container uses raw px and cool-grey shadow instead of rem + warm-ink shadow
p2plus.recommendation: Convert px to rem (maxWidth 27.5rem, padding 2.5rem 2.25rem, radius 1.25rem), use HAIRLINE #E3D6BC for the border, and adopt the canon warm-ink shadow (e.g. SHADOW[2] = 0 0.5rem 1.5rem rgba(64,59,54,0.14)).

p2plus.title: MFA back-to-login button border uses cream token, rendering an invisible/near-white outline
p2plus.recommendation: Use HAIRLINE #E3D6BC (or T.color.sandstone to match the other buttons) for the MFA secondary button border so it is visible and consistent.

p2plus.title: MFA active-digit border uses terracotta while the surrounding surface lacks any gold ceremony
p2plus.recommendation: Once the interactive color is corrected to EMBER #B85C38, these MFA states inherit the fix; keep ember (not gold) for the filled-digit state, which is semantically correct.

p2plus.title: handleMfaVerify leaves mfaLoading stuck true if the post-verify navigation is slow or the WKWebView wedges
p2plus.recommendation: Wrap the post-verify navigation in a try/finally or add a safety setTimeout(() => setMfaLoading(false), 8000) before calling nativeHardNav, so a dropped navigation re-enables the button and lets the user retry rather than stranding the screen.

p2plus.title: signIn returns a raw Supabase error message straight to the UI (unlocalized, provider-worded)
p2plus.recommendation: Map common Supabase auth error codes (invalid credentials, email not confirmed, rate-limited) to localized serverError() keys and return t(...) instead of the raw error.message; fall back to a generic localized message for unmapped codes.

p2plus.title: Register 'success' screen is terminal on email-confirmation flow but shows no resend / stuck-user recovery
p2plus.recommendation: Add a 'resend confirmation email' action on the success screen (calling a resend server action), and/or surface guidance for the already-registered case. At minimum keep the email around so resend can target it without re-entry.

p2plus.title: Register age-gate is client-only; server signUp does not enforce ageConfirmed
p2plus.recommendation: Include the age-confirmation in the submitted FormData and validate it server-side in signUp (reject when absent), so the attestation is enforced rather than merely gating a button.

p2plus.title: OAuth sign-in ignores the ?redirect= param entirely (deep-link destination lost for social login)
p2plus.recommendation: Accept an optional redirect in the OAuth opts, append it as ?redirect= to the web callbackRedirect (and thread it through the native custom-scheme handler) so social login honors invite/kep deep links like the password path does.

p2plus.title: Register password null-deref possible before try/catch if required attribute is bypassed
p2plus.recommendation: Guard with if (!password) { setError(t(...)); setLoading(false); return; } before the length check, or move the length/mismatch checks inside the try so a thrown value is surfaced and loading is reset.

p2plus.title: Age-confirmation checkbox is a 1rem x 1rem (16px) tap target — far below the 2.75rem minimum
p2plus.recommendation: Give the label a min-height of 2.75rem with vertical padding (padding: "0.5rem 0") so the whole row is a comfortable hit target, and/or scale the checkbox to ~1.25rem. Inline styles only, per canon.

p2plus.title: `register.unexpectedError` missing in all 5 locales — error falls back to a hardcoded English string
p2plus.recommendation: Reuse the existing, fully-translated common key: setError(tc("somethingWentWrong")). Remove the hardcoded English fallback literal.

p2plus.title: Secondary text links (forgot-password, footer Privacy/Terms, register/login switch) are sub-2.75rem tap targets
p2plus.recommendation: Give tappable links display:inline-block with vertical padding (e.g. padding:"0.5rem 0.25rem") to reach ~2.75rem effective height, and add horizontal spacing between the Privacy/Terms links. Applies to both login and register footers.

p2plus.title: No portrait/landscape or iPad adaptation via useIsMobile/useIsCompact/useIsPortrait
p2plus.recommendation: Acceptable as-is, but consider useIsPortrait()/useIsCompact() to tighten vertical rhythm in landscape/short viewports so the CTA stays reachable without scrolling on small phones.

p2plus.title: MFA 'back to login' button and OAuth buttons rely on padding for height; back button is marginally under 2.75rem
p2plus.recommendation: Add minHeight:"2.75rem" to the MFA back-to-login button to match the social-button baseline.

p2plus.title: CTA/accent color is off-canon terracotta #C66B3D instead of EMBER #B85C38
p2plus.recommendation: Reconcile the legacy T.color.terracotta with libraryTokens EMBER #B85C38 (or map auth CTAs to the EMBER token) so the interactive color matches canon across surfaces.

p2plus.title: Body ink and muted colors drift from canon INK/MUTED
p2plus.recommendation: Point auth title/body/muted colors at the canon INK (#403B36 / inkSoft) and MUTED (#716A5E) tokens for warm-ink consistency.

p2plus.title: Auth container font-family is 'Manrope', not the Fraunces/Source Sans canon
p2plus.recommendation: Change the container fallback to T.font.body ('Source Sans 3', …) so nothing silently renders in Manrope.

p2plus.title: Error-alert palette is hardcoded and inconsistent across the two form surfaces
p2plus.recommendation: Extract one shared error-banner style token set (warm-red on cream) and use it identically on all auth surfaces; at minimum make forgot-password use T.color.error like its sibling.

p2plus.title: reset-password re-hardcodes the entire auth shell instead of sharing it
p2plus.recommendation: Extract a shared AuthShell component (card + gradient + blobs) used by both the (auth) layout and reset-password so the surfaces stay pixel-identical.

p2plus.title: Passcode empty/error state relies on JS-set border color with no reduced-motion or token-consistent focus
p2plus.recommendation: Use a real CSS :focus-visible ring (gold) and gate the card entrance animation behind a prefers-reduced-motion guard for polish parity with the rest of the app.

p2plus.title: reset-password footer link is labeled 'Request new link' but routes to /login
p2plus.recommendation: Point this link to /forgot-password to match its label, or change the label to a 'back to sign in' string. Reuse the existing forgotPassword.backToSignIn / resetPassword.requestNewLink keys so the copy matches the destination.

p2plus.title: Passcode validation is a soft gate — /public/[slug] never re-checks the passcode
p2plus.recommendation: If the passcode is meant to gate access, have validatePasscode() set a short-lived signed cookie/token for that share id and require it in getShareData(); otherwise drop the passcode framing and treat the slug as the secret. Align the UI promise with the actual enforcement.

p2plus.title: reset-password relies on getUser() to detect the recovery session, but a normally logged-in user gets the reset form too
p2plus.recommendation: Distinguish the recovery flow explicitly (e.g. pass a ?type=recovery / one-time flag from the callback, or check the AAL/AMR of the session) rather than treating any authenticated session as a valid password-reset context.

p2plus.title: validatePasscode uses .single() on a non-unique passcode column — collisions surface as 'Invalid passcode'
p2plus.recommendation: Either enforce global passcode uniqueness among active shares (DB partial unique index) or scope the passcode per-owner/per-slug and require the slug in the URL; at minimum use .maybeSingle()/limit(1) and handle the multi-row case deterministically instead of silently failing valid codes.

p2plus.title: forgot-password success state is one-way; no way to correct a typo'd email without a full reload
p2plus.recommendation: Add a secondary 'try a different email' control in the success view that calls setSuccess(false) to return to the form, preserving the entered email if desired.

p2plus.title: Passcode result panel and success state give no live announcement after validation
p2plus.recommendation: Wrap the validated-share panel and the forgot-password success block in role="status" aria-live="polite" so the outcome is announced when the view swaps in.

p2plus.title: reset-password spinner/loading state has no accessible label
p2plus.recommendation: Add role="status" + visually-hidden {t("loading")} text (or aria-label) to the spinner container so the loading state is announced.

p2plus.title: No responsive hooks; portrait/landscape and small-phone sizing rely purely on fixed maxWidth
p2plus.recommendation: Introduce useIsCompact()/useIsPortrait() to tighten card padding (e.g. 1.5rem on compact) and heading size in short-landscape, keeping all branching inline per canon.

p2plus.title: Passcode code field lacks inputMode/enterKeyHint hints for on-screen keyboards
p2plus.recommendation: Add enterKeyHint="go" (and consider spellCheck={false}) so the mobile keyboard advertises the submit action for this code field.

p2plus.title: reset-password duplicates the (auth) layout chrome instead of living in the route group
p2plus.recommendation: Move reset-password under src/app/(auth)/ so it inherits the shared layout, or extract the wrapper into a shared component to keep safe-area/responsive handling in one place.

strengths: Consistent internal shared-style approach: login and register duplicate the exact same labelStyle/inputStyle/buttonStyle/divider/social-button token blocks, so the two sibling auth surfaces are visually identical to each other.
Inputs correctly use fontSize '1rem' to prevent iOS zoom, and social buttons honor the >=2.75rem touch-target rule via minHeight '2.75rem'.
All sizing inside the page components uses rem (padding, radii, font sizes); px is reserved for 1px hairline dividers (height 1), matching the canon px-only-for-hairlines rule.
Error states are styled consistently (role=alert, soft red #FDF2F2 / #FECACA) and success/MFA states get warm terracotta gradient icon medallions, giving the flow polished non-happy-path states.
Google and Apple provider buttons use correct brand styling (white with brand-multicolor G, solid black Apple) rather than off-brand recolors.

OAuth flows are hardened against the exact iOS 2.1a wedge history documented in memory: 45s safety timeout, visibilitychange backstop, and onDismiss reset guarantee the Apple/Google buttons can never stay stuck disabled (login/page.tsx 40-68; register 33-38, 282-283).

signIn fails CLOSED when MFA is required but no factor is returned — it tears down the partial AAL1 session and returns an error rather than granting a half-authenticated session (actions.ts 109-114).

signOut is genuinely robust: time-boxed server revoke raced against a 1500ms cap, then an authoritative loop expiring every sb-* cookie regardless of revoke outcome, while preserving mp_platform/mp_locale (actions.ts 134-152).

Login handleSubmit exhaustively handles every result shape — mfaRequired, success, error, an explicit unrecognized/empty-result fallback, plus a catch surfacing thrown server-action errors, so a tap is never a silent no-op (login/page.tsx 87-118).
Referral application correctly skips the Stripe-coupon fetch on iOS (Guideline 3.1.1) and is wrapped best-effort so a failed /api/referral never blocks signup success (register/page.tsx 80-96).
MFA 6-digit input is fully wired: per-digit advance, backspace-to-previous, paste-to-fill, auto-submit on the 6th digit, and code reset + refocus on invalid code (login/page.tsx 121-196).

areas.summary: The Landing area is functionally solid on the marketing page itself (real routed CTAs, a robust two-place iOS 3.1.1 seal, SSR-safe reveal animations, on-canon fonts and core palette) but is not launch-ready as a set because its highest-traffic inbound surface — the public share gallery (/public/[slug]) — is authored entirely in fixed px with zero responsive hooks, making the primary viral surface visibly oversized and un-adapted on phones and iPad. Two revenue/conversion-critical defects compound this: the /pricing IAP Upgrade button is gated on initIAP() rather than waitForProducts(), reviving the exact 'button errors on tap' regression Apple 2.1 has flagged before, and the iOS purchase-success toast leaks the raw i18n key 'subscriptionActivated' at the celebratory moment of a paid conversion. The public Follow control is also a dead no-op for logged-out visitors (the exact audience Landing targets), firing phantom UI and misleading analytics with no login redirect. Design polish is good on the main page but drifts off-canon across the share and pricing surfaces (terracotta #C66B3D vs EMBER #B85C38, gold spent on generic CTAs, cool-black shadows, rem-canon violations).

p0.title: PublicGallery has ZERO responsive hooks and hardcoded px sizing everywhere
p0.detail: The entire /public/[slug] gallery surface never imports or uses useIsMobile/useIsCompact/useIsPortrait (verified: no such imports in the file). All type scale, padding, and layout are fixed px literals that do not adapt to viewport — header at fontSize:32 with padding '40px 24px 32px', empty/error states at fontSize:28/48, cards at fontSize:17/12/11. On a phone the 32px title and 40px vertical padding are oversized with no portrait/landscape/iPad differentiation. Because share links are the primary viral/inbound surface Landing feeds, this is the most damaging multimodal gap in the audited set.
p0.recommendation: Import useIsMobile()/useIsCompact() and drive header font size, section padding, and grid density off them; convert px literals to rem (fontSize 2rem->~1.5rem on mobile, scale down padding). Match the hook-driven pattern already used correctly in ProfilePageClient.tsx.

p1.title: iapReady is derived from initIAP() return, not waitForProducts() — Upgrade button can enable before prices load
p1.detail: Verified at line 60: iapReady is set from initIAP().then((ok) => ...). iap.ts explicitly warns 'a successful init alone does NOT mean anything is purchasable. Gate purchase UI on [waitForProducts], never on initIAP()'s return value.' If prices haven't populated, getProduct returns '—' and purchase(productId) fails on tap (offer null -> resolve(false)) — the exact 'button errors on tap' regression Apple 2.1 flagged historically.
p1.recommendation: Replace initIAP().then(setIapReady) with initIAP() followed by waitForProducts() (or use isIAPReady()) so iapReady is set only once at least one product price has actually loaded, matching the documented contract in iap.ts.

p1.title: iOS purchase-success toast leaks a raw i18n key to the user
p1.detail: Verified at line 84: t("subscriptionActivated") || "Subscription activated!". The key subscriptionActivated is MISSING from the pricing namespace in all five locales (en/nl/de/es/fr). t() falls back English->raw-key, and the || guard cannot work because t() returns the truthy raw key (never empty). So on a successful iOS IAP purchase the user sees the literal token 'subscriptionActivated' at the celebratory moment of a paid conversion.
p1.recommendation: Add subscriptionActivated to pricing.* in all 5 message files, OR switch to the guard used elsewhere: t("subscriptionActivated") !== "subscriptionActivated" ? ... : "Subscription activated!". Note || cannot work because t() returns the truthy raw key.

p1.title: Follow button silently no-ops for anonymous visitors (phantom UI + misleading analytics, no login prompt)
p1.detail: On a public /u/[username] profile an unauthenticated visitor has is_own=false, so the Follow button renders. handleFollow calls toggleFollow(profile.id); server-side toggleFollow does `if (!user || user.id === targetUserId) return { following: false }` and never persists. But the client unconditionally does setIsFollowing(following), setFollowerCount(c => c + (following?1:-1)) and fires track('social_follow_toggle'). The button looks clickable, does nothing, never routes to /login or /register, and emits a misleading analytics event — a dead control for exactly the logged-out audience Landing targets.
p1.recommendation: Gate on auth: pass isAuthenticated into ProfileCard (ProfilePageClient already has it) and, when false, redirect to /login?next=... on click instead of calling toggleFollow. At minimum, have toggleFollow return { authRequired: true } and short-circuit the optimistic UI + track() when unauthenticated.

p1.title: PublicGallery is built entirely in px, violating the rem canon
p1.detail: The /public/[slug] share surface hard-codes px for every dimension: type sizes (32,28,20,17,14,13,12,11,10), paddings ('40px 24px 32px','14px 16px 16px'), radii (16,20,12,10), gaps and widths (maxWidth:1000, width:60). Canon requires rem for sizing (px only for hairlines) so the page scales with root font size and matches siblings. Its sibling /u/[username] is correctly authored in rem throughout, so the two share surfaces are internally inconsistent.
p1.recommendation: Convert all px sizing/spacing/radius/type in PublicGallery, MemoryCard and MemoryLightbox to rem (32px->2rem, 16px->1rem, '40px 24px 32px'->'2.5rem 1.5rem 2rem'), keeping px only for 1px hairlines. Pull sizes from T.fontSize / T.space / T.radius to match the rem-based ProfilePageClient.

p1.title: Lightbox and full-viewport containers use 100vh instead of 100dvh (iOS toolbar clipping)
p1.detail: Verified: 100vh appears 3x. Full-viewport containers use minHeight:'100vh' and the lightbox media uses height:'60vh'/maxHeight:'90vh'. On iOS Safari the dynamic browser chrome makes 100vh taller than the visible area, so the footer CTA and lightbox close button can be clipped below the toolbar. ProfilePageClient.tsx correctly uses '100dvh' — this file was not updated to match.
p1.recommendation: Replace 100vh with 100dvh on the loading, error, and root containers; use maxHeight:'90dvh' for the lightbox shell so the Close button stays reachable on iOS.

p1.title: CTAs and dividers use terracotta #C66B3D instead of canon EMBER #B85C38
p1.detail: PublicGallery uses T.color.terracotta (#C66B3D) and per-wing wing.accent HSL as its interactive/CTA color for the 'Create Own' error-state button, the footer register button, and the decorative divider (verified: getWingMeta defaults accent to T.color.terracotta). #C66B3D is a distinct off-canon orange from EMBER #B85C38, and routing CTA color through an arbitrary wing.accent makes the button color non-deterministic and can land far outside the palette.
p1.recommendation: Use a fixed EMBER #B85C38 fill for the primary register/create CTAs and reserve wing.accent for the header icon/divider identity accent only, not the primary button.

p1.title: GOLD is spent as a generic navigation/CTA gradient, breaking the palace-only rule
p1.detail: Canon (libraryTokens.ts) codifies GOLD #D4AF37 as ceremonial/palace-only (wing seals, focus rings) and EMBER #B85C38 as the interactive color; 'Never spend gold on a generic button.' On the profile surface the Follow button (ProfileCard) and the Enter-Palace button both use linear-gradient(gold->goldDark) as their fill, while the owner Edit button correctly uses EMBER. Two competing accent systems in the same header dilute gold's ceremonial meaning; the 'Visit wing ->' affordance also uses goldDark as a plain link color.
p1.recommendation: Reserve gold for the ceremonial Enter-Palace CTA only, and switch the Follow button and 'Visit wing ->' link accent to EMBER #B85C38 / EMBER_GLYPH #9A4F2A so interactive elements read consistently as ember.

p1.title: Interactive color on /pricing is off-canon terracotta #C66B3D, not EMBER #B85C38
p1.detail: Every CTA, active toggle, badge, link and accent on the page is painted with C.terracotta = '#C66B3D' (theme.ts), a noticeably more orange hue than the canon EMBER interactive token #B85C38. Because it is the single interactive color repeated across the nav CTA gradient, billing toggle, plan buttons, 'Most Popular' badge, trial note, disclosure links and IAP controls, the whole surface reads as a different accent than sibling library/atrium surfaces.
p1.recommendation: Repoint the interactive accent to canon EMBER #B85C38 (present in libraryTokens as EMBER). Import EMBER/EMBER_GLYPH for interactive states, or correct T.color.terracotta to #B85C38 so /pricing matches the rest of the palace.

p1.title: IAP purchase() attaches new approved/verified/error listeners on every call — listeners accumulate
p1.detail: Each handleSubscribe -> purchase(productId) registers fresh store.when().approved(...), store.when().verified(...), and store.error(...) callbacks without ever removing them. Repeated attempts (tap, fail, retry) stack duplicate global listeners on the singleton store. A later successful verify can resolve multiple stale promises, and the error handler's resolve(false) can fire for unrelated errors of prior attempts.
p1.recommendation: Register approved/verified/error handlers once at init (module scope) and correlate to the in-flight order via a pending map keyed by productId, or use the plugin's per-order promise API, so retries don't accumulate global listeners.

p1.title: @media queries in the injected <style> block violate the 'inline styles only, no @media' canon
p1.detail: The design canon is explicit: 'Responsiveness: INLINE STYLES ONLY, no @media — use useIsMobile()/useIsCompact()/useIsPortrait() hooks.' This surface ships ~8 @media rules inside a dangerouslySetInnerHTML <style> tag driving core layout: nav collapse (899/900px), steps-grid stacking (768px), chapter-rail hide (1023px), plus reduced-motion guards. This is a systemic deviation from how sibling surfaces (Atrium/Library) express responsiveness and means these breakpoints can't be reasoned about via the shared hooks.
p1.recommendation: Migrate the layout-driving breakpoints (nav-links vs burger, steps-grid columns, chapter-rail visibility) to useIsMobile()/useIsCompact() with inline styles, matching canon. Reduced-motion @media guards are defensible to keep; the layout @media rules should move to the hook pattern used elsewhere.

p2plus.title: Focus rings use terracotta (#C66B3D), not canon GOLD
p2plus.recommendation: Change the focus-visible outline color from T.color.terracotta to GOLD #D4AF37 (T.color.gold / L.accentDark); on-light focus should be gold, dark-hero cream outlines are fine.

p2plus.title: Primary CTA gradient uses EMBER_GLYPH (#9A4F2A), not interactive EMBER (#B85C38)
p2plus.recommendation: Rebuild the CTA gradient around EMBER #B85C38 as the interactive base, keeping #9A4F2A reserved for at-rest accent text.

p2plus.title: Language <select> desyncs when locale is restored client-side from localStorage
p2plus.recommendation: In the restore effect, after a successful load also write document.cookie mp_locale so downstream server-rendered routes inherit the resolved locale.

p2plus.title: switchLocale does a full page reload for every language change, discarding in-page state
p2plus.recommendation: Replace the reload with an in-place dynamic import of the chosen locale's slices (including the iOS seal branch); keep the cookie write, drop the reload.

p2plus.title: Hardcoded English aria-labels never localize
p2plus.recommendation: Add landingV2.a11y.menu/.mainNav/.language keys across all 5 locales; brand name may stay literal, the rest must localize.

p2plus.title: Language <select> is a 2.25rem-tall touch control on iPad web (below 2.75rem minimum)
p2plus.recommendation: Raise the select minHeight to T.touch (2.75rem).

p2plus.title: USP shell surface & shadow palette diverge from canon tokens (TRAY, warm-ink shadow)
p2plus.recommendation: Align to libraryTokens: surface TRAY #F6EBE3, base shadows on the warm-ink rgba(64,59,54,x) SHADOW ramp.

p2plus.title: PalaceCard header renders the sub-brand name twice
p2plus.recommendation: Drop the duplicated palaceName plaque row so there is one name beat per card across the family.

p2plus.title: Kep header uses U.dark near-black circles that read off-canon against cream
p2plus.recommendation: Swap the avatar fill from U.dark to canon INK #403B36 (or the warm brown EMBER_GLYPH); keep the gold glyph for the ceremonial porter mark.

p2plus.title: Kep card body is markedly taller than PalaceCard body — uneven grid rhythm
p2plus.recommendation: Standardize the body content area to a shared min-height/aspect token in UspCardShell so all USP cards align on a consistent height.

p2plus.title: PalaceCard pills/stems stay invisible if the perf-gate never fires (JS-disabled / IO-unsupported)
p2plus.recommendation: Give the pills/stems a visible resting state independent of JS, or a no-JS fallback so labels are shown rather than hidden without the perf gate.

p2plus.title: PalaceCard uses @container/@media breakpoints instead of the mandated hooks
p2plus.recommendation: If kept as an intentional container-query exception, document it explicitly so future audits don't revert it; otherwise thread width via ResizeObserver and inline the values.

p2plus.title: Cold black shadows and non-warm overlay instead of warm-ink shadow grammar
p2plus.recommendation: Use the warm-ink ramp rgba(64,59,54,x) (SHADOW.1/SHADOW.2) for card/overlay shadows and a warm-ink lightbox scrim rgba(64,59,54,0.7).

p2plus.title: Two share surfaces don't read as siblings (Tuscan-glass vs flat card)
p2plus.recommendation: Reuse TuscanCard and TuscanSectionHeader's gilt underline so the public gallery inherits the profile page's card grammar, gold seam and background ramp.

p2plus.title: Headings use charcoal #1F1B1A instead of canon INK #403B36; muted is off-canon
p2plus.recommendation: Map heading/body ink to INK #403B36 and secondary text to MUTED #716A5E; reserve near-black charcoal for the intentional 'dark' card variant only.

p2plus.title: Wing-count stats may double-count shared visits
p2plus.recommendation: Label as total wing visits, or compute a distinct owner-level visit count (COUNT of palace_visits by owner_id, or DISTINCT visitor_id).

p2plus.title: PublicGallery error path cannot distinguish 404 / 410-expired / 429
p2plus.recommendation: Branch on res.status: expired-specific for 410, retryable for 429/5xx, permanent only for 404; surface linkDeactivated vs linkNoLongerAvailable.

p2plus.title: Video thumbnails on public gallery cards autoload full video source with no poster fallback
p2plus.recommendation: Include thumbnail_url in the /api/public-share select and PublicMemory type, render an <Image> poster for video cards, and only mount <video> in the lightbox.

p2plus.title: Memory 'type' rendered as raw untranslated string
p2plus.recommendation: Add publicGallery keys type_photo/type_video/type_orb/type_case/type_album across all 5 locales and render t(`type_${mem.type}`) with a fallback.

p2plus.title: No reduced-motion guards on entry animations (profile)
p2plus.recommendation: Gate entrance animations behind a prefers-reduced-motion check (keyframe media query or useReducedMotion hook swapping animation to 'none').

p2plus.title: Pricing borders use sandstone #D6CCBA at alpha instead of canon HAIRLINE #E3D6BC
p2plus.recommendation: Use canon HAIRLINE #E3D6BC at full opacity for 1px borders.

p2plus.title: Raw px / unitless sizing dominates /pricing, contradicting rem canon
p2plus.recommendation: Convert numeric/px sizing to rem (42->2.625rem, '8px 20px'->'0.5rem 1.25rem', height 64->4rem), keeping px only for 1px hairlines.

p2plus.title: Cool-black shadow rgba(0,0,0,0.04) breaks the warm-ink shadow grammar (pricing)
p2plus.recommendation: Adopt the warm-ink SHADOW ramp: rest '0 0.25rem 1rem rgba(64,59,54,0.07)', highlighted '0 0.5rem 1.5rem rgba(64,59,54,0.14)'.

p2plus.title: IAP init effect ignores IAP_ENABLED in dep array and can double-init / race the redirect
p2plus.recommendation: Add IAP_ENABLED to the dependency array and guard setIapReady/setIapError against unmount (isMounted flag) since router.replace('/atrium') may tear down concurrently.

p2plus.title: Stripe checkout redirect detection may false-positive on a 200 error JSON, and 403 not handled
p2plus.recommendation: Treat 403/302 as unauthenticated -> /register; align the guard to the actual status the auth middleware returns so genuine auth redirects never fall to the json() error path.

p2plus.title: Currency selection is not passed to Stripe checkout — user charged in server default
p2plus.recommendation: Include currency in the checkout body and honor it server-side (Stripe multi-currency), or mark converted prices as 'approximate, billed in EUR'.

p2plus.title: Nav back-button and language select fall below the 2.75rem touch-target minimum (pricing)
p2plus.recommendation: Bump the back Link to min 2.75rem x 2.75rem and raise the language select min-height/padding to 2.75rem on touch.

p2plus.title: Language select uses fontSize 0.75rem — risks iOS focus zoom (pricing)
p2plus.recommendation: Set both <select> fontSize to 1rem (16px); reduce padding if the control must stay visually small, never below 16px on focusable form controls.

p2plus.title: Billing interval toggle is not an accessible radiogroup
p2plus.recommendation: Wrap the two buttons in role='radiogroup' with aria-label, give each role='radio'+aria-checked (or aria-pressed), and add aria-busy to the CTA while loading.

p2plus.title: Toast/redirect success path uses undefined i18n keys, falling back to raw key in non-English
p2plus.recommendation: Add subscriptionActivated and preparingStore keys to all 5 message files, or switch to the '!== key' guard.

p2plus.title: Hero/scrim/shadow colors hardcoded as raw rgba umber instead of tokens
p2plus.recommendation: Introduce L.scrim/shadow tokens and reuse the warm-ink SHADOW ramp so the umber wash and CTA shadows derive from tokens.

p2plus.title: Comparison-table concession row mixes charcoal weights and a stray success check
p2plus.recommendation: Give the table's checks a consistent accent (sage T.color.success or ember) matching the USP-rail checkmarks.

p2plus.title: USP scroll-active state relies on findIndex by title string, brittle on title collision
p2plus.recommendation: Key off a stable numeric id per item computed when building USP_FLAT instead of matching translated title text.

p2plus.title: Hero autoplay treats every mobile viewport without Network Information API as constrained
p2plus.recommendation: Offer a tap-to-play affordance on mobile or gate on saveData only; at minimum confirm poster-only default is the intended product decision.

p2plus.title: Mobile menu does not lock body scroll or trap focus while open
p2plus.recommendation: On menuOpen set body overflow hidden (restored on close), move focus into the menu, add Escape-to-close, and have Link items call setMenuOpen(false).

p2plus.title: USP chapter-rail active step exposes no aria state
p2plus.recommendation: Add aria-current={isActive ? 'true' : undefined} to the rail buttons.

p2plus.title: Hero secondary CTA prefixes a literal play glyph with no text alternative
p2plus.recommendation: Wrap the glyph in <span aria-hidden='true'> so the accessible name is just the localized label.

p2plus.title: Trust chip links may compress below the touch minimum
p2plus.recommendation: Give the trust chips minHeight: T.touch and verify computed height on touch.

p2plus.title: IntersectionObserver snapshots refs once at mount with empty deps
p2plus.recommendation: Observe elements in the ref callback (observe on set, unobserve on null) so the gate is robust to dynamic card lists.

p2plus.title: USP shell outer box-shadow uses px, not rem
p2plus.recommendation: Convert to rem: '0 0.625rem 1.875rem rgba(64,59,54,0.10)'.

p2plus.title: Kep bubble shadow hardcodes px offsets
p2plus.recommendation: Use rem offsets '0 0.0625rem 0.125rem rgba(64,59,54,0.06)' and the warm-ink shadow color.

p2plus.title: AI badge and shell logo hand-copy EMBER_GLYPH rgba literals
p2plus.recommendation: Derive alpha fills from U.accent/U.gold via a hexAlpha helper so they stay locked to token values.

p2plus.title: KepCard shell aria-label is just the brand name; vignette meaning not announced
p2plus.recommendation: Pass a descriptive label mirroring PalaceCard (kepName: kepRole — kepSaved, kepSorted) so the img role conveys the scene.

p2plus.title: PalaceCard renders palaceName twice (shell header + engraved plaque)
p2plus.recommendation: Drop the name from the engraved plaque (keep the diamond dividers as pure ornament) so the sub-brand shows once.

p2plus.title: UspCardShell logo animation lives only in globals.css @media blocks, not co-located
p2plus.recommendation: Co-locate the logo keyframes with the shell or add a comment pointing to the globals.css dependency and the .usp-live gate.

p2plus.title: Meaningful photo/frame imagery carries empty alt; the 'photo gets framed' story is invisible to SR
p2plus.recommendation: Give KepCard a localized descriptive label for the role='img' region instead of reusing m.kepName.

p2plus.title: Loading skeleton uses cool grey shimmer, not warm CREAM/EMBER placeholder tone
p2plus.recommendation: Match the skeleton to TuscanCard (glass bg, 2px gold top-border, warm-ink shadow) and give wing skeletons the arch-header block.

p2plus.title: Memory type label rendered as raw lowercase key, unstyled
p2plus.recommendation: Add textTransform:'capitalize' and treat as a small-caps meta token consistent with the profile stats' overline style.

p2plus.title: Enter-Palace button assumes publishedWings[0] ordered by published_at, not curated
p2plus.recommendation: Route the primary CTA to a palace-level entry (/visit/{profile.id}) or let the owner mark a default landing wing; fall back to publishedWings[0] only if none is set.

p2plus.title: ActivityFeed loadMore useCallback omits userId from deps
p2plus.recommendation: Add userId to the dependency array of the loadMore useCallback.

p2plus.title: Public gallery card exposes raw memory type slug as user-facing text (untranslated)
p2plus.recommendation: Map mem.type through a translated label lookup t(`memoryType_${mem.type}`) with a fallback.

p2plus.title: Self-view Edit button uses a runtime t()-echo guard instead of a real fallback
p2plus.recommendation: Replace with plain {t('editProfile')} and rely on the messages files; drop the hardcoded fallback.

p2plus.title: Report reason radios lack radiogroup semantics
p2plus.recommendation: Wrap the radio list in role='radiogroup' with aria-label={t('safetyReportTitle')}.

p2plus.title: Muted secondary text is #857B70, lighter than canon MUTED #716A5E (pricing)
p2plus.recommendation: Align C.muted to canon MUTED #716A5E (theme land.inkMutedLight already #716A5E) to hold >=4.5:1 on tiny disclosure copy.

p2plus.title: Chevron/back-button and select dropdown glyph use hardcoded grey #666, off-palette
p2plus.recommendation: Recolor the SVG chevrons to warm ink/muted (%23716A5E) in both select backgroundImage data-URIs.

p2plus.title: No canon GOLD focus ring on /pricing; controls rely on default browser focus
p2plus.recommendation: Apply the canon focusRing (0.1875rem solid #D4AF37, offset 0.1875rem) on :focus-visible for toggle, CTA and select.

p2plus.title: Restore Purchases returns false pre-init, showing 'No purchases' instead of a not-ready state
p2plus.recommendation: Distinguish 'store not ready' from a genuine empty restore (check isIAPReady() before restore and show a loading toast otherwise).

p2plus.title: No reduced-motion guard on scale/transform transitions (pricing)
p2plus.recommendation: Gate transitions behind a usePrefersReducedMotion() hook (inline, no @media) and drop to transition:'none'/no scale.

p2plus.title: Optional: use useIsPortrait() to tighten hero padding on landscape phones (pricing)
p2plus.recommendation: Acceptable per canon (no @media). Optionally tighten the 60px top padding on landscape phones via useIsPortrait().

strengths: Font system is fully on-canon: FONT_DISPLAY/FONT_BODY resolve to --font-display (Fraunces) and --font-body (Source Sans 3) via next/font in layout.tsx, with Georgia/generic only as FOUT fallbacks — display serif on headings, Source Sans on body throughout.
Core light-surface palette matches canon exactly: L.canvas #FCFAF5 (CREAM), L.inkBody #403B36 (INK), L.inkMutedLight #716A5E (MUTED), L.hairline #E3D6BC (HAIRLINE), with 1px hairline borders honored.

GOLD #D4AF37 is correctly reserved for dark-background ceremonial accents only on the main landing page (eyebrows on dark, margin-note ink, final-CTA kicker, tour-ring glow, security link), never spent on generic light-surface buttons.
Landing sizing is consistently in rem with a coherent clamp-based fluid type ramp; px is used only for 1px hairlines and small SVG icon dimensions.
Touch targets honor T.touch = 2.75rem across nav links, burger, FAQ toggles, video controls, chips and CTAs on the main landing page; hero inputs sit at >=1rem font to avoid iOS zoom.

Reduced-motion is guarded everywhere on the landing page (Reveal, tour-breath, cta-breath, scroll-behavior) and every section is SSR-visible before the reveal class is added — degradation-safe motion.

Strong visual rhythm: shared Eyebrow/H2/CtaLink primitives, a repeated 72rem 'wide' / 42rem 'prose' width system, and alternating dark-umber editorial bands vs cream content bands give a cohesive, premium cadence.

Every landing CTA is a real Next.js <Link href> to a valid route (/register, /login, /pricing, /security, /blog, /help, /privacy, /terms all resolve) — no dead or non-wired primary controls on the marketing page.

Robust iOS 3.1.1 seal implemented in two coordinated places (server sealForIos in page.tsx and the client-side twin in the restore effect), so paid surfaces never leak even on the cookie-less native path.

Reveal animation is genuinely SSR-safe: content renders opaque, the hide class is only added post-hydration and skipped when already on-screen, plus a 2500ms IntersectionObserver fail-safe guarantees content is never left invisible.

TourPlayer state machine is carefully sequenced — configures/plays the video after mode flips to 'playing', cleans up timeupdate/ended/keydown listeners, and offers a reduced-motion/saveData static storyboard fallback.

Scroll-driven nav-solid and USP-active use IO sentinels / rAF-throttled passive scroll handlers with proper cleanup, and off-screen CSS loops are paused via a usp-live IntersectionObserver for INP/battery.

areas.summary: The Storage area is functionally near-ready but ships a user-visible P0: the primary Upgrade CTA on the storage/paywall path renders the raw i18n key "upgradeNow" as its label in all five languages, because the key is absent from the palace namespace and the `|| "Upgrade"` guard is dead code that can never fire. Below that sits a cluster of P1 defects concentrated entirely in StorageBanner (off-canon tokens/EMBER, dropped {used/limit/pct} interpolation so shown percentages can contradict reality, and a 2.25rem sub-minimum touch target) plus a 2rem close button in TrackDetailPanel. Its sibling surfaces (TracksPanel, TrackDetailPanel) are, by contrast, fully re-skinned to canon and completely i18n-driven — the entire quality gap is that StorageBanner never received the reskin/i18n pass its neighbours did. Not shippable until the P0 key and the interpolation/touch-target P1s are fixed.

p0.title: StorageBanner Upgrade button renders raw key text 'upgradeNow' in every language
p0.detail: The 'upgradeNow' key is absent from the palace namespace in all 5 locale files (en/nl/de/es/fr — verified undefined; confirmed 0 matches in en.json). useTranslation.t() falls back to returning the key STRING itself when missing, so t("upgradeNow") returns the truthy string "upgradeNow". Because the code is `t("upgradeNow") || "Upgrade"` (line 92), the `|| "Upgrade"` fallback can NEVER fire — the left side is always truthy. Users therefore see the primary storage/paywall CTA literally labelled "upgradeNow" in all languages.
p0.recommendation: Add an `upgradeNow` string to the palace namespace in en/nl/de/es/fr (en "Upgrade", nl "Upgraden", de "Upgrade", es "Mejorar", fr "Améliorer"). Remove the dead, hardcoded-English `|| "Upgrade"` guard and rely solely on the translated key so coverage is enforced, not masked.

p1.title: Storage warning messages ignore used/limit/pct interpolation params — numbers never shown
p1.detail: StorageBanner passes {used, limit, pct} to t(messageKey[level], {...}) (lines 65-69), but NONE of the locale strings contain any {used}/{limit}/{pct} placeholder — verified en storageWarning50 = "You've used 50% of your storage" (hardcoded 50%). The interpolation params are silently dropped, so the banner shows a static hardcoded percentage that can contradict actual usage (at 87% it still reads '80% of your storage') and never surfaces real MB used vs limit. The dynamic/multimodal intent is defeated.
p1.recommendation: Rewrite the storageWarning50/80/95 and storageFull strings across all 5 locales to use placeholders, e.g. "You've used {pct}% ({used} MB of {limit} MB)", so the passed params render and the shown percentage matches actual usage.

p1.title: StorageBanner Upgrade button touch target is 2.25rem — below 2.75rem minimum
p1.detail: The Upgrade CTA sets minHeight 2.25rem (line 89) with padding 0.5rem 1rem — 36px, below the canon 2.75rem (44px) minimum, on the exact phones/iPad where this paywall CTA matters. TracksPanel and TrackDetailPanel's interactive controls correctly use 2.75rem, making this banner the outlier.
p1.recommendation: Raise minHeight to "2.75rem" and ensure horizontal padding keeps the tappable width >= 2.75rem.

p1.title: TrackDetailPanel close button is 2rem — below 2.75rem touch target
p1.detail: The dialog close (X) button is width/height 2rem (line 85) — 32px, below the 2.75rem (44px) minimum. TracksPanel's close button correctly uses 2.75rem, so TrackDetailPanel's close is inconsistent and hard to tap on the mobile/iPad where the Tracks flow lives.
p1.recommendation: Enlarge the close button to width/height 2.75rem to match TracksPanel and satisfy the touch-target minimum.

p1.title: StorageBanner is off-canon: uses legacy T.color tokens instead of the Atrium/Library reskin
p1.detail: StorageBanner styles entirely from the old T.color ramp (T.color.muted, T.color.terracotta, T.color.error at lines 27-32) rather than the canon hexes used by its siblings. It reads as a different generation of UI alongside TracksPanel. Notably T.color.muted = #857B70, NOT the canon MUTED #716A5E used throughout TracksPanel/TrackDetailPanel, so the info-state text/border/bg are a visibly lighter, greyer tone than the rest of the surface.
p1.recommendation: Reskin StorageBanner to the same literal canon hexes as the panels: MUTED #716A5E for info text/border, HAIRLINE #E3D6BC where appropriate, the warm-ink shadow ramp, and Fraunces/Source Sans, so it visibly belongs to the same family.

p1.title: Upgrade CTA uses off-canon ember (#C66B3D) instead of canon EMBER #B85C38
p1.detail: The primary interactive control on this surface — the Upgrade button — is painted with T.color.terracotta = #C66B3D (line 82), a brighter/oranger red than the canon EMBER interactive color #B85C38. Canon reserves EMBER #B85C38 for interactive/CTA, so the most prominent CTA on the storage surface doesn't match the app's interactive color, undermining EMBER's 'this is the action' role.
p1.recommendation: Use EMBER #B85C38 for the default/warning CTA background (canon interactive), keeping error red only for the genuine full/urgent escalation, with a hover lift to match the panels' hover language.

p2plus.title: StorageBanner has no Fraunces display type — flat all-body-font block feels unlike sibling panels
p2plus.recommendation: Introduce a small Fraunces display lead or emphasized figure (e.g. the percentage/used value) to establish hierarchy and tie the banner to the panels' type system.

p2plus.title: Storage banner Upgrade CTA has a hardcoded English fallback string
p2plus.recommendation: Remove the `|| "Upgrade"` fallback and ensure the `upgradeNow` key exists in all five message files; rely solely on t("upgradeNow") so translation coverage is enforced rather than masked (pairs with the P0 fix).

p2plus.title: StorageBanner has zero responsive handling and no reduced-motion / focus token
p2plus.recommendation: Wrap to a column on very narrow widths via useIsMobile()/useIsSmall(), and add a focus-visible outline (gold #D4AF37) for keyboard users like TracksPanel does.

p2plus.title: TracksPanel gates layout only on useIsMobile — no iPad-portrait (useIsCompact) handling
p2plus.recommendation: Use useIsCompact()/useIsTablet() for compact padding on iPad portrait, and add a responsive hook to TrackDetailPanel which currently has none.

p2plus.title: Hardcoded white #FFF for CTA text instead of canon CREAM #FCFAF5
p2plus.recommendation: Use T.color.cream / #FCFAF5 for on-color button text to keep the warm cast consistent with the palette.

p2plus.title: StorageBanner border radius (0.75rem) is smaller than the panels' 1rem card radius
p2plus.recommendation: Align the banner container to the 1rem card radius (keep 0.5rem for the inner button) to match the card family.

p2plus.title: Backdrop blur unit inconsistency between the two sibling panels (px vs rem)
p2plus.recommendation: Change TrackDetailPanel backdrop to blur(0.375rem) to match TracksPanel and the rem-only sizing rule.

p2plus.title: StorageBanner role=alert with dynamic level changes may over-announce to screen readers
p2plus.recommendation: Use role="status" (polite) for info/warning and reserve role="alert" for full/urgent, or render aria-live="polite" and switch to assertive only at >=95%.

p2plus.title: Redundant 50% storage gate duplicated across mount site and component
p2plus.recommendation: Keep the threshold in one place — either remove the outer >=0.5 guard in MemoryPalace (let the banner self-gate) or export a shared constant used by both.

p2plus.title: Level-color circle/next-step accents rely on track.color contrast that can dip below canon on light bg
p2plus.recommendation: For small text uses prefer EMBER_GLYPH #9A4F2A (or darken track.color for text), reserving raw track.color for fills/icons/borders where contrast isn't text-critical.

p2plus.title: Recommended-track sort places any track missing from a goal-priority list at the front
p2plus.recommendation: Normalize -1 to Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER before comparing indexOf results so unlisted tracks fall to the end deterministically.

p2plus.title: daysLeft treats a same-day target as 'past due' due to Math.ceil rounding at midnight boundary
p2plus.recommendation: Floor both dates to local midnight so daysLeft===0 means 'due today'; render a dedicated 'today' label for the 0 case instead of pastDue.

p2plus.title: TrackDetailPanel intercepts 'legacy' itself, duplicating the parent's onNavigate branch
p2plus.recommendation: Drop the special-case and let all navigateTo values flow through onNavigate (which already handles "legacy") for a single source of truth.

p2plus.title: Panels use 1px hairline in one spot but banner uses raw px border
p2plus.recommendation: Align borders and backdrop blur to rem for consistency; no functional impact.

strengths: TracksPanel and TrackDetailPanel are fully re-skinned to the Atrium/Library canon: hairline #E3D6BC, warm-ink shadow ramp rgba(64,59,54,0.07)/(0.14), INK #403B36, MUTED #716A5E, SAGE #56683C, and Fraunces/Source Sans applied consistently with inline comments citing each token.

Sizing is rem throughout (px reserved only for a couple tiny SVG check glyphs); touch targets meet the 2.75rem minimum in the two panels (TracksPanel close 2.75rem, TrackDetailPanel CTA minHeight 2.75rem) — the banner and TrackDetailPanel close being the only exceptions.

Responsiveness uses the useIsMobile() hook with inline conditional padding (no @media); the only @media is the legitimate prefers-reduced-motion guard plus a gold focus-visible ring (#D4AF37), satisfying both a11y and canon.
Gold is correctly restricted to the focus ring only and never spent on a generic accent, honoring the GOLD = palace-only rule; EMBER_GLYPH #9A4F2A is used for point values with an explicit comment.
Progress bars, badges, sage completion trays (#EFF2E8/#DFE3D2) and the recommended/complete overline voice (0.6875rem, 700, 0.12em, uppercase) are visually consistent across both panels.

onNavigate in MemoryPalace covers every navigateTo value used by track steps (library-import, library, entrance, wings, share, interview, legacy, keps, explore, settings), closing both panels before routing so no CTA dead-ends.

Progress math is defensive: pct clamped with Math.min(100, ...), totalSteps>0 guarded, and getLevelProgress guards divide-by-zero via the !nextLevel early return; StorageBanner's level thresholds and pct<50 early return match the mount guard.
IAP gating is correct: hideUpgrade = isAndroid() || (isIOS() && !IAP_ENABLED) hides the Upgrade CTA where no purchase path exists, matching the approved-canon pattern.

runProgressCheck merges steps idempotently with a Set and only writes state on a JSON diff, avoiding redundant re-renders and double point awards; TrackDetailPanel guards missing track (return null) so an unknown selectedTrackId can't crash.

TracksPanel and TrackDetailPanel are fully i18n-driven: tracksPanel (177 keys) and trackDetail (21 keys) namespaces are complete across all 5 locales with no hardcoded user-facing strings — making StorageBanner's missing key the sole i18n gap in the area.

areas.summary: Three of the four legal surfaces (privacy, terms, security) are genuinely production-ready: fully internationalized across all 5 locales, sharing a cohesive sticky-nav + LEGAL-overline/H1 scaffold, with security.tsx showing real illustrative polish and correct canon responsiveness. The data-deletion page, however, is not shippable: it is a design orphan with 100% hardcoded English (no i18n, no locale switcher, no shared nav) on a legally-mandated, externally-audited surface, and it documents two broken GDPR erasure paths — it tells users to send "STOP KEP" (the webhook only matches exactly "STOP", so the opt-out is instead ingested as a memory) and points to Settings → Profile for account deletion when the control actually lives in Settings → Security. A cross-cutting P1 color/rem drift (linen/charcoal/terracotta instead of canon CREAM/INK/EMBER, pervasive raw-px) keeps the whole family slightly colder than the rest of the app. Net: privacy/terms/security are near-done polish; data-deletion needs a focused rebuild before this area can be called ready.

p0.title: data-deletion page is 100% hardcoded English — no i18n, no locale switcher
p0.detail: Verified: the file imports no useTranslation and no locales; every user-facing string is a hardcoded English literal (H1 'Data Deletion Instructions', all three option headings, numbered steps, the STOP-KEP instruction, 'Back to home', 'Privacy Policy'). Sibling legal pages (privacy/terms/security) are fully translated across en/nl/de/es/fr. This is typically the Meta/WhatsApp 'data deletion callback' URL — externally visible and audited — so a NL/DE/ES/FR user sees only English on a legally-mandated page, with no language <select> to even switch.
p0.recommendation: Convert to a client i18n page like privacy/terms: add const { t, locale, setLocale } = useTranslation("dataDeletion") plus the language <select>, and move every literal into a new dataDeletion section in en/nl/de/es/fr.json.

p0.title: data-deletion tells users to send "STOP KEP" but the WhatsApp webhook only matches exactly "STOP"
p0.detail: Verified against src/lib/kep/whatsapp-processor.ts line 69: the command block is `if (upper === "STOP")`. The page (line 65) instructs users to send 'STOP KEP' to stop data collection. 'STOP KEP' does not equal 'STOP' and does not match any handled prefix (NEW/ROOM), so it falls through the command block into the AI/media-capture path — the user's opt-out request is instead ingested as a captured memory. The documented data-deletion mechanism is broken.
p0.recommendation: Change the instruction to send exactly 'STOP' (the canonical command shown in HELP), OR broaden the handler to `if (upper === "STOP" || upper === "STOP KEP")` in src/lib/kep/whatsapp-processor.ts. Prefer fixing the docs to match the canonical HELP command.

p0.title: data-deletion page is a design orphan: no nav/header, hardcoded English, bare margin-auto layout
p0.detail: Verified: privacy/terms/security share a sticky blurred nav (back-chip + PalaceLogo + brand + language <select>) and the LEGAL-overline + display H1 + lastUpdated pattern. data-deletion has none of it — it opens with a bare inline back-link and plain H1, no logo, no language switcher, no nav bar. It also applies safe-area padding directly on the max-width:720 centered container (lines 17-22), so the whole page is inset with no full-bleed header band. It reads like a different, unfinished app and breaks the legal-surface family.
p0.recommendation: Reuse the shared nav/header + LEGAL-overline/H1/lastUpdated scaffold from privacy/terms (ideally extract a <LegalShell> wrapper), route copy through useTranslation, and move safe-area padding onto a full-width outer wrapper so the header spans edge-to-edge like its siblings.

p1.title: Delete-Account instructions point to Settings → Profile, but the control lives in Settings → Security
p1.detail: Verified: Option 1 (line 56) tells the user 'Go to Settings → Profile ... Scroll to the bottom and click "Delete Account"'. The actual delete-account UI is implemented in src/app/(app)/settings/security/page.tsx (handleDeleteAccount / deleteAccount import ~line 19, button ~line 738). The profile settings page has no delete control. A user following the legal page's own instructions will not find the button, undermining the documented GDPR erasure path.
p1.recommendation: Update the step to 'Settings → Security' (or wherever the button is canonically placed) so it matches the real UI location.

p1.title: Off-canon background, ink and interactive colors throughout the legal surface
p1.detail: Canon is CREAM #FCFAF5 (bg), INK #403B36 (text), EMBER #B85C38 (interactive/CTA), MUTED #716A5E. Every legal page instead paints bg with C.linen #F2EDE4, body/heading text with C.charcoal #1F1B1A (a colder near-black, not warm INK), links/CTA with C.terracotta #C66B3D (brighter than EMBER), and secondary text with C.muted #857B70. Net effect is a grayer, colder, more orange surface than canon Library/Atrium, so the legal pages don't sit in the same warm-cream family. (data-deletion uses these same off-canon tokens — see lines 14-16, 55, 74.)
p1.recommendation: Align to canon tokens: bg CREAM #FCFAF5, body/headings INK #403B36, interactive EMBER #B85C38, secondary MUTED #716A5E. If T.color must stay, add canon-aligned aliases (cream/inkSoft already exist in theme.ts) and switch these pages to them.

p1.title: Pervasive raw-px sizing violates rem canon (px reserved for hairlines only)
p1.detail: Canon: rem for sizing, px only for 1px hairlines. privacy and terms set nearly all type and spacing in raw px: nav height 64, brand fontSize 20, overline 12, H2 24, body/Li 15, section marginBottom 40, main padding '60px clamp(20px,5vw,40px) 100px', footer link 14. security is the same (borderRadius 16/20, padding '28px 24px', gap 12/20). This won't scale with user root-font-size and diverges from the rem-based Library tokens.
p1.recommendation: Convert type/spacing/radii to rem (24px→1.5rem, 40px→2.5rem, radius 16px→1rem), keep only 1px hairline borders in px, and lean on RT/space scales for consistency.

p2plus.title: Language <select> triggers a full window.location.reload() on change
p2plus.recommendation: For the legal pages, use setLocaleNoReload from the hook (already returned) so language changes preserve scroll position without a reload.

p2plus.title: Terms links to the EU ODR platform, which the European Commission shut down on 20 July 2025
p2plus.recommendation: Remove the ODR link/paragraph or replace with current guidance; verify the target resolves before shipping legal copy that cites it as a live remedy.

p2plus.title: Responsive layout uses clamp()/vw instead of the mandated useIsMobile/useIsCompact hooks
p2plus.recommendation: Adopt the same useIsMobile/useIsSmall pattern security.tsx uses for the shared nav and content padding so all four legal pages branch responsively the canon way.

p2plus.title: Native language <select> font 0.75rem can trigger iOS focus zoom
p2plus.recommendation: Raise the select fontSize to 1rem (≥16px) to prevent focus-zoom on iOS, or scale it visually with transform while keeping the intrinsic font at 1rem. Apply on privacy/terms/security.

p2plus.title: Language <select> chevron hardcodes a gray #666 arrow off the warm palette
p2plus.recommendation: Recolor the chevron to a warm ink/muted token (e.g. url-encoded %23716A5E MUTED or C.walnut) so the control matches the surrounding warm palette.

p2plus.title: CTA glow shadow uses a raw non-token orange rgba, not the warm-ink shadow grammar
